tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //shā chi/hā sbya 7717shā 0'aḥcuXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog

༄7/ /snyan dgon sprul sku gsung rab mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum legs bshad nor bu'i snang ba bzhugs/mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis 'tshol sdud dag sgrig byas/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chagagasang sngags gsar rnying gi lta ba gcig tu sgrub pa dag snang nor bu'i me long (3)gsar rnying mkhas pa'i dgongs bzhed gcig tu sgrub pa rigs lam bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin/ (49)gangs can sgrub brgyud sngon byung rnams kyi chos kyi bab la mnyam par bzhag pa/ (63)rgyal ba'i gsung rab la sbyangs pa'i go thob kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ (75)rdzogs chen chos skor sogs/ (91)theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po'i gtam rig 'dzin mnyes pa'i mchod sprin/ (133)snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i mtshan don/ (200)snga 'gyur theg pa rim dgu'i skor/ (208)snga 'gyur rnying ma'i ring lugs bsre bslad med par bshad pa/ (218)rdzogs pa chen po/'i tha snyad 'ga'i 'grel ba/ (227)rdzogs chen chos skor thor bu 'ga' zhig (234)phyag rdzogs sogs kyi skor kyi brjed tho 'ga' zhig (267)phyag rdzogs gdams pa'i skor gyi brjed tho/ (268)lha'i rnal 'byor sko ra gyi brjed tho sogs/ (272)rtsod bzlog dang dris lan sogs kyi skor/ (293)rtsod pa bzlos tshul las 'phros pa'i brjed byang / (291)1

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi lta ba'i dris lan mkhas pa'i zhal lung / (308)rdo rje phur ba'i rtsa sngags kyi don cung zad bshad pa/ (354)slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam/ (363)mkhan chen bo rnyi sa twa la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ (377)bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun min gsang ba'i lam du bsgrub pa grub dbang thugs bcud/ (388)theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa/ (395)
dbozhung

— gsangarnyingadagongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/༄/ /gsang sngags gsar rnying gi lta ba gcig tu sgrub pa dag snang nor bu'i me long /༄ / /na mo gu ru mdzi gho ṣā ya/ phyogs bcu'i zhing du rgyal sras rnam pa yis/ /zab mo'i gtam gyis 'gro ba 'dul ba la/ /zla med thugs bskyed mthu grub 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dge ba'i bshes su rol ba'i blo gros gter/ /yab rje de dang dbyer med bstan pa'i bdag /pad+ma ka ra kun mkhyen tsong kha pa/ /mkhas pa'i khyu mchog rong klong rnam gnyis sogs/ /'dren mchog dam pa rnam la phyag byas te/ /thun mong theg par khyad par med mod kyang / /gsang sngags snga phyi'i 'gyur gyis phye ba yi/ /bka' srol so so'i grub mtha'i gsung sgros 'ga' / /'dra min snang yang dgongs pa'i gnad gcig tshul/ /cung zad mthong nas rang blo goms pa'i slad/ /lung rigs 'phrul gyis dka' gnad bkrol ba la/ /rgyal bstan dbyen la sbyor rnams mi dgyes mod/ /lung stong phyugs rdzis gling bu 'bud bzhin sgrogs/ /de la 'dir bsil ldan gyi ljongs 'di'i skye dgu'i phan bde'i ('byung gnas )rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la rnam grangs mang du yod pa las / gtso bor gyur pa bstan pa snga dar gyi rang lugs snga 'gyur 3

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gsang sngags rnying ma dang / phyi dar gyi lugs bzang bka' gdams gsar rnying gnyis dang / khyad par du bka' gdams glegs bam las / tha mar bstan pa'i me ro dag /grags pa'i mtshan gyis gso bar byed/ /ces lung bstan pa ltar gyi mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i bka' srol chen po gnyis su thub bstan rin po che'i srog tu bzhugs bzhin pa 'dir/ da lta dus kyi dbang gis lta ba snyigs mar gyur pa'i stobs kyis lung rigs kyi sgo nas legs par gtan la 'bebs pa shin tu dkon pas phan tshun lta grub 'gal 'dur mthong ste / rgyal bstan la ris gcod byed pa mang bas bstan pa rin po che nyag phra bar gyur mod/ bdag ni skyes sbyangs kyi rnam dpyod shin tu chung bas rgyal bstan la bya ba byed pa rngo mi thogs kyang / mtshan ldan gyi bshes gnyen dam pa du mas rjes su bzung ba'i thugs rjes bstan pa snga phyi de dag gi dgongs pa'i babs so shin tu gcig par mthong nas phyogs ris kyi mun pa sangs pa ltar rang dang skal mnyam gyi'ang chos spong gi las kyi sgo khegs pa dang / rgyal bstan phyogs med la dad gus dang / dag snang 'phel ba'i slad gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag bzhed tshul mthun pa'i lung rigs kyi sgo tsam dbye bar bya yi / dug sbrul gyis gla rtsi'i dri tshor ba mi bzod pa ma mdzad par gzu 4

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/bor gnas pa'i rnam dpyod kyis bdag la grogs dan mdzad du gsol lo zhes mkhas pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so/ /de yang dang po gzhi ngo bo'i gnas tshul gyi skor la/ mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa rnams nges don mthar thug gi zab mo lta ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed la de bzhin gshegs pa so so rang rig gi theg pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen por lung bstan pa'i phyir mgon po klu sgrub kho nar gsungs shing / de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba la jo bo dang mi tre ba sogs rgya gar mkhas pa'i bzhed pa bzhin sangs rgyas bskyangs dang zhi ba lha dpal ldan zla ba grags pa gsum 'gran zla med pa'i slob dpon du bzung nas/ gtso bor de dag gi rjes su 'brangs nas zab mo'i lta ba 'tshol ba yin la/ de bzhin du gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i phyogs nas kyang mdzad pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal bo snga ma klong chen rab 'byams kyis yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa'i rtsa 'grel las/ da ni nang ba sangs rgyas pa dag gi mtshan nyid theg pa chen po'i rtse mo dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs rnam par bzhag pa ni/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug snying bo'i don/ /thal 'gyur bas ni spros pa kun 'gog ste/ /chos kun rten 'brel stong nyid rang bzhin med/ /bden gnyis sgyu ma 5

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mtha' bral nyid sgo nas/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams mthar phyin byed/ /thub pa bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa ston pa ni dbu ma thal 'gyur ba yin la/ de'i shing rta 'dren pa'i srol 'byed pa thog ma ni bcom ldan 'das kyis rnga bo che chen po'i mdor lung bstan pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi nyi ma dri ma med pas lta ba ngan pa'i 'thibs so sel bar mdzad pa mgon po klu sgrub yin te/de'i gzhung rigs pa'i tshogs drug gi don 'grel ba'ang 'phags pa lha dang / sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / legs ldan 'byed dang / zla ba grags pa la sogs pa ste/ de dag gi nang nas mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje ldan pa 'phags pa zla ba grags pas ni slob dpon gyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud nas dbu ma rtsa ba'i don gyi 'grel ba dbu ma la 'jug pa dang / tshig gi 'grel ba tshig gsal ba mdzad de/ 'dzam bu'i gling du sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa mthar thug pa dbu ma thal 'gyur gyi nyi ma shar bar mdzad pas lta ba ngan pa'i 'thibs so bsal bar byas pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /klu sgrub thal 'gyur ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed lta bur gsung ba ni/dbu ma'i shing rta'i srol 'byed dang / thal 'gyur ba'i gzhi mthun gyi don yin pa las sger gyi srol 'byed zla bar bzhed par gsal te/6

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/'dzam gling du thal 'gyur gyi nyi ma 'char bar mdzad mkhan zla bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /kun mkhyen phyi ma rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling pa yang de ltar bzhed de/ de'i nyams mgur las/ yum chen shes rab phar phyin dang 'khyud rgya zhig byas pas/ /dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi nyams shig shar byung / /bshad pa'i chu mgo de zla ba grags pa la zhu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//1 yang rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos thal rang gi khyad par chos can mthun snang ba bzhed mi bzhed sogs kyis thal zlog dang rang rgyud 'gog tshul gyi khyad par gangs can 'dir sngar ma grags pa'i rgya gar mkhas pa'i legs bshad zhib mor phye ba'i rigs lam gyi sgo chen po btod kyang / mdor bsdu na de gnyis rang mtshan gyi khas len yod med kyis 'byed pa ltar kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po yang bzhed de/ yid bzhin mdzod kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa'i sngar gyi 'phros las/ 'dir de'i gzhung phyin ci ma log pa'i don bsdus te brjod pa ni/ gshis ngo bor gang yang rang bzhin ma grub pa dang khas len pa thams cad bden zhen dang bcas pas rang bzhin du smra ba dag gi lugs rang gi gzhung khas blangs na 'gal ba dang dngos po stobs zhugs khas len pa po de'i gzhung la grags tshad des 'gog pa 7

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/yin la/ bkag pa'i rjes la rang rgyud pa ltar nges pa'i dam bca' med de/ gal te nga la dam bcas 'ga' yod/ /des na nga la skyon 'di yod/ /nga la dam bca' med pas na/ /nga ni skyon med kho na yin / /zhes pa'i tshul gyis go bar byed pas 'dir de gtan la dbab pa la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di'i khas len med lugs kyang snga rabs pa kha cig dbu ma pa la khas len spyi med par 'dod pa'i don ltar min te/ khas len mi len gyi rnam gzhag 'og nas gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir te/ gtsang ba dang rma bya ltar khas len yod med kyi phyogs gcig mi 'dzin par khas len mi len kun rdzob tu yin gyi/don dam du khas len yod med kyi dpyad pa med pa dang / yang kun rdzob tu skabs kyi dbye bas khas blang rgyu dang / mi len rgyu gnyis yod par gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang gsungs te/ de nyid las/ rtsod pa dang / don dam yul du byed pa'i tshe snang ba gang yang rang bzhin med pa gshis la yod pa khas len med pa'i phyir/ khas blang bar bya ba ma yin no/ /lam rjes thob pa tha snyad yul du byed dus gsung rab las bshad pa ltar rnam dbye dang bcas pa rmi lam sgyu ma'i grub mtha' tsam du shes nas rang gis kyang dpyad de bsam zhing / gzhan la'ang bstan nas blang dor gyi dmigs phyed nas lam dbu ma tshogs gnyis 8

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/la zhugs te 'bras bu sku gnyis 'grub pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /sogs zhib par gsungs so/ /de bzhin du 'grel ba phyogs bcu'i mun sel las kyang de'ang dbu ma rang rgyud pa ni chos thams cad kun rdzob tu snang la de yang brtags na don dam par rang bzhin med par 'dod de / dbu ma bden gnyis las/ kun rdzob 'di ltar snang ba 'di/ /rigs pas brtags na 'ga' mi rnyed/ /ma rnyed pa de don ldan te/ /ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes so/ /dbu ma thal 'gyur ba ni dpyad rung ma dpyad rung dus gtan du chos thams cad spros pa nye bar zhi ba khas len thams cad dang bral bar 'dod de/ 'jug pa las / ji ltar khyod kyi gzhan dbang dngos 'dod ltar kun rdzob kyang ni bdag gi khas ma blangs/ zhes pa dang / zhes su gsungs nas dngos smra ltar rang mtshan gyi dngos po khas len pa dang mi len pa'i sgo nas dbye bar gsal bar gsungs so/ /2 thal rang la dgag bya'i khyad de lta bu yod pas thub dgongs mthar thug thal 'gyur ba'i lugs gzhir bzhag ste/ rang mtshan gyis grub pa'am yul rang ngos nas grub pa rdul phra mo tsam yang rje bdag nyid chen pos zhal gyis mi bzhes te/ de bzhin du gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i nang rgyud gsum gyi nges don gyi lta ba yang rang bzhin gyis 9

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/grub pa med par shin tu bzhed de/ slob dpon chen po'i man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba las/ de la rgyud gcig par rtogs pa ni/ chos thams cad don dam par ma skyes pas so so ma yin pa dang / kun rdzob tu sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid du so so ma yin pa dang / ma skyes pa nyid chu zla ltar sgyu ma sna tshogs su snang zhing bya ba byed nus pa dang / sgyu ma nyid ngo bo med de/ ma skyes pas kun rdzob dang don dam par dbyer med pas rgyu gcig pa rtogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang bshad bya rtsa ba'i mdo / chos thams cad ni ngo bo nyid kyis stong ba'o/ /zhes sogs drangs nas bshad pa mdzad la/ 'di'i nyid sgra gnyis kyang dmigs gsal can gyi dgag pa'i skabs 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo drangs pa ltar rang mtshan 'gog pa'i tshig yin la/ bden gnyis dbyer med kyi don kyang ngo bo gcig pa tsam la mi byed par dgag bya phra mo khegs pa'i bden gnyis kyi go thob khyad par can zhig la byed dgos par rong zom chen pos gsungs so/ /gzhan rong zom lo tsā ba chen pos theg chen tshul 'jug tu dgag bya rang mtshan phra mo nas 'gog tshul 'di ltar gsungs te/ de la yang dag par bsgrub par bya ba mi 'dod na/ kun rdzob thams cad 'go mnyam par 'gyur ba ji lta bu zhe na / dper na thag pa la sbrul du mthong ba'i tshe thag pa ni yang dag 10

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/par yod pa'o/ /sbrul ni gtan med pa'o/ /thag par mthong ba'i blo ni yang dag pa'i shes pa'o/ /sbrul du mthong ba'i blo ni 'khrul ba'i shes pa'o/ /'khrul na ma dag pa yin pa'i phyir blo de nyid kyang ji ltar snang ba de bzhin du yod pa ma yin pas/ de'i bdag nyid thob par mi 'gyur te/ gzhan las gzhan du btags pa tsam mo/ /de nas yang thag pa de nyid la zhib tu brtags na rtswa'am spu'i cha shas du ma 'dus pa tsam du mthong ste/ thag pa zlum ril gcig pu'i blo zhig pa na/ cha shas 'dus pa tsam ni yang dag par yod pa'o/ /thag pa dang sbrul ni 'go mnyam ste gtan med pa'o/ /cha shas 'dus pa tsam du mthong ba'i blo yang dag pa'i shes pa'o/ /thag pa'i blo ni sprul gyi blo dang 'dra ste/'khrul ba'i shes pa'o/ /de nas yang spu dang rtswa de nyid la zhib tu brtags na rdul 'dus pa tsam du mthong ste/ rtswa dang spu'i cha shas kyang ma grub par rtogs pa na don dang blo'i tshul thams cad snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas yang rdul de nyid la blos rnam par phye na/ rdul nyid kyang ma grub par rtogs te/ gzugs kyis stong ba'i stong ba nyid tsam yod par mthong ba de'i tshe/ don dang blor bcas pa thams cad snga ma bzhin / de nas yang stong ba nyid la rnam par brtags na/ stong ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang dngos po la ltos nas rnam par bzhag pa tsam ste/11

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dngos po nyid ma grub na stong ba nyid mi 'grub ste/ gang zhig stong /chos gang gis stong / sus stong ba ste/ bsgrub par bya ba'i chos gang yang med par rtogs pa na/ don thams cad med par 'go mnyam mol/ /blo thams cad 'khrul bar 'go mnyam mo/ /'khrul ba thams cad ji ltar snang ba de ltar ma yin par 'go mnyam mo/ /de ltar ma yin pa thams cad de'i bdag nyid thob pa med par 'go mnyam mo/ /bdag nyid thob pa med par gyur pa na/ don dang blo gnyis ka la'ang mtshan nyid 'go mi mnyam pa med do/ /de la dang po sbrul du mthong ba na skrag ste sdang ba skyes so/ /de nas thag par mthong ba na snang ba spangs pa'i rlom sems 'byung ste/ chags pa skyes pa'i blo 'byung ngo / /de nas thag pa'i blo zhig pa na thag pa zlum ril la chags pa'i blo spangs nas du ma 'dus pa tsam la chags pa'i blo skyes te/ ji srid du dngos por lta ba ma log pa de srid du chags sdang spang ba dang skye ba'i blo ni ldog par mi 'gyur mod kyi/ don gyi mtshan nyid la ni yang dag par bzhag pa'i rdzas ma grub tsam na/ re zhig par bzhag pa'i rdzas dang 'go mi mnyam par mi 'grub ste/ snang ba tsam la mi bskur ba ma gtogs pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad 'go mnyam mo/ /zhes gsungs te/gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa/ /12

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/zhes gsungs pa de yang 'di ltar/ dmigs pa'i gtad so zhig pa zhig la byed rgyu yin 'dug pas gsar rnying gi rjes 'brang blo gsal rnams thugs rig grim pos gzigs la phyogs ris kyi mun pa sel bar mdzod cig rong zom gyi gsung 'dir rang mtshan 'gog lugs dpe dang bcas shin tu gsal zhing rgyas par gsungs 'dug kyang yi ges 'jigs nas ma drangs la/ rjes 'jug nges don gyi lta sgom la re ba can yod na legs bshad kyi rin thang shes dgos so/ /de dang mtshungs par kun mkhyen chen po'i theg mchog mdzod kyi rim khang bcu gsum par/ thag pa dang chos mthun pa'o/ /thag pa yang brtags na spu nyag ma re re ba 'ching ba'i don byed mi nus pa dang 'dra ba la/ ma brtags na tshogs pa 'ching byed du grub pa ltar 'khrul snang dang 'khrul 'dzin gnyis po dpyad na gzhi med/ ngo bo nyid kyang stong yang ma brtags na blo dang snang yul 'khrul ba rang rig 'ching byed ltar snang ba'o/ /bcings par snang dus nas bcings pa med la/grol bar snang dus nas 'ching byed rang mtshan pa med pas grol ba med de/ sgyu 'phrul las/ sus kyang ma bcings bcing med de/ /'ching bar bya ba yod ma yin/ /bcing med rnam par bgrol med pa/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos/ /bstan phyir spro ba sna tshogs 13

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mdzad / /ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsung la de ltar thag khra'i sbrul bzhin gsungs pa ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gzhan dbang la/ kun rdzob kyi snang tshul 'di rang bzhin du 'jog pa thag pa la sbrul ltar sgro btags sam kun btags 'ba' zhig dang / mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi gzigs tshul thag pa la thag pa ltar yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag dpal ldan zla bas gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /gzhan yang kun mkhyen chen po'i dgongs nyams glegs bam du shar ba'i rdo rje'i tshig chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las / rnam dag byang chub sems kyi ngo bo la/ /blta ba'i yul med lta ba'i chos su med/ /blta bar bya dang byed pa rdul tsam med/ /sgom pa'i blo med bsgom bya cung zad med/ /spyad dang spyod pa gnyis med lhun grub pas/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i 'bras bu rdul tsam med/ /med pa'i chos la bgrod pa'i sa med pas/ /par phyin bya ba'i lam yang ye nas med/ /'od gsal thig le chen por grub zin pas/ /rnam rtog 'phro 'dus bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /sngags dang kha ton dbang dang dam tshig med/ /rim sdud la sogs mi dmigs rdzogs rim med/ /ye nas grub zin sku dang ye shes la/ /'dus byas glo bur rkyen byung rgyu 'bras med/ /'di dag yod na rang byung ye shes min/ /14

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/'dus byas nyid phyir 'jig pa nyid dang ni/ /lhun grub 'dus ma byas zhes gang slad mtshon/ /de phyir don dam dbyings kyi ngo bo la/ /rgyu 'bras las 'das rang bzhin rnam bcu med/ /rtsol dang sgrub med sems nyid rnal ma'i don/ /yod med spros kun zhi bar mkhyen 'tshal lo / /zhes gsungs shing gnas lugs mdzod du med pa sogs bzhi re re la 'gag sdom gnad du dril ba la bzla ba'i skor du yang shin tu gsal la/ gzhan mdzod chen bdun dang / ngal gso gsum sogs su chos sku stong nyams chen po'i rdo rje'i tshig gi do ha bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bka' bstsal pa rnams ni dgag bya phra mo 'gog tshul yin pa shes par gyis la chos sku'i gdung ma bcad par dag snang gi ngang du bzhugs zhes da lta'i gsar rnying gi blo gsar rnams la zhu'o/ /3 de ltar dgag bya rang ngos nas grub pa rdul phra mo tsam mi bzhed kyang snang phyogs la gtsigs su byed dgos zhes 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bka' bzhin rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos snang tsam 'di mi 'gog ste/ snang ba rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi lugs su yang snang tsam mi 'gog pa ni/ lta phreng las/ ma skyes pa nyid chu zla ltar sgyu ma sna tshogs su snang zhing bya ba byed nus pa dang / zhes gsungs shing /15

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/kun mkhyen rong zom lo tsā ba chen pos kyang / rkyen rnams nye bar gnas bzhin du/ /'bras bu snang bar mi 'gyur zhes/ /gang du'ang skur ba ma btab pas/ /'di la skur ba'i gnas ma mthong rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel tshul du/ /snang ba tsam las ma gtogs pa/ /rgyu 'bras dngos po mi bsgrub pas/ /'di la sgro 'dogs gnas ma mthong ske/ /gang gzhan sgro skur bral ba'i don/ /tshul gzhan dag gis sgrub byed kyang / /nges don bka' yi rjes 'brangs nas/ /don la bdag blo 'di ltar skyes/ /zhes gsungs la/ de bzhin kun mkhyen chen pos chos dbyings mdzod du yang / 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rig pa byang chub la/ /spangs thob med pa'i snang srid 'khor 'dus shar/ /gzung 'dzin med pa'i rnal 'byor ngo kha la/ /med la snang 'di ya mtshan rgod po 'chor/ /snang bar med la sna tshogs snang bar shar/ /stong bar med la mtha' dbus khyab par bdal/ /gzung 'dzin med la nga bdag so sor zhen/ /gzhi rtsa med la tshe rabs brgyud mar snang //dgag sgrub med la bde sdug blang dor byed/ /par bltas skye 'gro'i snang ba mtshar re che/ /mi bden bden par zhen pas bden chen 'dra / /zhes sogs dang / yang / 'di yi ngang la rgyu 'bras bya rtsol med / /lta ba sgom du med pa la sogs te/ /mtha' dbus gnyis med 16

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/dpog pa'i tshul brjod kyis/ /gzhan du ngang las phyir 'khyal rtsal nyid las/ /rol ba sna tshogs snang srid dgu 'char bas/ /rgyu 'bras med ces nam yang ma brjod cig /ces gsungs/4 de lta bu'i snang tsam gyi 'khor 'das gyi rnam gzhag thams cad ming rkyang btags yod tsam du rje bdag nyid chen po bzhed pa bzhin / gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba yang gzhi grub na btags yod kyis khyab par bzhed de/ rnying rgyud kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las/de nas sems dpa' chen pos bka' bstsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs chos thams cad ni/ brda dang / tha snyad dang / btags pa tsam du shes par gyis shig btags pa'i chos thams cad ni phyi nang gang na yang mi gnas te/ chos thams cad la ming gi gzhi med cing btags pa'i tha snyad dang bral ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang spyi mdo dgongs 'dus le'u bdun cu don lnga ba las gsungs pa bzhin gnubs chen gyi mdo 'grel mun pa'i go cha las kyang 'di ltar gsungs te/ gzhi la 'gro ba rang rgyud pa med pas zhen rtog snang ba'i phyir btags pa'i yod pa tsam pas so/ /zhes dang / 'o na gang med pa las snang na ri bong rwa dang nam mkha'i me tog kyang 'byung bar rigs so zhe na/ gang las ming du btags pa'i gzhi/ /med rgyu 17

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/btags chags bsgrub 'grub cing / /zhes pa de kho na nyid kyi dngos po tha dad pa la btags pa ril gyi gzhi ni ji lta bu zhe na/ mtshan nyid thams cad pa mtshan nyid med pa/ rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa bral ba/brjod pa kun 'byung brjod pa med pa ni/ gang yang ma bkol bas rnam pa'i phyogs bral ba'i phyir ngo bo med pa lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyu la ji ltar btags bsnyad pa ltar chags grub bsam pa ltar snang ba'o/ /de lta bus na ri bong rwa dang mi mtshungs so/ /zhes gdags gzhi rang bzhin med kyang snang ba'i chos la brten nas tha snyad btags pa chags te 'dogs yul de go zhing de'i dgos pa bsgrub nus par grub pa'i cha nas don rang mtshan du med kyang ri bong rwa bzhin med mi dgos pa'i khyad par legs par gsungs te/ tha snyad kyi 'jog mtshams shin tu phra mo de la gnubs chen yang rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa dang dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig pa'i tshul 'di shes par gyis la zhwa'i kha dog tsam rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ rgyal bstan dbyin la ma sbyor zhes gsar rnying gi da lta'i blo gsar rnams la gsol ba 'debs so/ /sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying bo'i le'u gsum pa las/chos rnams ming du btags pa tsam/ /ston pas don dang mthun phyogs su/ /ming dang tshig tu btags nas bstan/ /ston ming tshig la 18

—— gsangarnyingadagongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/dngos po med/ /ces dang / de'i thad kyi phyogs bcu mun sel las/snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams thams cad don la grub pa med pas ming du btags pa tsam ste/ mdo las/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni brda tsam btags pa tsam ste ngo bo nyid kyis yongs su grub pa med do/ /zhes so/ /sus btags she na lha mi'i ston pa sangs rgyas kyis snang tsam ma 'gags pa/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i don dang re zhig mthun pa'i phyogs su mdzad de/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa phung bo dang khams dang skye mched ces pa la sogs pa'i ming dang tshig tu btags nas bstan to/ /dgos pa ni don gyi gnas lugs blos rtogs par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar ming tshig tu btags nas ston pa'i dus nyid na ming tshig la dngos po med de nam mkha' zhes brjod dus na ming tshig de nyid nam mkha'i khams la ni grub pa med cing / lus dang sems la nam mkha'i ming tshig kyang med de / gang nas kyang nam mkha'i ming tshig mi rnyed pas dngos po dang ngos bzung med do/ /de nyid nam mkha'i don dang dbyer med pas chos thams cad blos ming tshig tu btags kyang ming don gang du yang grub pa med pa'i rang bzhin du shes par bya/ zhes shin tu gsal bar gsungs la/ sems phyogs nas kyang chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod 19

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/las / rten med rmi lam 'dra ba'i rang bzhin la/ /'khor 'das rang mtshan zhen pa mtshar re che/ /thams cad kun bzang lhun grub chen po ni / /ma 'khrul mi 'khrul 'khrul bar mi 'gyur bas/ /srid pa ming tsam yod med mtha' las 'das/ /zhes dang / ye nas lhun grub rang byung rig pa che/ /ma grol mi grol grol bar mi 'gyur la/ /'das pa ming tsam su yang grol ma myong / /myong bar mi 'gyur bcings pa ye nas med/ /ces sogs gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i ming du btags pa tsam la bya byed 'thad pa yang theg mchog mdzod kyi rim khang bcu dgu bar / phyi snang ba sna tshogs/ nang dran rtog glo bur/ dbang po drug snang yul dang bcas pa thams cad med pa gsal snang tsam las/don la phyi nang gang na yang med pa rab rib can gyi skra shad dang / sgyu ma dang mig 'phrul dang / sprul ba lta bur blo la snang yang / snang dus de nyid nas yod med kyi mtha' las 'das par shes par bya ste/ snang ba'i ngos nas ji ltar btags kyang mi 'gal/ yin du chug /min du chug /yod du chug /med du chug /snang du chug /stong du chug /'khrul du chug /grol du chug /bzang du chug /ngan du chug /sems su chugagazhan du chug gang ltar btags kyang stong ba'i ngos nas ji ltar btags pa de nyid kyis thog mar stong ste/ btags pa sems yin/20

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/sems med pa yin/ med pa la 'dogs mkhan med pas rmi lam gyi bya byed / sgyu ma'i bya byed bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ rang bzhin med kyang yin min yod med grol 'khrul sogs 'thad lugs dang / de ltar btags tsam nas skra shad kyi snang ba sogs dang 'dra bar ye nas yul steng du yod ma myong ba'i snang tsam yin lugs gsungs pa sogs shin tu gsung 'gangs che ste/ dbu ma rtsa ba las/ gang la stong ba nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung bar 'gyur/ /sogs dang / byang chub sems 'grel las/ chos rnams stong ba 'di shes nas/ /las dang 'bras bu bsten pa gang / /ngo mtshar bas kyang 'di ngo mtshar/ /rmad byung bas kyang 'di rmad byung / /zhes don ji bzhin pa yin no/ /gzhan yang rgyal bo rā ma ṇas bu 'ba' le mched gnyis kyi lo rgyus sogs dpe dang bcas te rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu la bya byed 'thad lugs shin tu rgyas par rong zom mkhas pa'i dbang phyug de nyid kyis legs par gsungs yod pas de'i gsung rab la mi blta ba shin tu phangs so/ /5 yang bden gnyis kyi mtshan nyid 'khrul ba dang ma 'khrul ba'i blo'i rnyed don gyi cha nas rje bdag nyid chen pos ngos 'dzin gnang ba ltar snga 'gyur pa yang bzhed de/ 'phags pa gsum gyi 21

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mnyam bzhag ye shes don dam 'jog byed ma 'khrul ba'i blo dang / ma rig pa dang de'i bag chags kyis bslad pa'i blo rnams kun rdzob 'jog byed blo 'khrul bar kun mkhyen chen pos bzhed pa'i phyir te/grub mtha' mdzod las/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la gsum ste/blo 'khrul ba dang ma 'khrul ba'i dbye ba/ de la ltos te bden pa gnyis su dbye ba'i tshul/ thal 'gyur gyis spros pa gcod pa'i tshul sogs rgyas par gsungs te/ yi ges 'jigs nas ma drangs so/ /yang spyod 'jug gi dgongs pa ltar gnyis snang can gyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul yin min gyi sgo nas kyang kun mkhyen chen pos bden pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid gsungs te/ yid bzhin mdzod las/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i mtshan nyid blo'i yul las ma 'das pa'i chos dpyad mi bzod pa/don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid dmigs pa nye bar zhi ba'o/ /dpyad bzod mi 'thad de sngar bkag zin to/ /zhes gsungs shing 'di'i blo 'das kyi don gnyis snang can gyi kun rtog gi yul du mngon sum du mi 'gyur ba la gsungs te/don dam so so rang rig gi yul du gsungs pa la/ so so rang rig gi blo yin pas don dam yang blo 'das ma yin pa'i dogs pa bslangs nas bsal ba'i phyir te/ yid bzhin mdzod las/ so so rang rig 22

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/dang blo gcig yin mod snyam na/ brda la rmongs pas re bden/ 'on kyang blo ni kun rtog pa la skabs 'dir mdzad de/ zhes gsungs so/ /des na ye shes yul med dang / /chos nyid yul ma yin pa dang / /don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /sogs snga rabs pa 'ga' zhig ltar 'grel ba ni/ rang lugs kun mkhyen gyi gsung ngag bdud rtsi'i btung ba yod bzhin du gzhan zer mchil ma'i thal ba la longs spyod pa yin no / /'on kyang ye shes yul med du gsungs pa 'ga' re yod pa ni yongs gcod sgrub pa'i chos yul du mi 'gyur bar dgag bya 'khrul rtog gi zhen stangs sun dbyung ba'i don tsam la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul gsungs pa ste/ gsar bu ba rnams skrag pa skye ba'i gnas med dgag cig gzigs ngor shar ba'i don no/ /6 de lta bu'i bden gnyis kyi dbye ba ni/ phung gsum sel ba'i grangs nges kyi dbye ba yin par rje bdag nyid chen pos bzhed pa ltar kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer kyang bzhed de/ grub mtha' mdzod las/bzhi ba grangs nges pa ni/ spros pa las grol ma grol dngos 'gal du nges pas bsgrub phyogs dang dgag phyogs kyi phung bo gsum pa khegs pas gnyis su grangs nges so/ /rnam pa gcig tu na yul rnams ni yul can la ltos nas 'jog pa na yul can ni mthar ma thug pa 23

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'khrul ba'i blo dang / mthar thug pa ma 'khrul ba'i blo gnyis las mi 'da' / de la 'khor ba'i chos rnams ni 'khrul ba dang / chos nyid ni ma 'khrul ba'i yul yin pas blo'i dbang gis gnyis su bzhag ste/'jug pa las/ dngos kun yang dag rdzun pa mthong ba yi/ /sogs drangs nas gsungs so/ /des na yod min med min gyi shes bya phung gsum pa sogs khas len pa'i gsang sngags rnying ma ba yod na rang lugs don la sgrib pa yin pas mi mdzes so/ /skya bden gnyis kyi ya gyal kun rdzob bden pa la yang log gnyis su don la 'byed rgyu med par gangs can gyi shing rta chen pos bzhed pa ltar gsang sngags nang rgyud sde gsum gyi lta ba'i bka' srol la yang legs par snang ste/ kun mkhyen rong zom chen pos theg tshul du gsal bar gsungs te/ dbu ma rang rgyud pas/ snang du 'dra yang don byed dag /nus pa'i phyir dang mi nus phyir/ /zhes bum pa dang /de'i gzugs brnyan gyi chu 'dzin pa'i don byed nus mi nus yod pas kun rdzob yang log tu 'jog pa ni/ chus khyer bas rtswa drungs phyung la 'ju ba ltar mi 'thad tshul rgyas par gsungs te/ rgyal po grags pa mtha' yas dper byas te/ ngo mtshar dang bzhad gad kyi gnas su bshad de/ de nyid las/ chos thams cad don dam par spros pa 24

— gsangarnyingadagongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/thams cad nye bar zhi ste/ bsgrub par bya ba gang yang mi bsgrub par lta bzhin du/ yang dag pa'i kun rdzob kyi mtshan ma nyid spang ba dang blang bar bya ba'i rdzas yod par 'dzin pa 'di ni/ shin tu mi 'tsham pa 'dzin pa ste/ ngo mtshar ba'i gnas yin no/ /zhes dang / 'grel ba phyogs bcu mun sel las/ dpyad na yang dag pa dang / log pa gnyis ka yang snang bar mnyam zhing / gzhigs na don la ma grub mnyam pa pa'i phyir/ 'khor 'das snang srid thams cad da lta nyid nas rnam dbye med par mnyam pa nyid du gnas so/ /zhes byad dang de'i gzugs brnyan rang ngos nas ma grub mnyam pa pas yang log mi 'thad par gsungs so/ /yang 'jig rten shes ngo la ltos te bden rdzun gyi tha snyad 'thob rung lta bu'i yang log gnyis su dbye ba zla ba dang rje btsun tsong kha pa bzhed pa ltar kun mkhyen chen po yang bzhed de / yid bzhin mdzod las/ kun rdzob la tha snyad 'jig rten pas bden rdzun du byed pa dang bstun nas brda' shes pa'i yan lag tu/yang dag kun rdzob dbang bo gnod pa med pa drug gi snang yul du snang ba'i gzuṭa sgra dri ro reg bya dang chos rnams yin la/ log pa'i kun rdzob gnod pas dkrugs pa'i snang ba rab rib dang skra shad la sogs par snang ba ste/ 'jug pa las/ gnod pa med pa'i dbang bo 25

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/drug rnams kyis/ /zhes sogs drangs nas gsungs so/ /'jig rten na bden par grags pa dang / ma grags pa dang sgo bstun nas yang log byed par grub mtha' mdzod las gsungs so/ /8 don dam la yul can gtso bor byas te gnyis snang gi spros pa log ma log gi sgo nas rnam grangs dang rnam grangs ma yin pa'i dbye ba gnyis su rang rgyud pa'i gzhung nas bshad pa ltar rje bdag nyid chen po yang bzhed la/ yang dgag bya'i spros pa rdzogs par khegs ma khegs kyis don dam dngos btags sam rnam grangs dang / rnam grangs ma yin pa'i dbye ba yang phye tshul yod la/ rong zom gyi lta phreng 'grel bar/ spros pa phyogs re re chod pa yin min gyi blo'i yul gyi khyad las rnam grangs yin min dang de yang stong nyid bco brgyad lta bu don dam pa'i rnam grangs kyi tshig gi bstan bya'i cha nas dang po dang /spros pa thams cad zhi ba'i rang bzhin med pa gnyis par gsungs so//kun mkhyen chen pos dgag bya rang bzhin gyis stong ba rnam grangs ma yin pa dang / de rtogs pa'i spros bral gyi mkhyen pa rnam grangs pa'i don dam par bzhed de/ phyogs bcu mun sel las/ don dam blo las 'das pas ngo bo la dbye ba med kyang / blos cung zad dbye na/chos rnams rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis stong ba de ni gshis kyi don dam 26

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/yin te/ mdo las/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha'i khams la 'ga' zhig gis bsngags pa brjod cing / 'ga' zhig gis bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod na gang ba'am bri ba med de/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid don dam pa gcig pu zhi ba'i rang bzhin brjod cing / gzhan yang mu stegs byed kun tu rgyu rnams kyis rtag pa ther zug pa'i chos su bstan yang /yang dag pa'i de bzhin nyid la gnyis su gyur pa med do/ /zhes so/ /rnal 'byor bas don de nyid bsgoms pas spros pa dang bral ba'i blo skyes pa ni rnam grangs pa'i don dam pa zhes bya ste/ skye la sogs pa bkag pa yang / /zhes sogs drangs nas gsungs so/ /des na don dam gyi dbye ba'i gsung sgros cung mi mthun kyang gnad gcig la/ da lta kun mkhyen rong klong gnyis kyi rjes 'jug la/ rang bzhin gyis stong ba don dam btags pa ba dang / kun rdzob mtshan nyid pa sogs su 'dod pa yod na kun mkhyen gnyis kyi gsung 'di dag ma mthong bar snga rabs pa 'ga' re'i grub mtha'i shan shor ba yin no/ /rang bzhin gyis grub pa khegs pa'i stong ba de nyid dgag bya rdzogs par khegs pa'i yul rnam grangs min pa'i don dam yin pa la ni rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po dang / rong zom chen po kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang 27

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/po gsum dgongs pa gcig par yod pas rang bzhin med pa la med mtha'i spros par 'dzin pa'i rnying ma pa ni shin tu yang mi mdzes te/chos dbyings mdzod sogs nges don gyi rdo rje'i do ha rnams la skur ba btab pa'i phyir ro/ /nang ba sangs rgyas pa thams cad kyis zab khyad du brtsi ba'i bdag med pa'i lam chen dor nas/ gsal rig tsam dang yin min yod med sogs gang du yang ngos bzung med pa'i ci yang yid la mi byed pa tsam la snying bor ma 'dzin par mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi gsung rab snga ma rnams kyi gsung sgros ltar bya bar rigs zhes da lta'i rnying ma pa phal cher la gsol ba 'debs so/ /9 de lta bu'i bden gnyis ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad du bzhed pa yang / rje bla ma dang kun mkhyen chen po dgongs pa so sor med de/ theg mchog mdzod kyi rim khang brgyad pa las/ yang snang ngo kun rdzob kyi cha nas lhun grub la/ stong ngo don dam gyi cha nas ka dag tu tshig gis brjod pa tsam las/ de gnyis rdzas tha dad du med pas so sor mi 'gyur te/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad/ bram ze yin pas mi yin la/ sdom ldan yin pas rab tu byung ba yin pa gnyis mi 'gal ba bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /10 don dam dpe'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa la rab rib 28

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/kyis ma bslad pa'i mig gis nam mkhar bltas na ci yang ma mthong ba ltar ji ltar btsal kyang gang du yang ma rnyed pa'i bdag nyid yin pa yang dgongs pa gcig ste/ theg mchog mdzod kyi rim khang bcu dgu bar / de ltar rnam pa du ma'i sgo nas rang gi sems la gcig dang tha dad kyi brgal bas brtags te btsal bas gang yang ma rnyed pa ni chos nyid ka nas dag pa'i don shes rab kyi dbang pos rtogs pa ste/ zhes dang / chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/ gzung 'dzin med pa'i rnal 'byor ngo kha la/ /med la snang 'di ya mtshan rgod po 'chor/ /zhes sogs dang / yid bzhin mdzod kyi le'u bco brgyad pa las/kun rdzob 'di ltar sna tshogs snang ba 'di/ /sgyu ma chu zla sprul ba gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rang bzhin med la snang ba gang yin pa/ /shin tu brtags na gzhi rtsa dngos med pas/ /mkha' 'dra stong zhing mtshan nyid chad pa ste/ /ma brtags nyams dga' sna tshogs sgyu ma bzhin / /bag chags 'khrul ba'i rten 'brel las byung ba/ /ji ltar dha tu ra yi snang ba bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /11 kun rdzob kyi dpe rab rib can gyi skra shad kyi snang ba dang 'dra bar yang dgongs pa gcig ste/ sngar gong du drangs pa rnams kyis kyang shes la/ theg mchog mdzod kyi rim khang nyer gcig par/29

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/phyi snang ba sna tshogs dkar dmar gyi snang ba snod bcud 'byung ba lngas bsdus kyi klong na gsal ba 'di dag /rang sems 'khrul ba'i ngo la snang ba ma gtogs pa phyi don gyi dngos po dang / nang sems kyi dngos po gnyis kur ma grub pas/ gzhi med stong ba'i cho 'phrul med pa gsal snang gi rang bzhin rab rib can gyi skra shad dang / rmi lam sgyu ma'i snang ba dang 'dra bar shes par bya/ zhes so/ /des na kun rdzob kyi chos rnams la med snang stong ba'i gzugs brnyan du snga 'gyur mkhas pa rnams yang yang gsungs pa nyid/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas / rab rib mthu yis skra shad la sogs pa/ /ngo bo log pa gang zhig rnam brtags pa/ /de nyid bdag nyid gang du mig dag pas/ /mthong de de nyid de ni 'dir shes bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang shin tu mthun pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med kyi tshul gyi nges don mthar thug gtan la 'bebs pa ste ha cang 'gangs che'o/ /12 stong ba de nyid gsar du blos byas glo bur ba ma yin par gnyug ma ye grol gyi rang bzhin 'dus ma byas su kun mkhyen chen po bzhed pa ltar/ tha snyad chos skad kyi khyad tsam las don mthun par rje bdag nyid chen po yang bzhed pa ni/ gnas lugs zab mo'i don la skrag gyur nas/ /blos byas nyi tshe'i stong ba mchog 'dzin pa'i/ /30

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/log pa'i lta ngan mtha' dag rab spangs te/ /chos kun gdod nas stong bar rtogs par shog /ces smon lam du gnang ngo / /13 don dam la dpyod pa'i rtags kyi bsgrub bya med dgag tu tshig gsal dang / shes rab sgron ma sogs su gsungs pa bzhin rje bdag nyid chen po yang bzhed la/ spyir na dgag pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid rje rang gi legs bshad rnams su yang yang nan chen pos rgya gzhung rnams drangs te gtan la phab pa ltar gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba yang bzhed de/ rong zom parnyi ta chen pos/ theg chen tshul 'jug tu de la dgag pa ji snyed pa thams cad kyang med par dgag pa dang ma yin par dgag pa gnyis su 'dus so/ /de la med par dgag pa zhes bya ba ni/ yod pa bkag pa tsam yin gyi/ gzhan bsgrub par bya ba'i don med de/ 'di ltar ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtogs pa dang / the tshom za ba tsam sel bar byed pa kun tu brtags pa tsam 'gog par byed pa yin te/ don gzhan ston pa med do/ /dper na bum pa med ces brjod na/ bum pa yod par rtog pa bzlog pa tsam du zad de/ bum pa med pa'i sa phyogs la sogs pa ni ston par mi byed do/ /de bzhin du gang zag med ces brjod na/ gang zag yod par rtog pa tsam bzlog par zad de/ gang zag gis stong ba'i phung bo 31

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/yod par ston par ni mi byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du kun la sbyor ro/ /ma yin par dgag pa gang zhe na/ gzhan bkag nas gzhan ston pa ste/'di ltar bum pa med pa zhes brjod pa ni/ bum pas stong ba'i sa phyogs go bar byed pa bzhin du gang zag med pa zhes brjod na/ gang zag gis stong ba'i phung bo ston par byed pa lta bu'o/ /de lta bus na med par dgag pa ni gzhan gyis grub pa'i mtha' sel ba tsam yin la/ma yin par dgag pa ni de tsam gyis mi chog ste/ rang gi grub pa'i mtha' yang sgrub par byed pa yin no/ /zhes dgag pa gnyis kyis mtshan nyid gsungs pa ni shing rta chen po'i gzhung drangs nas rje bdag nyid chen po gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin yin la/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi gzigs ngo na 'khrul ba'i blos sgro btags pa'i don bkag pa'i stong sang tsam las bsgrub bya gzhan gang yang med pas so so rang rig gi ye shes de'i gzhal bya'i spros bral ni/ gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar gyi dgag bya bkag tsam gyi med dgag kho na yin te/ theg mchog mdzod kyi rim khang brgyad pa las / ka dag dngos po dang mtshan mar ma grub pa'i ldog pa la ltos te / rig pa med/ ma rig pa med/ sangs rgyas med/ sems can med / ces pa nas/ ci yang grub pa dang dmigs su med pa ste/32

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/dgag chos 'ba' zhig gis bsgrub chos dor bar bstan pa ni/ zhes bkra shis mdzes ldan chen po'i rgyud drangs nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dgag bya bkag shul du chos gzhan 'phen mi 'phen gyis dgag pa gnyis kyi rnam dbye byed pa ni/ rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung dang / bod 'dir yang rong klong gnyis dang / 'jam mgon bla ma yab sras dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis bzhed la/ chos rnams kyi gnas lugs ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe yang 'khrul ba'i blos sgro btags pa bkag pa'i cha tsam zhig las gzhan bsgrub tu med pa dang /gal srid yod na spros pa ma chod pa'i skyon yod par yang mkhas pa'i dbang po de dag bzhed pas stong nyid med dgag yin pa la mi mthun pa med do/ /'on kyang deng sang sa rnying gi klog pa ba mang bo zhig /med dgag la skyon du mthong ba ni med dgag gi don ma shes pa ste/don gyi dbang de mngon par mkhyen pas gzigs nas mkhas pa rnams kyang dgag pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid mang du gtan la phab pa 'dra yang / rang gi rjes 'jug la ltos te dgos pa grub ma grub ci rigs yod la/ mkhas pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs mi pham rnam rgyal ba ni nges shes sgron mer chos nyid med dgag tu gsungs so/ /smin gling sku mched gnyis ma yin dgag tu gsungs pa ni stong nyid 33

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rang ldog tsam min par tshul gzhan la dgongs pa ste dpyad bya mang yang yi ges 'jigs nas bzhag go/ /14 nyan rang gis chos nyid de rtogs dgos par zla bas 'jug 'grel sogs su lung rigs mang bos nan tan du gsungs pa ltar rje yab sras bzhed la/ snga 'gyur ba'i rang lugs la thun mong gi bshad srol mkhan chen yab sras kyi lugs ltar mdzad pas ma rtogs pa'i phyogs gsungs kyang / thun min nang rgyud sde gsum gyi nges don gyi lta ba dpal ldan thal 'gyur ba ltar bzhed dgos par kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po bzhed pas nyan rang gis chos kyi bdag med phra mo rtogs pa bzhed dgos par grub la/ gzhan yang mkhas pa'i dbang po rong klong gnyis kyi gsung rab tu gnas lugs rang bzhin med pa'i lta ba med par nyon mongs mi spong ba'i tshul shin tu mang bo gsungs pas kyang 'grub la/ rtogs ma rtogs kyi dbang gis 'khor 'das kyi khyad par dbye dgos par yang mang du bka' bstsal pa ltar yongs su grags pas thun min gyi bshad srol du nyan rang gi stong nyid rtogs par bzhed pa la bston du med do/ /yi ges 'jigs nas rgyas par ma drangs so/ /15 rigs shes kyi dpyad bzod gzhi ma grub par rje bdag 34

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/nyid chen po bzhed la/ snga rabs pa 'ga' re rigs shes kyi rnyed don dang rigs shes kyi dpyad bzod gcig tu 'khrul nas don dam bden pa dpyad bzod du 'dod mkhan yod mod/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos grub mtha' mdzod kyi skabs snga rabs pa'i rjes zlos mdzad kyang / yid bzhin mdzod 'grel pad+ma dkar bor don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid kyi 'phros su dpyad bzod bkag pas rang bzhed rje rin po che dang dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab bo/ /rgyas par ma drangs so/ /16 kun rdzob dngos yul du byed pa'i sems can gyi blo ni 'khrul bar zla ba dang rje btsun tsong kha pa bzhed pa ltar kun mkhyen chen po sogs gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba yang shin tu bzhed de/ grub mtha' mdzod las/ mthong ba rdzun pa blo 'khrul ba ni so so skye bo ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis mig ldong bas/ rab rib dang skra shad 'dzag pa la don du zhen pa ltar/ 'gro ba drug gi gnas dang longs spyod la sogs pa'i bde sdug sna tshogs su snang ba 'khrul ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gzung 'dzin gyi rnam pa rnams dang / sa thob pa'i rjes thob na gzhan dang thun mong du snod bcud la sogs par snang ba'i rnam pa dang / snang tsam dbang bo'i mngon sum dang / me 35

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/la sogs pa dpog pa'i rjes su dpog pa la sogs te blo rim gnyis ni kun rdzob pa'i rnam pa 'jal ba la ltos nas snang la/ de la'ang mig la sogs pa'i dbang po dag pa dang / skyon can gnyis las kun rdzob gnyis su bzhag ste/ zhes gsungs so/ /yang gzhan skye tha snyad du yang mi 'thad tshul 'jug pa rtsa 'grel du gsungs pa ltar rje bla mas gzhan skye 'gog tshul gyi rigs pa'i 'phul mtshams gangs can 'dir sngar yongs su ma grags pa'i shing rta chen po'i rigs lam phra mo'i rnam gzhag mkhas pa yid 'phrog pa'i gnas mang du gsungs la/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer kyang gzhan skye tha snyad du mi bzhed de/ yid bzhin mdzod 'grel gyis rang rgyud 'gog skabs/ de ltar rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gyi snang ba las skye bar snang yang / gzhan kho na las 'dod par mi rigs te/ tha snyad du gzhan las skye ba grub na rang las skye ba yang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bdag skye dang / gzhan skye 'thad mi 'thad 'go mnyam du mdzad do/ /yang grub mtha' mdzod kyi rang rgyud pa'i skabs/ shes bya bden gnyis kyi dbye gzhir bzhag cing —/ don dam dpyod pa'i rtags kyis bsgrub bya med dgag yin par yang gsungs so/ /de bzhin du gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba rnams rang rig kyang mi bzhed pa'i phyogs yin te/ dpal ldan zla ba la 36

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/bshad pa'i chu mgo zhu dgos pa gang zhig /'jug 'grel du rang rig rgyas par bkag pa'i phyir dang / rang rig gis bden dngos ci yang bsgrub tu med pa'i phyir te/ snang tshul ltar bden pa rdul tsam yang khas mi len pa'i phyir dang / tha snyad pa'i rnam gzhag la snang tsam las logs su btags don dang 'jog byed kyi tshad ma zur du 'tshol mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rong klong gnyis zhig pa dngos por bzhed pa'i gsal kha med kyang nges par bzhed de/ zla bas rgyas par bsgrub nga/ rang lugs gang zhig chos thams cad btags tsam du 'jog pa'i lugs la zhig pa dngos por bzhed par gnod byed med cing /bzhed dgos pa'i sgrub byed mang ba'i phyir/ des na zhig pa dngos po la yang than mthong ba ltar mi byed par blo gzu bos khas blang bar bya dgos so/ /spro rgyu mang yang yi ges 'jigs so/ /17 kun rdzob tha snyad pa'i chos rnams ji snyed pa gzigs pa'i rnam mkhyen tshad ma'i gtsos tshad mas bslu med du grub pa yang dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig yin te/ kun mkhyen chen po'i 'grel ba pad dkar du/ shes bya mtha' med pa mkhyen pas thams cad gzigs shing / thugs rje mtha' med pas 'jig rten kun la gzigs pa na yungs 'bru gcig gi go sa na'ang / snod bcud kyi 37

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'jig rten tshad med par snang bas don mdzad cing / zhes pa nas/nam mkha' go sa khab kyi mig tsam na'ang las mthun par bsags pa'i sems can snod bcud kyi 'jig rten grangs med pa snang ba thams cad du ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'jug cing don mdzad pa yin no / /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/18 de ltar gzhi bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag gtan la 'bebs pa la gsar rnying dgongs pa mi mthun pa med la/ khyad par du nges don gyi lta ba mthar thug gi tshul bden gnyis dbyer med kyi chos skad kyis yang yang nan tan du gsungs pa de nyid zla ba'i 'grel chen gsum gyi dgongs pa rje bla mas ṭīka chen gnyis dang / lhag mthong che chung sogs su bkral ba dang tha snyad kyi sgros las dgongs pa'i gtad so shin tu gcig tu 'bab ste/ don dam gtan la 'bebs tshe dgag bya rang ngos nas grub pa bkag pas/ rang rgyud pa ltar kun rdzob rang mtshan pa log na med/ kun rdzob 'jog tshe 'khor 'das kyi rnam gzhag snang tsam btags tsam gyi ming rkyang btags yod du 'jog pa'i phyir dgag bya dngos su khegs pas don dam zur du med pas na bden gnyis dbyer med ces tha snyad du rang rgyud kyi gtan tshig gis yang dag pa'i bsgrub bya sgrub pa'i dbu ma byings las 38

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/kyang phye ste/ zla ba'i dgongs pa thun mong min par bsgrub pa'i phyir/de skad du/ yid bzhin mdzod kyi le'u bco brgyad pa las/ de la dang po gnas lugs shes pa gces/ /theg pa'i dbang gis rnam pa mang na yang / /nges pa'i snying bo bden pa dbyer med de/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod khang yin/ /de yi rang bzhin 'od gsal ye shes te/ /thog ma med nas rang bzhin spros med bdag /nyi mkha' bzhin du lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /rang bzhin rnam dag chen por ye gnas pas/ /snang stong dbyer med grub bsal 'gro 'ong med/ /kun rdzob rnam chad rnam dbye'i yul 'das pas/ /btags pa'i bden gnyis 'das phyir spros kun zhi/ /bden pa dbyer med grub dang ma grub med/ /dbyings las snang stong rang bzhin gnyis med pas/ /bden pa de yang dbyer med ces su brjod/ /ces dang / 'di dag rang bzhin stong ba bdag med pa/ /de nyid de yi gnas lugs yin pa'i phyir/ /don dam zhes bya snang cha kun rdzob ste/ /snang dus nyid nas skye sogs grub med pas/ /rang bzhin de yin bden pa dbyer med do/ /sogs dang / 'di las gzhan du rtog pa log pa'i blo/ /gnas lugs don la rab tu rmongs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /skabs 'dir rigs shes kyis dpyad nas ma rnyed pas med par 39

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'jog pa stong ba phyang chad theg chen spyi sgos las ring ba'i skal med skur 'debs kyi lta bar gsungs shing / rigs shes kyi ma rnyed pa med pa'i don min zhes rang bzhin med pa dang med pa la dngos su tshig gis khyad mi dbye bar rigs shes kyis ma rnyed pa la brten nas rtogs pa'i 'od gsal stong ba'i gnas lugs ni sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyi 'char gzhir ye nas lhun grub tu yod pa'i gzhi lhun grub kyi yon tan gyi cha nas cang med ci med kyi phyang chad min par gsungs te/ de yang dus dang rdul phran sogs su dpyad nas ma rnyed pa ni chos can bden par 'dzin pa zlog pa'i drang don du gsungs mod / 'on kyang rigs shes kyis 'khrul ba'i zhen stangs sun dbyung ba'i don stong nyid du mi bzhed pa ni min te/ sngar drangs pa rnams dang / 'dir yang / 'di ltar snang yang 'khor ba ma grub pas/ /rang bzhin med de dbyings kyi don dam dang / /tha dad so sor dbye ba'i chos med pas/ /'khor 'das dbyer med mnyam pa nyid du bstan/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na drang don du gsungs pa ni rigs shes de'i nges ngo'i gzhal bya tsam de la ltos te spros pa mtha' dag log pa'i don dam min pa'i don no/ /'di dag 'khrul gzhi shin tu che bas zhib tu dpyad dgos te/ pad dkar las/ 'di lta bu'i 40

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/gnas lugs go ba ni deng sang shin tu nyung bar snang ngo / /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /de la rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i zhal snga nas ni/rigs shes kyis ma rnyed pa dang rang bzhin med pa med pa'i don min zhes pa'i gsung gcig gis 'gag thams cad bkrol te/ de lta bu'i 'chad tshul bde ba'i legs bshad kyi zhib tig ni gzhan su la'ang med mod/ gzhi lhun grub kyi yon tan gyis dbye ba yang don du med pa min pa'i don yin pas dgongs pa gcig pa'i tshul shin tu shes dgos la/ 'di dag la spro bya mang yang yi shes 'jigs te/ gzu bor gnas pa'i rnam dpyod dang ldan pa la ni sgo tsam bstan pas chog cing / blun po phyogs ris can la ni ci tsam spros kyang dgos don mi 'grub pas mdor bsdus so/ /theg chen tshul 'jug tu yang bden gnyis dbyer med kyi lta ba la bsngags brjod mdzad cing don kyang 'di kho na ltar gsungs te ma spros so/ /lam bgrod tshul la/ lam gyi ngo bo sku gnyis sgrub byed bden gnyis kyi lam rim gnyis yod pa la dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig yin te/ 'grel ba pad dkar las/ de la kun rdzob kyi bden pa la brten nas thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa nyams su len zhing / shes rab ye shes kyi tshogs la brten nas don dam pa'i ye 41

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/shes 'od gsal ba'i don la sgom par byed do/ /zhes dang / sems gnas tsam dang ci yang yid la mi byed pa sogs bkag mthar/ lam yang dag pa tshogs gnyis su thabs shes su 'brel dgos na/ de med pas bstan pa 'di las phyi rol tu 'gyur ba ste/ byang chub 'dod na de las bzlog dgos par shes pas/ mdo rgyud gzigs la spongs shig ces gdams pa yin no/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /19 lam gcig tsam ma yin par rnam grangs du ma gdul bya'i khams dbang dang bstun nas grangs dang go rim nges pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len dgos pa yang shin tu mthun te/ yid bzhin mdzod las / byis dang rgan bzhin kha zas tha dad las/ /de yi chos kyang rang bzhin tha dad do/ /zhes dang / de nas rim par 'khrid pa'i tshul gyis bshad/ /des ni theg pa'i rim pa shes pa dang / /yon tan gong 'phel 'jigs sngangs skrag pa med/ /nor ba med cing lta spyod zung 'brel 'gyur/ /de ltar ma bshad skyon ni tshad med de/ /gong 'og snga phyi'i rim pa dang bral bas/ /bstan pa'i spyi srol rim pas nyams pa dang / /blo chung sngangs skrag log ltas 'dor ba dang / /go rim mi shes zab mor mi rtogs dang / /'dus byas dge ba khyad du gsod pa dang / /sgro skur rgyur 'gyur rgyu 'bras 'chol ba dang / /blang 42

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/dor mi shes shes bya'i don la rmongs/ /theg chen sems bskyed snying rje spang ba dang / /stong ltas dad ldan ngan 'gror bslus pa dang / /byar med zer nas tha mal lus pa dang / /ma smin 'gro la gsang ba sgrogs pa ste/ /nyes mang ldan phyir theg pa rim gyis bshad/ /ces dang /de'i 'grel ba las/ sna gcig gis chog na sangs rgyas kyis 'di tsam gsungs pa don med pa las de ltar ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /deng sang ni da ltar gyi rig pa ngos zin pas chog mang bo bstan pa la don med ces zer ba mang ste/ des chog na sangs rgyas kyis gzhan bstan mi dgos la/ gcig tu da ltar gyi rig pa de yang thos pa dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor tsam la brten dgos pas/ rang tshig bsal ba la zhugs pa yin no/ /des na blo la dang po dang / bar dang / tha ma'i rim pas gnyen po gang tshe zab pa'i phyir de bstan par gdams pa yin no/ /zhes sogs shin tu mang ngo / /20 nyams su blang ba'i 'bras bu mthar thug sku gnyis kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa la yang mi mthun pa ga la yod de/ yid bzhin mdzod las/ de ltar bsgom pa dag pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin sku dang ye shes te/ /ji ltar nyi zla sprin dang bral ba bzhin / khams kyi sgrib pa kun dang bral bas na/ /byang chub ces bya 43

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/lhun grub yon tan snang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar rang don gtsang bde rtag bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos sku zag med kyi yon tan brgya zhe bzhi sogs legs par thob pa dang lhan cig tu gzhan don sprul sku rnam pa thams cad pa'i bdag nyid du rtsol med du bzhugs pa'i mtshan dpe gsar rdzogs kyis spras pa'i nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs sku ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bzhugs nas sems can gyi don mdzad par bzhed pa yin no/ /slar yang smras pa/ dal 'byor gru bo che 'di thob gyur te/ /gangs ljongs phyogs med bstan pa'i rin chen nor/ /'dod 'jo'i rnam 'phrul gang che ji dga' ru/ /blang du yod pa'i skal bzang rnyed na yang / /yang dag lam la rang gzhan phyogs 'byed dang / /dag dang ma dag kun kyang dag snang khul/ /blo gros mig la ma rig ling tog gis/ /blta ba'i skal ba phrogs rnams snying rje'i gnas/ /kye ma rgyal bstan zab mo nyin mor byed/ /bsod nams mkha' la shar dang 'phrad mod de/ /rnam dpyod mig gis mjal ba'i nus bral la/ /log rtog rab rib snang ba cir yang 'char/ /chos mig rdul bral theg gsum 'phags pa rnams/ /rgya chen gzhan don khur 'khyer nus min las / /spros pas dub pa ngal gso'i zhi dbyings der/ /phyogs med 44

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/dgongs pa ro gcig 'di mthong ngam/ /kye hud zag med zas dang bral ba yi/ /tshur mthong blo yi gzhong stong 'di dag tu/ /rang gzhan phyogs 'dzin rtsod pas 'o brgyal kyang / /skyes mchog rnams ni dgongs klong gcig tu mnal/ /kye ma kyi hud nyon mongs gdon 'di yis / /sgo kun nas ni 'di ltar brlag bzhin du/ /phan pa'i zol gyis snying la gnas bcas pa'i/ /dgra 'di 'joms pa'i skal ba nam zhig 'ong / /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i dgongs zab nam mkha'i khyon/ /gsal byed legs bshad nyi ma 'bum phrag gis/ /lung rigs 'od zer cir yang rtse ba yi/ /dge ldan lugs bzang 'di 'dra su yis 'dor / /sgrub rgyud gser gyi ri bo'i ngos dag tu/ /don gnyis sgrub byed theg dgu'i nor bu'i tshal/ /lhag par rnam gsum yo ga'i khyad nor can/ /snga 'gyur rin chen gling du su mi spro/ /brtse chen thabs kyis bskyod pa'i ye shes gcig /gzhan phan sgyu 'phrul dra bar rol ba las / /gangs ljongs bstan pa'i dpal du snang ba yi/ /rnam gsum sprul ba'i sku la blang dor ci/ /gangs ri'i mu khyud 'dzin pa 'di tsam gyi / /dam chos de 'dzin bcas pa rang lugs su/ /shong ba min na mkha' khyab dkon mchog gsum/ /skyabs yul gcig tu sdud pa kha bshad tsam/ /theg mchog dar so che ba gangs can gyi/ /bstan pa 45

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/kun la dag snang thob mod de/ /bshad tshad yang dag lam du zhen pa yi / /ris med rnam dbye med par gol ba med/ /gzhi la snang stong ya bral ma song bas/ /lam la tshogs gnyis nyams len zung 'brel dang / /'bras bu don gnyis sgrub pa'i phyag rgya 'di/ /yang dag ltar snang 'byed pa'i srang chen yin/ /de dag kun la nyams myong ma skyes kyang ske/ /thos bsam tsam gyi go yul rnam dag 'di/ /yab rje sangs rgyas dngos des bskyangs pa yi/ /bka' drin yin phyir byang chub bar du mchod/ /bdag ni skyes stobs shes rab dang bral zhing / /tshe 'dir sbyang ba'ang shin tu dman pas na/ /'di la log par bshad pa gang mchis kun/ /gsar rnying mkhas pa'i spyan sngar snying nas 'chag /de ltar yang dag lam la dpyad pa yis/ /phyogs med lta grub bshad pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /tshe rabs kun tu chos spong las spangs te/ /rnam dag chos dang 'phrad pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge ldan legs bshad nyi mas mig phyes te/ /gsang chen snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nor bu sogs / /yang dag chos kyi rin thang rtogs pa'i blo/ /'di bzhin sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par shog /'jam pa'i rdo rjes sna tshogs thabs mkhas kyis/ /rab 'byams zhing du zab mo'i 'bel gtam gyis / /nges don bstan pa'i ngang tshul bgro ba'i gral/ /srid pa ma 46

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/stongs bar du thob par shog /de yi tshe yang mgon de'i ye shes kyi/ /sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul ji snyed dang khyad par/ /rang gi bsod nams me tog phog pa yi/ /rigs bdag de yi bran du rtag gyur cig /ces mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa dang / gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba gnyis dgongs bzhed gcig du gyur pa'i tshul cung zad brjod pa dag snang nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i ngo bo 'jam dpal gzhon nu/ 7 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros dpal bzang bo dang / brtse ba'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang 7 blo bzang dpal ldan bstan 'dzin snyan grags dpal bzang bo dang / nus mthu'i rang gzugs gsang ba'i bdag po 7 las rab gling ba rin po che'i zhabs sogs theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang bo'i zhabs pad la gtug pa'i skal ba bzang bo thob pa'i shākya'i btsun pa'i gzugs brnyan/ blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya bas/ rang nyid kyi dad pa dang shes rab phyogs med du 'phel ba'i dgos ched gtsor bzung / rang la legs bshad kyi re ltos 'cha' ba'i skal mnyam gzhan dag 'ga' zhig la'ang phan pa'i bsam pas/ rigs gsum sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul de dag gis byin gyis brlabs te bstan 'gro'i gsos sman du 47

grub pa'i dpal ldan snyan mo ri'i gtsug lag khang gi nye logs ne'u gsing me tog sna tshogs kyis mngon par bkra ba'i skyed mos tshal nas dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i dad pa'i dga' ston la longs spyod bzhin bris pa dge legs 'phel/ dge'o/ /

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/h+phu/ /gsar rnying mkhas pa'i dgongs bzhed gcig tu sgrub pa rigs lam bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin/༄7/ /gang gi blo gros nam mkha'i klong yangs por/ /mkhyen gnyis nyi zla'i 'od zer 'bum brdal bas/ /chos sku'i dgongs pa'i rtsal chen yongs rdzogs pa/ /rje btsun chos rje'i zhabs pad spyi bos mchod / /'di na snga 'gyur theg mchog 'dzin pa yi/ /gsung sgros tha dad gzhi las lta grub cha/ /'gal bar mthong ba'i blo mun sangs pa'i phyir / /yang dag rigs pa'i 'od snang spro bar bya/ /de yang dang po las can rnams/ /theg mchog lta ba 'tshol ba'i tshe/ /nges don dbu ma'i lam rnyed par/ /dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi/ /rigs tshogs gtso bor bsten dgos te/ /rang blo'i stobs kyis mi rnyed cing / /nges don 'grel la klu dbang nyid/ /rgyal ba rang gis lung bstan dang / /bden grub rigs pas khegs phyir ro/ /klu sgrub srol la gnyis snang yang / /dmigs bsal can gyi dgag pa yis/ /rang mtshan legs par bkag phyir dang / /'khor 'das btags tsam la 'jog phyir/ /mdo sgyu sems phyogs lta ba'i tshul/ /dpal ldan zla ba 49

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/grags pa yis/ /ji skad bkral ba kho nar nges/ /(1)thal rang grub mtha'i khyad par nyid/ /rang rgyud gtan tshigs bzhed min dang / /thal 'gyur tsam gyis pha rol po'i/ /bden zhen khegs min bzhed tshul khyad/ /de yang chos can mthun snang nyid/ /yod med dgag bya phra rags kyis/ /phye ba sher sgron tshig gsal gyi/ /brgal brtag dpang du yod phyir 'thad/ /don 'di bsdu na rang mtshan gyi/ khas len yod dang med pas zhes/ /kun mkhyen chos rje la sogs pas/ /gsungs te gnad gcig yin phyir ro/ /(2)zab mo'i gnas lugs mthar gtugs na/ /rdzas dang rang mtshan phra mo yang / /med de rigs pa gsum dang ni/ /lung 'gal gcig dang bzhis gnod phyir/ /de yang 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag nyid/ /dngos po'i 'jig rgyur thal phyir dang —/ /kun rdzob rigs pas dpyad bzod dang / /bden skye khegs pa min phyir dang / /'od srungs kyis ni zhus pa las/ /stong ba nyid kyis chos rnams kun/ /stong bar mi byed ces sogs kyi/ /lung 'gal 'grel bas bskang phyir ro/ /(3)'on kyang snang phyogs gal che ste/ /'khor 'das spang blang sa lam 'gros/ /rlabs chen gzhan phan spyod pa sogs/ /ye shes tshogs dang stobs mtshungs na/ /yul gyi steng nas ma rnyed phyin/ /gang du de dag 'jog pa'i gzhi/ /nges shes rnyed pa'i 50

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/sgo dka' phyir/ /zab mo'i lta ba dka' bar gsungs/ /(4snang phyogs de yang sgra rtog gis/ /phar btags tsam pa ches 'thad de/ /btags don ji ltar btsal na yang / /phar btags tsam las mi rnyed phyir/ /'di ni mdo rgyud phal cher las/ /yang dang yang du gsung phyir dang / /tha snyad tsam du yod pa'i don/ /yin phyir nges par khas len 'tshal/ /gnubs kyi slob dpon chen mo yang / /chos rnams ming gis btags tsam pa/ /yin kyang ri bong rwa ltar du/ /thal ba min nga/'i rtsod spong gi/ /zab don chos kyi bdud rtsi che/ /mdo 'grel bum pas sbreng ba'i rgyun/ /blo gros ljags steng longs shig ces/ /snga 'gyur rjes 'jug rnams la sgron/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rtsa rgyud kyi/ /yi ge'i 'khor lo bkod pa yang / /don 'di'i steng nas nges dgos zhes/ /snga 'gyur mkhas pas bzhed la gzigs/ /(5)gnas lugs yin na khyod 'jal ba'i/ /mngon sum khyod la 'khrul ba 'gal/ /snang tshul rdzun pa 'jog byed la/ /so skye'i ma 'khrul ba 'gal phyir/ /bden gnyis ma 'khrul 'khrul ba'i blos/ /rnam par bzhag pa ches 'thad de//'di ni dpal ldan thal 'gyur ba'i/ /ring lugs bla na med pa'o/ /(6)gang zhig bslu dang mi bslu ba/ /rnam bcad yongs gcod kyis 'gal ba/ /de phyir bden dang rdzun pa la/ /phung gsum srid pa min 51

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa'i phyir/ /bden pa gnyis su grangs nges la/ /tshogs gnyis mdzod khang dbye ba'i ched/ /sa rnams bden pa gnyis kyi sgos/ /dbye ba theg mchog dbu ma'i srol/ /(7)kun rdzob la ni byad bzhin dang / /ngo yi gzugs brnyan gnyis po la/ /btags don mi rnyed mnyam pa'i phyir / /yul steng yang log mi 'thad pa/ /rong klong mgrin gcig gsung bzhin 'thad/ /'on kyang 'jig rten shes ngo la/ /ltos te rta dang sgyu ma'i rtar/ /bden 'dzin tsam zhig dbyer yod ces/ /snga phyi'i mkhas rnams bzhed mod de/ /kun rdzob yin pa'i yang dag pa/ /med phyir kun rdzob yang log nyid/ /dbu ma ring lugs la med 'thad/ /(8)don dam rnam grangs yin min gnyis/ /snang ngo'i spros pa chod min gyis/ /slar yang dngos btags gnyis phye ba/ /rtog ge 'bar ba sogs kyi gtam/ /skye 'phags don dam 'jal ba'i khyad/ /yod phyir shing rta chen mo'i gsung / /rnam pa kun tu 'thad ldan te/ /skabs 'dir sbyor ba nor ro lo/ /rang rgyud gzhung nas bshad snyam tsam/ /ma nges rtags kyi mthar thug dang / /rgyu mtshan gzhan yang bral bas dor / /blo 'das gtam gyi rnga bo che/ /lung rigs dbyug gus brdung bzhed na/ /rnam grangs rnam grangs min pa yi/ /don dam 'jal tshul mkhyen 'tshal lo/ /(9)bden gnyis gcig dang tha dad kyang / /gang 52

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/yang min na yod pa 'gal/ /yod kyang gcig dang du ma dag /gang rung min na gtan tshigs 'bud/ /de phyir ngo bo gcig pa dang / /ldog pa tha dad yin pa'i tshul/ /kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyis/ /bzhed 'dir blo gros spyan phyes shig /rang rgyud gzhung nas bshad pas na/ /thal 'gyur lugs la mi 'thad cing / /dge ldan mkhas pas bsgrags pas na/ /snga 'gyur ring lugs min snyam na/ /mgo la zhwa mo gyon pa yang / /de dag gis ni mdzad pas na/ /rkang la mnab pa ring lugs su/ /byas na legs pa ma yin nam/ /de phyir gong 'og kun tu yang / /rigs pas gnod min mi dpyod par/ /ha cang phyogs ris che drags na/ /'jig rten lugs las brgal bar 'gyur/ /(10)don dam dpe yi mtshon pa na/ /rab rib nad dang bral ba yis / /skra shad ma mthong ba ji ltar/ /dbu ma 'jug pa las gsungs te / /chags sdang zug rngu ldang ba yi/ /dmigs pa'i dug de lhag med du / /gzhil ba'i ma 'khrul gnyug ma dang / /'di 'dra kho na dgos phyir dang / /rang bzhin med kyang phar btags la/ /kun byang blang dor 'thad pa yi/ /bden gnyis dbyer med mthar thug tshul/ /klan ka bral ba rnam phyes te/ /dpal ldan thal 'gyur ba yi lugs/ /grub mtha' kun gyi rtse mo ru/ /gsar rnying mkhas pa 'bum bzhed kyi/ /rgyu 53

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mtshan rtsa ba 'di min nam/ /(11)des na kun rdzob mtshon dpe yang ske/ /rdzun pa kho na yin pa'i tshul/ /rab rib can gyi skra shad kyi/ /snang bas mtshon te zab khyad che/ /(12)de 'dra'i stong ba nyid kyi tshul / /gnas lugs yin phyir blos byas min/ /kun kyang 'dra phyir nyi tshe ci/ /kun khyab gdod ma'i gnas lugs lags/ /(13)stong nyid de yi ngo bo yang / /'khrul ba'i zhen stangs dbyung tsam la/ /'jog phyir med dgag tu 'thad de/ /dgag bya bkag tsam med dgag phyir/ /'khrul blo sun phyung tsam gyi chas/ /mi tshim yongs gcod bzang zhen can/ /de la 'khrul ba spangs pa yis/ /mi chog bya ba gzhan yod 'gyur/ /yang na 'khrul ba spong ba yang / /zhes yul bkag pas ma yin par/ /'khrul blo rang gi ngo bo'i sgos/ /tsher ma dbyung bzhin spong dgos 'gyur/ /med dang med dgag ma nor phyin/ /stong nyid med dgag yin pa la/ /rigs pas gnod pa 'ga' med de//thal rang gzhung gis dngos zin lags/ /(14chos nyid 'di ni nyan rang gis/ /rtogs par 'jug pa rang 'grel du/ /rigs pa gsum dang lung bdun gyis/ /bsgrub phyir 'dir ni ngal mi dgos/ /'khor rtsa legs par ngos zin na/ /'khor ba spangs pa'i dgra bcom rnams / /don 'di rtogs pa zhar byung du/ /'grub phyir rtsod pa'i 54

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/tshegs kyis ci/ /(15)btags don btsal na mi rnyed phyir/ /rigs nga sa dpyad bzod med pa dang / /ma bzod tsa na stong ba'i dngos/ /dpyod byed rig pas rnyed pa'i phyir/ /dpyad bzod med dang dpyod rigs kyis/ /rnyed don rnam kun mi mtshungs pa'i/ /rigs lam sngon med 'dab brgya ba/ /gang gi gzhung lugs skyed tshal du/ /blo gros mig gi dga' ston du/ /rnam par bstar ba'i legs bshad cha/ /'jam dbyangs thugs kyi rdzing bu las/ /'khrungs par nges so blo ldan dag /(16)kun rdzob 'jal ba'i sems can blo/ /gang snang bden par snang bas na/ /gnyis snang bag chags kyis bslad phyir/ /'khrul ba kho nar nges pa yin/ /'khrul med gnyug ma'i btsan sa ni/ /gsal stong tsam la mi zer bar/ /bden par snang ba mi bden pa'i/ /bden pa'i gshis 'di rtogs par 'tshal/ /de lta lags na gnyis snang gis/ /ma bslad dngos smra'i rang rig kyang / /skabs 'dir 'os pa ma yin pa'i/ /tshul 'di rnam dpyod khur du bzhes/ /btags pa tsam la 'khor 'das kun/ /'thad na blang dor bya ba'i gzhir/ /gtsor gyur shes pa'i rdzas bsgrub pa'i/ /rang rig cho ga 'o brgyal yin / /ma brtags lhan skyes blo ngo nas/ /'jog pa'i tha snyad bden pa la/ /brtags nas rang rig gzhan rig tshul/ /'gal phyir rang 55

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rig 'thad pa min/ /rang rig med kyang dran pa'i tshul/ /'thad pa'i rtsod spong 'dir gzigs dang / /don dam tsam du bkag min pa/ /blo dang ldan na shes par sla/ /zhig pa dngos po'i tshul 'di yang / /snga 'gyur gzhung du mi gsal kyang / /snga 'gyur mkhas pas bzhed dgongs de/ /dpal ldan zla bas bsgrubs phyir ro/ /zhig pa dngos por mi rung bas/ /grub mtha' 'og ma'i gtad so yang / /zhig pa'i btags don dngos po'i cha/ /ma rnyed pa la thug med de/ /zhig rgyu'i bum pa'i mtshan gzhi yang / /gdags gzhi'i gseb nas ma rnyed bzhin / /dngos po kho nar 'jog chog na/ /zhig par mi chog rgyu mtshan ci/ /kun gzhi thob pa la sogs pa'i/ /rnam gzhag dngos smras sgro btags pa/ /mi dgos lugs 'dir las 'bras sogs/ /'thad par gsungs pa mtha' chod na/ /zhig pas rang 'bras bskyed chog pa//de las gzhan du 'os med de/ /rigs pa mi shes pa 'ga' zhig /zhig pas bskyed na las min lo/ /zhig rgyu'i las zhig ma grub par/ /zhig pa rnyed na chog go lo/ /zhig par gang zhig zhig pa dang / /zhig pa'i ngo bo gnyis med dam/ /las de zhig pa'i brda tsam yang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas shar ba la/ /zhig pa dngos po'i grub mtha'i gsang / /shes par dka' 'o blo gsar rnams/ /zhig pas nam mkha' gang ba 56

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/yi / /thal 'gyur mtshon yang bzhad gad gzhi/ /zhig rgyu'i 'dus byas mkha' gang na/ /de zhig mkha' gang thal 'gyur ci/ /gal te gang na shong mi shong / /dogs pa min na gnod pa ci/ /yin na dngos po tsam ma zad/ /zhig pa bem por thal lo kye/ /blo la gang shar bem po'i spyir / /shar ba'i lhan skyes rags pa 'di/ /grangs can gzhung na'ang yod med ces/ /kho bo'i blo gros som nyir gyur/ /rang bzhin med bzhin las zhig pas/ /rang 'bras 'byin 'di las 'bras la /nges shes 'og mar thun mong min/ /'drongs tshul mkhyen te gces spras 'tshal / /ldog pa gcig pu'i dpung 'phul gyis/ /gzhan skye 'gog pa'i u thug sogs/ /gzhung gi mtha' ma chod pa'i gtam/ /re zhig bzhag na mi legs sam/ /sa myug rang ngos nas gzhan na/ /ltos med thal ba bzlog pa med/ /ltos med rgyu 'bras su 'gyur na/ /me las mun 'byung rigs pas 'phul/ /(17)chos kun rang ngos nas med kyang / /ming gi tha snyad tsam du ni/ /'thad ldan lags na tha snyad chos /kun mkhyen tshad mas cis mi 'grub/ /rang gi ngos nas med pa 'di/ /gtan nas med par song ba yi/ /blo gros shed ma phye ba'i gtam/ /kye ma mkhas par grags pa'ang 'dzer/ /snang tshul ma rig bag chags kyis/ /bslad pa'i rdzun snang 'khrul ba dang / /snang tsam 57

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/cha la gnod pa gzhan/ /med phyir tshad grub 'gal ba med/ /tha snyad du ni tshad ma yis/ /grub dang ma grub tha snyad kyi/ /blo la ltos phyir gnyis dbye bar/ /tha snyad blo yis gnod pa med/ /don dam par ni tha snyad chos/ /tshad mas grub pa mi srid kyang / /don dam la ni ltos nas su/ /bzhag pa min phyir 'gal ba med/ /tha snyad du yang 'khrul ba dang / /tha snyad la ni ltos nas ni/ /ma 'khrul ba gnyis mi gcig phyir / /tha snyad tshad grub gnod med grub/ /de ltar bden gnyis mgo phyes na/ /sha ba'i rwa ltar 'gyur ro lo/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang bden pa gnyis/ /phye ste gsungs par klu dbang bzhed/ /(18)don 'di kun la gsar rnying su yang rung / /dpal ldan zla ba'i rjes su 'brangs rlom zhing / /thal 'gyur lta ba 'dzin par khas 'che phyin/ /lam 'di kho nar rigs pa'i mtshon brgyas phye/ /rigs lam nyi 'od bdal yang mi mthong ba'i/ /log rtog mun khrod rgyu ba'i gser mig can / /mchis na 'gal ba'i dung sgra sgrogs shig dang / /slar yang rigs pa'i zhugs phreng sbar ro kye/ /grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i blo gros rim pas ni/ /zab khyad za 'og ri mo ltar bkra dang / /mthar thug chags snang zug rngu slong ba yi/ /dmigs nga/'i dug 'jil rigs sngags la babs dang / /thal rang dgag bya'i tshad la phra rags 58

gsang rnying dgongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/mtshams / /ma 'dres dbye ba'i blo gros mig med na/ /shes rab zab mo'i de nyid mi mthong bas/ /gzhung lugs kun la zhib dpyod gnad du che/ /dpyad tshul de yang shing rta chen po'i gzhung / /spyi dang bye brag zla ba'i 'grel chen sogs/ /gzhung gi tshig dang don la 'khri dgos kyis / /rang blor shar tshod smras pas ga la 'ong / /rigs lam drang bo'i them skas la 'dzegs te/ /nges don chos kyi khang bzang yangs nga/ ru/ /thub pa'i gsung rab dga' ston myong ba yi/ /rnam dpyod ldan de skyid dgu'i mthil du sleb/ /thob bya sku gnyis 'thob dgos pas/ /thob byed zab dang rgya che'i lam/ /ya bral tsam res mi 'ong phyir/ /bden gnyis lam rim gnyis su nges/ /(19)de yang mgon po byams pa'i man ngag bzhin/ /ngo bo grangs dang go rim nges pa yi/ /rnam grangs du ma skyes bu gsum gyi lam/ /nyams su len pa a ti sha yi srol/ /de 'dra de la theg mchog mdo rgyud kyi/ /chos kyi zab gnad mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /nyams len snying bo mar gyi nying khu bzhin/ /legs par btung de sgrub pa'i mchod pa'i phul/ /(20)de ltar nyams su blangs pa la/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis po/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i lam 'bras 'brel/ /bde blag nyid du 'grub pa yin/ /de skad drang bor gsol ba'i rigs lam chab/ /skal bzang lha brgyar bdud 59

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rtsir 'gyur na yang / /log rtog las sgrib tshan che'i pre ta kur/ /chos kyi lus zungs gso ba'i zas 'gyur dka'/ /'on kyang rang gi blo gros zla tshes cha/ /phyi phyir 'phel ba'i slad dang dpyod ldan 'gas/ /gsung ngor rigs lam drang thig 'di btab ste/ /ma rtogs blo yi ya yo bcad pa'i dges/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang zab mo lta ba'i srol/ /klu sgrub lugs bzang phyogs kyi mthar khyab ste/ /mthar 'dzin nad kyis gdung ba'i 'gro ba kun/ /sher phyin sman gyis rtag tu gso bar shog /deng nas skye ba'i phreng ba thams cad du'ang / /rigs pa'i ral gris log rtog 'khyog gcod pa'i/ /gur kum mdog can shes rab 'khor lo'i lhas/ /dgyes 'dzum spyan gyis bdag la g.yo gyur cig /de las blo gros rdzing ring ches 'phyur te/ /zab don lta ba'i nor bu 'bum phrag tshogs/ /rgyal bstan dpyid du phyur bur spung ba yis/ /skal bzang dga' ba'i dus ston dar bar shog /ces yang dag pa'i rigs pas gsar rnying gi mkhas pa'i bzhed phugs thal 'gyur gyi lugs srol gcig tu sgrub pa'i rab tu byed pa rigs lam bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs shing bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba'i phyag bzhes dngos gtsang gis thub bstan rin po che'i srog shing 60

wa gsangarnyingadagongs pa gcig sgrub bzhugs/du gyur pa lcang ma'i sgar gyi rnam dpyod ldan pa bla ma rgya mtsho nas 'di ltar gyis shig pa'i gsung phebs don rim 'gyangs su song yang nye char dpal yul dar thang gi slob dpon 'dul ba 'dzin pa 'jigs med dkon mchog nas sngar gyi lung sbyor de tsam gyis mi 'grub pa'i gsung phebs par brten/ rang dang skal mnyam gzhan gyi yang blo gros 'phel ba'i sgor dmigs te/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos rje btsun dam pa 7 mkha' klong yangs pa rtsal gyi zhabs pad spyi bos len pa'i shākya'i dge sbyong gi gzugs brnyan 'jam mgon bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros tshangs sras snyems pa'i sde zhes bya bas/ dpal ldan snyan mo ri'i gtsug lag khang dang nye ba'i gnas mkha' spyod ge'u tshang du bris pa dge bar gyur cig/'di yang rgyal bstan rin po che'i zhabs 'dregs su gyur cig /dza yan+tu / / //
smespra nya

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄sto /gangs can sgrub brgyud sngon byung rnams kyi chos kyi babs la mnyam par bzhag pa/༄tsho/ /re zhig dhīḥrdzong phug pa'i zhol du gso rig mkhan po'i zhabs bcar slad du zhag shas bsdad par sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi gdams ngag phyogs bsdus kyi chos mdzod chen mo zhal phyes te gangs can gyi sgrub brgyud sngon byung rnams kyi chos kyi babs la cung zad mnyam par bzhag pa la chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros kyi 'char sgo 'di ltar byung ste/ gangs can 'dir bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gnyis/ snga dar la thun mong du mgon po klu sgrub kyi bka' srol rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma'i lugs kyi theg pa chen po'i lta spyod dang / thun mong min par mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi zab chos skal ldan rnams la lkog chos su bstsal pa'i srol gnyis dang / phyi dar la bla chen po dgongs pa rab gsal las dbus gtsang gi mi bcus chos 'dul ba'i phyag bzhes sogs legs par tshugs pa tsam na/ rgya gar gyi parnyi ta chen po dī baṃ kā ra shrī dzñā na lha bla ma khu dngon gyis gdan drangs pa la/ spyan ras gzigs 'brom rje'i rnam par phebs pas gdams ngag gi mdzod chen po blangs te bka' gdams kyi pha 64

sgrub brgyud sngon byung rnams kyi chos babs/mdzad pa nas lo sum brgya lhag tsam na/ rje btsun 'jam dpal snying bos bstan pa'i byi dor dngos gtsang mdzad pa phyis kyi bka' gdams bcas bka' gdams gsar rnying ngam snga phyi gnyis byung ba ni / bka' sde snod gsum nyams len gyi mthil du 'dzin pa so skye'i sa nas rdzogs byang gi bar go rim can du bgrod pa'i lugs kyis gang zag spyi dang bstan pa spyi'i dbang du byas pa/ khe che la nyen med pa/gegs dang gol sa bral zhing 'jug bde bde lta bu zhig gda' ba ni/shing rta chen po rnams kyis thub pa'i dgongs pa ji ltar bkral ba'i gzhung chen mo rnams kyi dngos zin la bsgyur bkod spu tsam ma song bar de dag ji lta ba bzhin du bkri ba'i tshul te/ 'di ni gdul bya spyi la shes pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs rmad po che ste gang zag mchog dman thams cad kyis nyams len gyi gnad ma lus sam mngon par rtogs pa'i bgrod lugs kyi 'gros 'di las dpags te shes dgos pas/ ma phyi bla na med pa zhig yin pa 'di stor mi rung bar mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs pa la lhag par myong rgyu lta bu zhig byung / de nas rim gyis dpal nā ro ta ba chen po ming sring gnyis las / mar ba chos kyi blo gros dang / khyung bo dzo ki gnyis kyis gsang sngags bla med kyi bka' srol chen po gnyis blangs te nyams bzhes 65

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mdzad pa las grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por phebs te skal ldan mang bo zhig rjes su bzung nas rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi sgo 'phar chen po phyes pa las rim pas brgyud de/ dwags shing gi bka' brgyud rin po che gnyis kyi bstan pa'i chu bo gangs can pa'i bsod nams kyi gshong bur 'khyil ba dang / de'i phyis tsam na 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis grub chen ga ya dha ra sogs la gtugs te/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birlu pa'i bka' srol lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i chos skor blangs te rim gyis 'phel ba'i gtso bo dpal brtse ba chen po nas rgya cher dar ba dpal ldan sa skya ba'i ring lugs dang / de las khyad par phye ba ngor rdzong tshar gsum gyi brgyud srol rnams dang / zhi byed kyang yod/dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gtso bor 'don pa'i kun mkhyen jo mo nang ba sogs sgrub brgyud mang bo zhig phebs pa rnams ni phal che ba gang zag bye brag pa sbyangs pa'i 'phro can dbang bo rab tu gyur pa rnams kyi chos skal gtso bor byas shing / khyad par du gsang sngags nyid la rtsal du 'don / gsang sngags bla med kyi nang nas kyang gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gi sgo btod lugs da lta'i sems 'di'i steng du dpe dang gtan tshigs kyi spros pa mi rgyas par car phog tu ngo sprod de skyong 66

sgrub brgyud sngon byung rnams kyi chos babs/tshul slob dpon dang slob ma lta dgongs mthon po'i dbang du byas pa shas che ste/ de yang rgya gar sogs na grub chen so so'i skal ldan rjes su 'dzin tshul sna tshogs yod pa dang sgo bstun pa'i grub thob brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes shig ste/ 'di ni sngar sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe gdul bya rnams smin pa gsum shas che/ sgrib pa gsum shas chung gsungs shing kun shes sogs la rtogs pa skye myur ba ltar skye ba du mar rjes su bzung nas chos kyi bag chags mthu can du byas pa'i rang rang gi gdul bya'i zhing la thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa 'jug tshul bye brag cig tu gda'/ de yang dwags po lha rje bzhugs pa'i sgam po'i ri mthong bas sgom skyes pa sogs yod pa dang / me tog zla mdzes sogs nas brtsams byang chub sems dpa'i rnam pas 'gro don chen po grub pa'i bdag nyid chen po'i rnam thar gyis mtshon nus shing /gzhan yang de ltar yin pas rgyal ba sras bcas kyi 'gro don mdzad lugs 'di gcig tu nges pa zhig min par gda' bas shes/ dpal sa skya ba ni bshad sgrub gnyis ka rgyas shing snang gsum gyi skabs su ma dag pa dang nyams kyi snang ba'i nyams len rgyas pa dang / dwags po rin po che'i bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres mdzad pa 'di dag de tsam kho nas mi 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan kyis yin gda'/ jo nang ba'i rdo rje'i 67

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rnal 'byor ni dbang rnon la ltos te gnas lugs rang stong du go nus shing / gzhan stong la brten nas don gyi 'od gsal sogs sngags kyi skabs kyi spang bya kun rtog las grol ba'i lhan skyes kyi ye shes skyed pa'i tshul dang / dbang rtul la ltos te re zhig dkri ba'i ldem dgongs kyi tshul gyi lta bas khyad par du byas pa zhig gda'/ mdor na 'di ltar shes dgos te bka' bstan bcos kho na dang bstun te nyams len gyi gzhung lugs chen mo rnams rtsal du 'don pa zhig dang / grub thob chen po rnams kyi skabs su bab pa'i skal ldan bkri ba'i thabs mkhas kyi rdo rje'i gsung gi ngo sprod rtsal du 'don pa/'i lugs shig ste/bshad brgyud dang / sgrub brgyud gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' srol gnyis yod/ snga ma dang phyi ma gnyis kyi lugs kyi lta ba'i ngo sprod 'debs lugs kyang mi 'dra ste/ snga mas ni gzhung nas 'byung ba'i gtan tshigs chen po rnams kyis ngo sprod mdzad la/ phyi mas ni sems kyi ngo bo la thad kur bltas pas byung gnas 'gro gsum sogs gang yang ma mthong ba'i mthong med nyid mthong ba dam par ngo sprad de gnas lugs kyi lta ba 'bog /phyi ma 'di chos dang gang zag ma 'dzol ba zhig min pa gol sa yin/ sgrub brgyud 'di dag gi lhag mthong yang phyag rgya chen po zhes 'od gsal lhan skyes kyi rig pa yul dang yul 68

— sgrubabargyudasngon byung rnams kyi chos babs/can mi phye bar gtso bor yu la can gyi ldog pa nas ngo sprod/ bstan pa snga dar gyi yang bshad brgyud sgru ba brgyud 'di ltar shes dgos/ snga 'gyur ba'i rig pa rang snang gi don yang yul log nas go rim bzhin btan 'bebs mi dgos par 'od gsal gyi rig nga/'i ngo sprod nyid kyis rang snang tsam du rtogs goms klong gyur gyi gang zas la de'i blo can zer ba 'dra/ snga ma 'dis gsang sngags kyi skabs kyang lhan skyes kyi rig pa rtsa rlung thig ler gnad du bsnun pa rang gis ngo sprod pa las bzhag thabs sogs rtsal du mi 'don pa yin/ de ltar na mes kyi gnam ru brdung du mi btub pa ltar dang / drang srong mar ta'i bum pa bzhin du sgrub brgyud nyid kyi lam gnad zin pa dkon pa'i skabs su bstan pa spyi'i dbang du byas pa'i nyams len gyi khog phub nyi ma brgya las gsal ba'i dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i ring lugs ngo mtshar brgya ldan 'di/ ring mo zhig nas dam chos spel ba'i thugs bskyed rlabs po che'i mthu grub pa'i smon lam dus su sad de bdag nyid chen po tsong kha pa zhes snyan grags kyi dbyar rnga srid pa gsum gyi khongs su ldir ba de nyid kyis legs par drangs nas da lta bsod nams kyi skal ba ches sbom por gyur pa 'di lags/ bshad sgrub gnyis ka dang / sgrub brgyud kho na rtsal du 'don phyogs kyi khyad 69
