sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rdzogs pa chen po rang snang ris med kyi dgongs pa zer ba 'dra la 'di dag shin tu spros med kyi lam bsgrod lugs yin no/ /de ltar na sa brgyad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang rgyal ba rnams kyis rjes thob tu bsod nams kyi tshogs la bskul dgos kyang / skabs 'di dag tu sngags kyi thabs mkhas kyi gnad chen pos zin pas thabs shes kyi rtogs rigs thams cad 'od gsal gyi rig pa skad cig ma gcig la rdzogs pas rig pa rkyang 'ded kyi lam du gdams pa'i mgon po sras dang bcas pas bsngags pa lags so/ /chos mchog rdzogs pa chen po 'di nyid kyi lam khregs chod kyi gnad mi 'phyug pa'i gzer bu 'di ltar btab nas/ rdzogs chen gyi rgyud sde rang gi bshad sgros thun mong min pa gzhi las gzhi snang bzhed tshul dang / bar do drug gi rnam bzhag /khregs chod kyi cog bzhag bzhi dang / grol tshul gsum / thod rgal gyi sgron ma bzhi dang / snang ba bzhi sogs bcu bdun rgyud kyi don 'grel chen mo theg mchog mdzod las zhib tu shes dgos su snang bas bla ma'i gsung ltar blta rtogs gal che zhes rang la bskul lo/ /de ltar rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gshegs shul rmad du byung ba de la kho bo ni dad pa'i me tog de ltar du 'thor gyin sdod pa lags so/ /kun bzang bzhad pa'i rdo rjes rang gi brjed 342

phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi lta ba'i dris lan/byang du bris pa'o/ /༄7/ /rig pa dang byang chub kyi sems sogs chos sku ye rdzogs kyi chos nyid 'dus ma byas pa la go rgyu yin pa 'di bla ma gter chen gsungs pa bzhin shin tu 'thad par go ste/ thun mong gi tha snyad 'di ga rten 'brel gyi babs las byed rtsol can gyi theg pa'i rang 'gros bzhin byed sgrub gtso cher mdzad kyang thun mong min pa a ti rtsol med kyi lam 'dir mthar thug gi skyel so'i ldog pa nas las sgrub mdzad de mthar thug kho na gtso bor 'don pa'i che khyad 'di bzhin yod pa mkhyen 'tshal lo/ /dmar ho'i 'char sgo bla ma'i gsung rjes dran gyi tshul lo/ /dge'o/ /de skad du 'grel ba lung gter las/ rig ma rig las 'das pas rig pa tsam du'ang gdags su med pa 'di ni/mtha' bral yongs su rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya ste/ mtshon tshig gi tha snyad rang byung ba'i ye shes dang / byang chub kyi sems dang / chos sku dang / dbyings lhun grub chen po dang / rig pa rang gsal rjen pa zhes brjod kyang / brda shes pa'i phyir btags pa tsam las rang ngo brjod med chen por rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ yang / phyi sna tshogs pa 'di dag 'khrul snang gzhi med yod ma myong ba'i stong bde dang —/ sems nyid stong ba gnyis la tha dad du byar med pa tsam/ kho 343

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bo cag phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ro gcig byang chub kyi sems zhes chos nyid kyi cha la dbye bsal med pa brjod kyang snang tsam tha snyad nga/ rnams dang rang sems gcig tu mi 'dod de/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byung gnas 'gro gsum 'tshol lugs 'di la/ thun mong ba sems kyi skye 'gags gnas gsum bden pas stong lugs shig dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyug ma'i rig pa las glo bur du mched pa'i 'khrul rtog gi byung tshul gzhi med rtsa bral du go dgos pa gnyis yod snyam/༄༄/ /byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pas zin pa'i stong nyid kyi lta ba de nyid/ spang bya gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i kun rtog gi rum nas 'bras kyi shun pa brdol ba ltar gyen du 'phags pa'i sgo nas 'od gsal gyi rig pa'i ngo bor skyes te kho lag yongs su rdzogs pa mthar thug pa ni mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin la / de la lhag mthong gi dpyad pa mtha' med du spro ba'i steng nas kun rtog rags rim nas phal mo che zhig bcad de gdod shin tu phra ba'i lhag ma lam gzhan gyi byed pas gcod pa zhig dang / kun rtog rang gi 'gro 'ong gi bzhon pa'i rlung rnams btsan thabs su bsdus te rnam par mi rtog pa'i sems phra mo bag la nyal du yod pa bslang nas 344

phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi lta ba'i dris lan/de'i ngo bor sngar gyi lta ba'i rgyun bskyed de spang bya la gnod pa bsgrub nas myur lam gyi gnad 'dzin pa zhig dang / 'di dbang po'i khyad par 'ga' res kun rtog rang gi ngo bo rang las mi gzhan pa'i gnas lugs su gcun te sems la gnad du bsnun nas rnyog chu bzhag pas dwangs pa ltar je phrar btang ste gnyis snang gi rtog pa'i sbub las sngar gyi rtogs pa nar son nas mtha' med du 'phel ba'i tshul gcig dang gsum yod pa rnams ni/ blo gros rgyas par byed pa'i srog tu bzung ste theg pa gong 'og gi rnam bzhag byed dgos pa lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs las thon pa'i gsang ba'i tshig yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal pos kyang do zla med pa'i snying nor zab mo ste re zhig tsho /kun rtog gcod ces pa yang rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i blo gdeng gyen du bskyod de je zab tu song gyin bden 'dzin dang / ma zad bden pa'i gnyis snang can gyi blo bag chags gsog pa'i tshe sems kyi khams la gnod pa chen por rgyur nas kun rtog gnyis snang gi sgrib pa je zhan du song ba las/ lhan skyes kyi rig pa rjen par bud ba'i 'od gsal rtogs pa'i mdangs rang snang sku gsum gyi rgyan du rdzogs par byed pa'i sngags kyi tshul 'di ni ka lhun zung gi khregs thod kyi lam gyi babs gzhan dang ma bsres pa ste/ phar 345

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/phyin theg pa ltar gyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag mthong grangs med gsum du spel ba'i ye shes kyi nus pa dang / dus kyi yun de lta bu la ltos te skad cig ma tsam gyi tshod du bde blag tu 'dum pa ni/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i myur lam gyi gnad 'dzin lugs yin la de yang rtsa rlung thig le'i byed pa la brten nas sems kyi bzhon pa'i rlung bsdus pa las kun rtog gi sgrib pa btsan thabs su gcod pa ma yin par / sems nyid stong ba'i rang mal dang po'i 'byung khungs der kun rtog gi sgrib pa lan tshwa chur bzhu ba ltar dmigs med du bzhag pa'i rang grol gyi la bzla kho nas chos sku'i rgyal srid kyi rdzong 'dzin pa zhig lags pas/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i lag rjes ma yin pa'i gnyug ma'i rig pa zhig sgom rgyu med par go'o/ /'di ni don dam rtsol med kyi theg pa'i ring lugs so/ /a la la ho/༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam la rnal 'byor byed par bzhed pa'i skal ldan gang gis sems rig gi dbye ba bris shog ces gsung ngo / nyid la dris pa la ni lan mi 'debs zhes gcog tu mi rung bar gsungs pas mtshan tsam zhu na/ kho bo spyir na chos dang rang rgyud sbyar ba'i nyams len gyis phongs pas zhu rgyu dka'/ sgos su theg mchog rdzogs pa chen 346

phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi lta ba'i dris lan/po la 'dris cha chung bas zhu bar mi nus mod/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgyun thos lo tsam yod pa tsam gleng na/ sems dang rig pa'i 'byed pa 'di la bshad pa dang nyams myong gi dbye lugs gnyis shig yod par grags / bshad pas dbye na sems rig so so'i sgo yul gnad sogs bla ma yang tig sogs kun mkhyen gyi gzhung na gsal bas de ni bshad pas mtha' rgya gcod dgos par 'dug nyams su myong bas dbye na/dper na tshad pa can gyi yul gyi chu dwangs rnyog pa nor bu ke ta gas btsan thabs su bgrung ste dbye ba dang / gangs kyi yul gyi chu ma dkrug par bzhag pas dbye ba gnyis yod pa ltar 'khrul pa'i sems dang ma 'khrul pa'i rig pa yang chu dwangs rnyog ma ltar ngo bo 'dres pa'i tshul du yod pa tha dad du 'byed pa'i thabs la rtsa rlung thig le'i byed rtsol gyi btsan thabs dang / chos nyid ma bcos pa'i rang babs la 'jog pa'i 'jam po'i thabs gnyis las/ skabs 'dir phyi ma ltar dbye ba la/ gcig tu sngon gyi las 'phro dge ba dang / gnyis su lta dgongs khyad par du 'phags pa'i rtogs ldan bla ma'i ngo sprod gnad kyi me btsa' lta bu dang / gsum du dad pa dang mos gus byin brgyud kyi pha phogs lon nges pa dang / bzhi ru 'jig rten gyi bya ba rtsis med du bor nas dben pa'i gnas su snying bo'i don la sgrub 347

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/tshugs kyi zhe rus thang lhod med pa rnams 'dzoms pa zhig gis da gdod ngang bas chu las 'o ma 'byed pa ltar kun rtogs sems kyi mtshang brtol te 'od gsal gyi rig pa'i zhal ras mjal rgyu zhig yin zhes kho bo'i bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gsungs/ chags sdang gi rtog pa'i sgang gshong mang bo zhig 'bur dod du yod pa'i dmigs gtad sra 'thas kyi sa ltar hreng nge ba'i blo 'di sems zer ba de yin gi gda'/ dgra gnyen skyid sdug gi spros pa 'ja' ltar yal pa'i rjes kyi dmigs med stong ba'i rang ngo la lhan ner gnas pa'i zang thal gyi shes pa nam mkha' 'dra ba zhig rjen par bud na rig pa yin zhes a ti mkhan po rnams zhal mthun par gleng yang rtog ge nga tshos de 'dra ga la shes/ khyed de 'dra'i rig thog tu e bsleb ltos la sgrub pa la brtson dang / bsles na kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po lag mthil na yod ces mdzod chen bdun gyi zhal chem du gal bo che la brgya tshar zhig bskyar ba bslu med rdo rje'i lung bstan nges par legs so/ /kun bzang bzhad pa'i rdo rjes phul ba dge/༄7/ /rdo grub sgang nas yag shul bla ma 'gro 'dul gyi gsung lan la/ mkhan po'i gsung gi mchod brjod kyi tshig /zhing khams rgya mtshor gzugs sku'i bkod pa rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe'i gar/ /nyin 348

phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi lta ba'i dris lan/byed stong gi 'od kyi dpal sbyin 'gro khams rgya mtshor grol ba'i dpyid//ces gzugs sku'i yon tan dang / de yang gzhan don mthar thug gi sku dang / rnam mang theg pa'i chos kyi dbyar rngas gsung snyan sgrogs pa/zhes gsung gi yon tan dang / kun gyi bdag nyid ces thugs chos sku'i yon tan brjod de/ de ldan gyi ston pa la yon tan de ltar dran pa'i phyag bya ba'i tshig /kun mkhyen bu ram shing ba'i zhabs la 'dud/ces gsung ba min nam snyam la/ de yang kun gyi bdag nyid ces pas chos sku'i yon tan ji ltar bstan na/ phyag chen rtsa ba rgyal ba'i gzhung lam las/ /kun khyab kun gyi rang bzhin phyag rgya che/ /dbyer med brjod bral sems kyi rdo rje'i dbyings/ /zhes dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar rgya gzhung bkod par/ 'jam dpal rang bzhin chos rnams kun gyi dngos/ /gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin/ /dus kyi khams bzhin thuṭa rje 'gro 'ong bral/ /sprul ba 'gro dang bral ba gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos dbyings kun 'gro'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i sgo nas yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du byas pa de nyid ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang ye shes chos kyi sku dbyer med par chu la chu bzhag pa lta bu'i mtshan nyid can yin la de dang bdag nyid gcig tu gyur ba'i stong gzhi ji snyed pa gzigs 349

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa dang / 'gro drug sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa la dmigs pa'i thuṭa rje chen po dang / de'i gzung rnam ye shes kyi sku dang / de'i bdag rkyen can gyi rags pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sprul sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs mtha' med pa lhun grub tu yod do/ /skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / de ltar chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' klas par khyab pas khyab bdag yin te mngon rtogs rgyan du/ de ltar mdzad pa rgya che'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas khyab par nges par brjod/ /ces dang / rgyud bla mar/ chags med thogs pa med pa'i phyir/ /ye shes khyab pa nyid du 'dod/ /ces dang / gdul bya'i khams dang 'dul ba'i thabs dang ni/ /gdul ba'i khams kyi gdul bya'i bya ba dang / /de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la/ khyab bdag rtag tu lhun gyis grub par 'jug /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar na chos sku kho na'i yon tan min no snyam na/ ye shes chos sku'i ldog pa nas thams cad la khyab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad chos kyi dbyings mngon du byas pa'i chos sku la brten pa kho na lags so/ /kho bo rnam dpyod phra bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas dris pa la lan ldog mi nus kyang gsung ris su ma bor ba'i khul lags so/ /dharma sa ras gus 350

phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi lta ba'i dris lan/pas phul/༄7/ /dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum gyi tshig don ni/'khrul snang gi spros pa mtha' dag 'joms pa'i stobs mthar phyin pa'i phyir rgyal ba'i ye shes chos sku ni rdo rje khros pa ste/ de bsgom pas zhe snang bag chags dang bcas pa gcod do/ /zhe sdang gis nyon mongs pa gzhan mtshon mod/ dngos su de 'ba' zhig smos pa ni/ lha 'di zhe sdang gi rigs yin pas zhe sdang sgrib bral du byed pa'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ldog pa nas bstan te/ ye shes de la tshur zhe sdang sogs kyis mi brdzi ste/ thugs kyi ye shes de ni 'gyur ba med pa'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin nyid ces 'ba' zhig tu yang dag par ram rnam pa thams cad gyur pa'i zhes pa'i glags med pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ stong ba nyid kyi ye shes te/ stong nyid dang bar du spros pa phra mos kyang ma chod pas rnam par mi rtog pa dang / de'i spyod yul ji bzhin du rtog pas mtshon mi nus pas rnam rtog las 'das pa ste/ de lta bu'i mnyam bzhag las gtan mi g.yo ba'o/ /de la nga rgyal bzhag ste bsgom pa de nyid do/ /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig chen po'i tshul ni/ sems can de dag bsad cing mnan par bya'o snyam pa lta bu'i rnam pa can ma yin te'am 351

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/min gyi/ de dag gi phung sogs tha mal gyi chos thams cad sbyang bar bya'o snyam du ma dag pa'i phung bo dang khams sogs gar yod du dmigs med kyi snying rje'i bde ba chen po'i ngo bor mi phyed pa'i rdo rjes gtams pa ste khyab par byas nas/ dgos pa de sgrub phyir du rang gi rnam par shes pa rdo rjer te hūṃ du bsgom zhes dpag ljon dang bstun nas bshad la/ kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin kho nar sbyor skabs/'gro ba rnams kyi phung bo ste lus ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyis gtams pa ste tha mal gyi go sa 'phrogs nas/ de dag gi rnam par shes pa ni bde stong gi ye shes chen po'i rdo rjes sbyang bar bya'o zhes bsgom pa la bshad kyang rung ngam brtags/ snying rje des bskul te/ mtshon cha chen po rdo rje'i de nyid thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūṃ yig sngon po nyi ma ltar 'bar ba ni chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil nas thig pa lta bur rang shar ro / /de'ang yul dus nyi tshe tsam du shar ba ma yin gyi/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi srog gi go ru shar ba ste/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi srog ni stong nyid yin la/ stong nyid de dang ro gcig pa'i bde chen yang stong bas gar khyab tu 'jug cing / bde chen de nyid hūṃ du shar ba yin pas so/ /de ltar shar ba dang / de'i rtsa ba'i rgyu gang yin zhe na / sngar de ting gi skabs su rang gi phung khams thams cad snying ga'i 352
thig ler bsdus shing / thig le de thugs rdo rje'i ye shes nam mkha' lta bur bskyed nas de nyid slar yang hūṃ du bsgom pa yin pa'i phyir/snying gi go ru bsgom par byaḥzhes 'chad dam snyam/

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄/ /rdo rje phur ba'i rtsa sngags kyi don chung zad bshad pa snga 'gyur rig 'dzin rgan po'i thugs bcud ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /mkhas las mkhas pa 'jam mgon chos kyi rje/ /grub las grub pa gsang bdag las rab gling / /byang chub thob kyang spyi bos gus mchod de/ /nyung ngu'i ngag gis zab don rgya cher dbye/ /de la 'dir snga 'gyur gsang sngags rnying ma'i nang du rgyud sde gsum gyi ya gyal rgyud ma hā yo ga la rgyud sde dang sgrub sde gnyis su yod pa las/ phyi ma la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi sgrub sde lnga dang / 'jig rten pa'i gsum de sgrub sde chen po brgyad du yod pa'i nang tshan 'phrin las phur ba'i sgrub skor gyi myur lam zab mo'i chings thal 'byin rnam pa bzhi'i dgongs pa dang bstun rtsa sngags yi ge 'bru bcu bzhi'i 'bru gnyer phyogs tsam bsnyel thor 'god pa la/ o ni sngags kyi mgo 'dren te thun mong du sgra ba'i lugs su srung ba'i don can gyis shis pa brjod pa dang / thun min gsang sngags kyi lugs su sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i bdag nyid a u ma gsum gyis mtshon par gsungs la/ de lta bu'i don dran pas 354

rdo rje phur ba'i rtsa sngags kyi don bshad rig 'dzin gon po'i thugs bcud/lan gcig brjod pas kyang bsod nams rgya cher sdud par rdo rje rtse mo nas gsungs so/ /me'i nus pas bud shing thal bar byed pa ltar nges don rdo rje phur bu'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa la gegs su gyur ba'i mi mthun phyogs kyi bud shing thal bar 'byin pa'i thabs mkhas kyi lam 'bar ba me dpung 'dra ba 'di la/ 'byin pa'i byed po badz+ra tī li ste rdo rje phur bu bzhi dang / byed pa tī la ya ste phur bus thob ces phur bu gdab pa dang / 'debs yul thal bar 'byin bya'i las sarba bisne ste bgegs thams cad do/ /de yang ji ltar 'debs na gang du bsgral bar bya ba baṃ zhes badz+ra ba ra hi rdo rje phag mo'i rnam 'gyur 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kyis mtshon pa'i nges don gyi yum chos nyid stong ba'i mkha' dbyings su sgrol ba'am/ yang na gang zag bsgral bar bya ba birgyuḥbagegs kyi ming yig dang po la bgegs rang bzhin med pa'i don gyi chos nyid kyi thig le grwa zur spangs pas mtshan ma'i gshis su bsgral ba'i dam tshig rjes su dran par byas te/ hūṃ zhes gsang gsum dbyer med kyi rdo rje phur ba la bskul nas/ sgrol ba'i don dngos phaṭa kyis khos shig gam thal bar gyis shig pa'o/ /de yang cung zad zhib tu bshad na/ thal bar 'byin byed kyi rdo rje phur ba la bzhi yod de/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur ba dang / tshad med snying marje'i 355

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/phur ba dang / don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi phur ba dang / mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur ba rnams so/ /dang po ni/ chos dang gang zag gis mtshon pa'i shes bya'i gnas lugs rang bzhin gyi sde ba phal mo che zhig gis ji bzhin par nyams su ma myong ba'i mtha' bzhi'i spros bral gyi de bzhin nyid kun khyab nam mkhas mtshan pa'i don mdo rgyud thams cad nas rgya cher bsngags pa'i mnyam nyid chos sku chen po de nyid mngon du rtogs pa'i zab mo'i shes rab khyad par can zhig la bzhed do / /gnyis pa ni/ sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba'i nyam thag sems can gyi khams la dmigs te rang gis sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa'i rang nyams dang sbyar nas mkha' khyab kyi sems can la phyogs dang ris su chad pa med par sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod dam/ sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi blo bcos ma min pa zhig la byed do/ /gsum pa ni/chos nyid de bzhin nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes kyi gdangs snying rje chen pos rnam par bskyod de rkyen des srid gsum rdo rje phur bu'i dag pa'i snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bkod par shar ba'i thabs shes dbyer mi phyed pa'i rnam 'byor zab mo zhig ste/ 'di ni thob bya mthar thug gi byang chub dang mtshan nyid mtshungs pa'i sgo nas byang chub kyi sems su bzhag pa'i dpe don gyi phur ba bla na med 356

rdo rje phur ba'i rtsa sngags kyi don bshad rig 'dzin rgan po'i thugs bcud/pa'o / /bzhi ba ni/ 'di skor gyi rgyud dang dgongs 'grel nas bshad pa ltar gyi yi dam gyi phyag mtshan rdzas kyi phur ba tshad ldan rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyis nus ldan du bsgrub cing byin gyis brlabs pa la bya'o / /phur ba de dag gang dang gang la gdab nas bgegs gang dang gang thal bar 'byin pa la rig pa ye shes phur ba ni chos dang gang zag gi bsdus pa'i shes bya'i chos thams cad la btab nas bdag 'dzin gnyis dang de las byung ba'i nyon mongs dug gsum dgra sde brgyad khri bzhi stong bag chags dang bcas pa'i bgegs dpung thal bar 'byin pa ste thal 'byin dang po'o/ /de tshe gnas lugs rig pa'i ye shes de badz+ra tī lī ste 'debs byed phur bu dang / des mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa thams cad bshig pa ni tī la ya ste phur bus btab pa dang / bdag 'dzin gnyis ni gang gcod pa'i gnyis snang gi spros pa'i zug rngu slong ba'i sarba bisdi ste bgegs thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin la / de baṃ 'khor lo rgyas 'debs bsam pa'i dbyings su hūṃ dpal chen po bskul te phaṭa thal bar 'byin pa'i gcod tshig dngos yin pa ni lhag ma rnams la yang rigs bsgre'o/ /tshad med snying rje'i phur ba ni / phyogs ris med par nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can tshad med pa la btab nas rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa dang / rang kho 357

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nas zhe bde thob pa don du gnyer ba'i dman pa'i yid byed gzhan phan tshad med pa 'byung ba la gegs su gyur ba'i bgegs theg chen thams cad nas shin tu smad pa de da thal bar 'byin pa ste/ thal 'byin gnyis pa'o/ /byang chub sems kyi phur ba ni/ da lta tha mal du snang ba'i phyi snod dang / nang bcud kyi dngos po thams cad la btab nas ma dag pa'i snang zhen 'phen byed las rlung dang bcas pa'i bgegs thams cad rtsad nas dbyung ste srid gsum rdo rje phur ba'i grong khyer du byin gyis rlobs pa ste thal 'byin gsum pa'o/ /mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur ba ni/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig par byed pa dang /sngags gsang ba zab mo sun 'byin pa la sogs pa'i bsgral ba'i zhing bcu ci rigs tshang ba'i ma rung ba'i dgra bgegs la btab nas rang gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa'i bgegs btsan thabs su 'phro bcad de rdo rje theg pa'i thabs mkhas kyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba gdug can sgrol ba byed pas rang gzhan 'tshang bar byed pa ni thal 'byin bzhi ba'o/ /thal 'byin snga ma gsum gyis ni gtso bor rtogs pas bdag rgyud sgrol ba dang / phyi mas ni thugs rjes gzhan rgyud sgrol ba ste/ de yang rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i lam kho na dang 'brel ba'i tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs pa'i gsang ba chen po'i rno 358

rdo rje phur ba'i rtsa sngags kyi don bshad rig 'dzin rgan po'i thugs bcud/nus 'gran zla dang bral ba yin pas don 'di ltar rdo rje phur ba'i lha sngags kyi rnal 'byor la brtson rgyu zhig byung na ngo mtshar thams cad kyi phul du gyur ba yin no/ /sgrol ba zhes pa'i don ni/ rgyud las/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bsad mnan rang ga ma la zer ba min te/ ṭī rkyal ba dang sgrol ba la'o zhes pa'i dbyings kṛ ta rkyen gyis ming du bsgrub pa ltar chu bo las rang nyid brgal ba dang / gzhan gyis sgrol ba lta bu zhig la byed cing / de bzhin du sbyor sgrol gyi sbyor ba yang mi tshangs spyod tsam la go rgyu min no/ /'on kyang sngags bla med kyi thabs mkhas rmad du byung ba'i sbyor sgrol ni bud med la spyad pa dang / ma rung ba bsad pa'i las su bya ba ngan pa'i dug thabs la mkhas pa'i mngon rtogs kyi rtsis btab nas rang gzhan 'tshang pa'i bdud rtsir bsgyur ba zhig la byed pas sbyor ba de la mi tshangs spyod kyi don dang tha snyad yod med dpyad bya che la/ mtshan ma rdzas phur gyis btab ste dgra bo'i srog dbang 'gag pa de yang gong gi rgyud kyi lung dang mthun par bsad pa min zer dgos pa 'dra ste/ gsos pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sgrol byed phur ba dang / des gdab pa'i tī li dang tī la ya gnyis kyi tshig don ni/ byings mdo las/ tī la 'tshang bar byed pa la'o zhes 359

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gsungs pa ltar la/ snga ma la dbyangs can mar byings nges par brtan pa la i kra ltas dag go zhes gsungs pas yika byin pa dang /phyi ma la pañtsa mā'i pa ra smi'i skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig hi byin pa'i rjes yin 'dra yang dpyad par bya'o/ /bgegs la bisne zhes 'byung mod/ klad gor gnyis pa'i am byin nam snyam mo/ /lha mchog 'di nyid la bsten nas/ rgyal pa'i dbang bo pad+ma sam+bha was kyang thun mong gi snang tshul du bal yul yang le shod du bar chad thams cad bsal nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes tshul mdzad pas na/ rjes 'jug la bkra shis shing byin che bas yi dam gyi lha skal bsod nams chen po'i stobs kyis thob pa yin pas lha mchog 'di nyid kyi lha sngags la ci nas kyang brtson dgos so/ /zab gsang bla na med pa'i chos kyi bcud/ /'phrin las phur ba'i thal 'byin bzhi'i bya ba / /snga 'gyur rig 'dzin grub pa'i man ngag mchog /snying gi ze'u 'brur 'bral med rtag bzung nas/ /lam mchog 'di las rtogs pas bdag bsgral te/ /brtse chen thugs rjes mi srun gzhan sgrol ba'i//rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i bsgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ /rdo rje phur ba'i sa mchog 'grub par shog /ces 'phrin las lha mchog rdo rje phur ba'i rtsa sngags kyi don cung zad bshad pa snga 'gyur rig 'dzin rgan po'i 360

rdo rje phur ba'i rtsa sngags kyi don bshad rig 'dzin rgan po'i thugs bcud/thugs bcud ces bya ba 'di ni/ thal 'byin bzhi la mngon par byang chub pa'i zab gsang rdo rje glu yi mi 'jigs seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sgrog par mdzad pa'i 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang dang / 'phrin las phur ba'i zab gter la 'dod dgur dbang bsgyur ba'i pad+ma'i rgyal tshab chen po rnam pa gnyis las chos 'di'i smin grol legs par mnos pa'i skal ba bzang bo can sngags kyi brnye kun bzang bzhad pa'i rdo rjes rang gi brjed byang du btab pa dge bar gyur cig/ //

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/h+phu/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam/༄/ /gangs can 'dir gu ru'i rnam 'gyur phal cher za hor mar 'dug pa 'di gter kha rnams las byung la/ de yang gu ru'i zab sgrub phal mo che zhig chos rgyal nyid kyi rnam 'phrul gyi gter ston rnams kyi gter byon du song ba dang / de kun kyang sngon gyi rten 'brel la brten pa ste/ chos rgyal nyid za hor gyi rgyal bo gtsug lag 'dzin gyi rnam 'phrul yin pa dang / rgyal bo nyid kyis nges don du gu ru'i che rtags gsal bar bstan cing / rang gi sku chas mnga' thang gis gu ru bsnyen bkur te bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon du mnga' gsol ba'i rten 'brel gyis lo sum brgyar za hor gyi yul du bstan 'gror dge shis tshad med pa byung ba'i 'phros/ chos rgyal gyis bdag gir bzung ba'i bod yul 'dir mngon du gyur pa yin pas/ gu ru'i rnam 'gyur 'di la chos rgyal gyis skyong ba'i yul dge shis kyi rten 'brel zab mo yod pa yin la/ de yang gu rus za hor du gdul bya dngos su skyong ba'i dus tha na dud 'gror gyur pa rna lam du mtshan thos pa dang mig gis mjal ba sogs phra mo'i 'brel ba thogs tshad bod yul 'dir gu ru'i 364

slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam/gdul byar phyis su gyur nas rang rang gi skal ba bzhin gu ru'i zhal skyin rnams kyis rjes su bzung nas gu ru za hor ma'i rnam 'argyur la mtshan mar byas te bla ma'i skal bar thob nas dngos grub kyi bgo skal la spyod pa 'di byung ngo / /des na za hor ma 'di lho bal gyi ngan sngags mkhan zhig gu rur brdzus pa yin zer ba sogs skur ba 'debs pa ni/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las la tshad bzung btub pa'i blun po'i gzu lum las rnam dpyod dang ldan pas mi smra la/ 'on kyang gu ru'i sku dngos bod du byon pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dis pher snyam pa sogs kyang blo'i mig dkyus thung ba'i rang rtags tsam yin no/ /de ltar bod kyi bla ma'i skal ba gu ru'i yon tan rjes su dran te gter phyogs kyi zab gsang gi drod ma yal ba'i byin ldan gyi chos kyi rang skal mi gcod par dad gus dag snang gi gsol 'debs la brtson bzhin pa nas / gsar mar dgyes na yab rje'i ring lugs kyi shing rta chen po'i rigs lam gyi rno so 'byin lcogs na snga mas ci yang mi gnod lags so / /lar gu ru nyid brdzus skyes yin pas khyad du 'phags so zhes rnying ma'i chos gzhung 'dzin par rlom pa mang ba zhig smra ba ni shin tu blo chung ba ste/ gu ru nyid don la skye gnas bzhis ma bsdus pa'i lhun 365

wa wa sprulaskugasung rab kyi gsung 'bum/grub rig 'dzin gyi sar bzhugs pa yin pas/ brdzus skyes su gsungs pa ni thun mong gi dbang du na skye gnas bzhi'i tshul bsten pa'i rnam 'phrul las brdzus skyes rnam can gyi sprul sku yong ba'i don dang / thun mong min pa'i dbang du na brdzus skyes dang cha mtshungs pa'i gu ru'i rig 'dzin gyi sku 'grub tshul gyi gsang ba rmad du byung ba zhig brda' thabs kyis ston pa lags mod/ gu ru brdzus skyes ma red ces smras na/ smad par dogs pa de dag ni rnam dpyod khab mig dang 'dra ba'i 'u thug lags/ rgya gar yongs grags kyi mthun snang gi lo rgyus la rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta gsum gyi ngag rgyun yi ger bkod pa yin pas kun mkhyen sgrol ba'i mgon pos mdzad pa'i rgya gar ma 'di la bslad med par 'khums so/ /'di la brten nas gu ru slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyi slob ma yin tshul sogs kyis deng sang rnying ma'i bka' brgyad kyi tha ram sogs bka' gter gyi theg dgu'i bshad srol thun mong rnams rang rgyud kyi bshad par gnas pa sogs 'brel bsgrig rgyu mang yang de tsam mo/ /mdor na gter phyogs kyi lo rgyus rnams dang /rnam thar rgya gar ma sogs g.yag zhar gyis rtswa ltar 'dor len mi dgos pas kun la dag snang dang / khyad par rnying ma rang la grags par yang phur ba 'bum nag dang / rigs ni za hor rgyal bo'i rigs 366

slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam/su 'khrungs/ sogs gter phyogs la'ang bshad tshul mang ba lags so / /gangs can chos dkar nor bas phyur bur bkang yang / /chos la nga chos khyod chos phyogs ris 'byed pa'i/ /ngan rtog zhen stangs rgyal ba'i mdzad par sgrog rnams/ /re zhig btang snyoms bzhugs na nyes pa med do/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i mdun sa dag pa'i zhing nas/ /phyogs med rgyal ba'i gsang ba mngon sum mjal ba'i nga tsho'i yab rje'i gzigs tshul 'di bzhin lags na/ /blo chung bdag kyang rnam dpyod 'phur lding rtse bzhin/ /thub bstan bsil ljongs sgeg mo'i phang bar gnas pa'i/ /lung rtogs rgyan gyis spras pa'i lugs bzang gzhon nu/ /kun la dga' ba'i rtsed mo ci 'khyol byas te/ /rgyal ba'i mdun sar dge ba'i shugs kyis bskyod 'gro/ /zhes pa'ang / dharma sā ras rtsed mor byas so/ /yang gu ru'i mdzad pa rjes dran gyi sgo cung zad btod na/ bod gdong dmar srin po'i yul 'dir rgyal bstan gyi snang ba med pa'i tshe gu ru nyid kyi zhabs kyis bcags te/ 'dre srin mtha' dag bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya gnyan po'i zil 'og tu bcug ste ji srid rgyal bstan skye 'gro'i bsod nams kyi dpung bas theg pa de srid du thub bstan rin po che'i dbu 'phang 'dregs pa'i bya ra bar bskos nas gangs 367

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/can gyi ljongs 'di thub bstan 'khor lo gnyis kyi 'byung gnas su byin gyis brlabs te/ zan yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i bsod nams kyi mchod sdong chen po'i dge mtshan mngon sum du 'grub pa'i sgo 'phar rgya cher byas pa ni las dang skal bar ldan pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma chos skyong ba'i rgyal po tshangs pa lha'i me tog sogs rje 'bangs nyer lnga tsam rdo rje snying bo'i smin grol gyi lam la bkod de/ grub pa'i rtags mtshan khyad par du 'phags pa re re thon pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon po la bzhag nas snga 'gyur sgrub rgyud kyi chu bo chen po bskyil te/ dus da lta'i bar du gsang chen chos kyi bdud rtsi 'dod rgyar btung du rung ba'i cha nas gangs can gyi 'gro ba rnams bsod nams kyi skal ba sbom por mdzad pa ni drin lan gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin chen po'i thog ma yin/de nas gu ru nyid kyi sku dngos kyi gdul bya med pas 'gro lding sogs srin po'i kha gnon du bzhugs na yang / bod 'dir bla ma'i rnam rol ji snyed cig byon pa thams cad gu ru'i thugs rje dang ye shes kyi rnam par 'phrul ba las grub pa kho nas rgyal bstan rin po che'i srog mthud cing / lhag par bi kra ma la shi la'i gtsug lag khang 368

slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam/gi mkhas pa thams cad kyi gtsug na mngon par mtho ba'i za hor gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes zhabs kyi rdzu bag gis gangs can kyi bstan pa'i rgud pa gsos te/ dbu ru byang phyogs kyis mtshon pa'i ru bzhi dang mdo khams stod bcas bka' gdams kyi bstan pa dngos gtsang gis khyab par byas te rnam thar gtsang ma 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bgrang bar dka' bas theg pa chen po'i brtul zhugs kyi rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las lo sum brgya skor du bskyangs pa ni dus de tsam na ma ga dha las kyang lhag pa zhig byung ba dang / slar yang bstan pa cung zad 'grib pa gso ba dang —/ bka' gdams kyi sngags la dam dogs che ba glod pa dang /zab mo'i lta ba la rang blo'i tshod bzhin thal rang sogs sna tshogs byung ba gcig tu grub pa'i slob dpon chen po rnam pa gsum gyi rang lugs kyis mgon po klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa nges par bya ba'i slad du grub mtha'i rnam gzhag phra mo tshun chad rigs pa'i lam nas zur phyin par mdzad pa sogs tshang la ma nor ba'i rgyal bstan gzhi nas slong zhing blo skyon gyi g.ya' sel ba'i byi dor gyi slad du/ tha mar bstan pa'i me ro dag /grags pa'i mtshan gyis gso bar byed/ /ces pa'i jo 'brom yab sras kyi rdo rje'i glu yi lung bstan bzhin rje btsun tsong kha pa'i 369

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/zol gyis mdo sngags kyi bstan pa mtha' dag stong khun gyi za 'og gi ri mo ltar ma 'dres par mdzes shing bkra ba 'di bskrun pa sogs mdor na kha ba can gyi rgyal bstan rin po che mtha' dag gu ru'i thugs bskyed kyi dpung shed gcig gis bzung ba ni gzhal du med pa'i bka' drin chen po gnyis pa yin/de dang de'i skabs su yang gu ru srin yul du gshegs nas da lta'i bar lo cig stong lnga brgya skor gyi bar du kha ba can gyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba mtha' dag la bu bzhin du dgongs pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pas btsa' bzhin du bzhugs te/ dus kyi rgyad pa bzlog pa dang skal ldan gyi gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa sogs kyi 'phrin las cung zad kyang mi bsnyel bar bod kyi bde skyid mtha' dag gu ru nyid kyi thugs bskyed kyi phrag par thogs te gangs can gyi stod smad mtha' dag gi ri brag mtsho gsum soṭa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bzhugs gnas su byin gyis brlabs te chos dang nor gyi gter kha sna tshogs kyis bkang nas kha ba can gyi bsod nams kyi rten phur dang bde skyid kyi gsos su mdzad/ dus dang dus su bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i rgyad pa sel zhing legs tshogs gso ba'i gu ru yab sras kyi rnam 'phrul skal ba dang 'tsham par phebs te gangs can gyi gdul bya dpag tu med pa 370

slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam/smin cing grol bar byed pa'i chos nor gyi gter kha 'byed pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'phrin las kyis ji srid gangs can gyi gdul bya ma zad pa de srid du skyong ba ni gzhal du med pa'i bka' drin chen po gsum pa'o/ /rgyu mtshan chen po gsum po de dag gi gnad kyis gu ru rin po che nyid bod kyi bla ma'i skal bar gyur pa yin pas gu ru nyid la gsol ba 'debs shing phur tshugs mos gus kyis yi dam du bzung nas bsnyen sgrub byas na bod kyi gdul bya dang shin tu 'brel ba zab cing / rtag tu bod la dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed kyi nus mthu btsan pas na sangs rgyas byang sems gzhan las 'dren stobs kyi rten 'brel che bas byin rlabs myur ba yin/ don du gdong dmar bod kyi 'dul bya dmu rgod rnams pad+ma'i rigs kyi sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang /byang sems spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po gnyis kyi gdul bya'i zhing du bzung ba'i rten 'brel las sangs rgyas byang sems de gnyis kyi gsang gsum gyi dpal yon bla ma'i rnam par brdzus te gangs can gyi gdul bya 'dul ba'i 'phrin las dus babs su byung ba ni/ dpal o rgyan gyi grub pa'i slob dpon chen po 'di ga rang lags pas bod dang las 'brel che ba yang de gas yin/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje dang /371

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rgyal ba tsong kha pa sogs lta grub so so'i bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon chen po rnams gu ru'i rnam 'phrul kho na yin kyang gtso bo dag pa'i rnam 'phrul thams cad kyi 'byung gnas gu ru nyid bod spyi'i bla ma'i skal bar gyur pa 'di shes pa byas te bye brag tu rang gi las 'brel gyi me tog phog ba'i skal ba de dag gi sgo nas lhag tu rang rang la bka' drin che ba yang gu ru'i bka' drin rjes dran gyi sgor byas te gsol ba btab na spyi sgos kyi byin rlabs spungs pa bzhin du rang rgyud la bde blag tu 'byung ba'i rten 'brel kyi gnad chen po zhig yod pas phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa 'di shin tu zab/dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob dpon chen po nyid bod du ci tsam bzhugs zhes 'dri na/ 'di la sna tshogs shig gleng yang rnam thar rgya gar ma ltar yin par 'khrul ba med de/ rnying ma rang gi sngon gyi lo rgyus las kyang de dang phyogs mthun par bshad pa'i phyir te/ sngon gyi yig rnying rong zom chen po'i man ngag lta phreng gi 'grel bar yang /chos rgyal khri srong rang gi sku ring la o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po srin yul du gshegs pa dang / de tshe rgyal bo 'khor bcas phebs skyel du byon pa la dpon slob kun brag dmar mtsho mo mgul du zhag gsum dro btab ste/ man ngag lta phreng dang ma mo gsang ba las kyi thig le 372

slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam/gnyis chos rgyal la skyud byang du gnang bar gsungs pas shes shing /gang gi rnam thar de rgya gar la yongs su grags pa'i gtam yin par rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta phyis byon de dag gis kun mkhyen tā ra na tha la gnang ba'i lo rgyus tshad ma yin pa dang / bod nas gu ru nyid srin yul du gshegs pa la yang rgya bod kun 'chams pa bzhin bzhugs pa'i yun kyang phal cher 'chams pa'i phyir ro/ /srin yul du gshegs zhes pa'i srin yul 'gro lding gi yul la byed rgyur 'dug cing / gu ru'i sku'i rnam 'gyur 'di nyid mi dang mi min gdug pa can rnams drag shul gyi stobs kyis gnon pa'i mthu stobs dbang phyug gi skur bzhengs te sems can gyi don byed pa'i brtul zhugs can zhig yin par 'dug ste/ bka' gdams glegs bam du ma 'ongs lung ston gyi tshe / nga yang gnas der lha 'dre 'dul du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa dang ske/ rnam thar rgya gar mar yang / dur khrod brgyad du sbyong ba mdzad pa'i tshe gnod sbyin mi ma yin rnams kyis rang rang gi gnya' bar khur te dur khrod chen po rnams nyul bar gsungs pa la sogs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhugs dus rgya gar ma ltar na yang bka' thang sogs nas bod yul du ci tsam bzhugs par bshad pa lta bu dang yang 'gal ba med de/ gu ru nyid thun mong du srin yul du gshegs nas kyang gu 373

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ru'i zhabs zin ma zin gyi skal ldan snga phyir byung ba phal mo che zhig la lo grangs de tsam zhig tu gu ru'i sku dang gsung gi snang ba rgyun ma chad pa'i dag pa'i snang cha la dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phyis su skal ldan las can gu rus rjes 'dzin med pa ga la yin kyang gu ru'i sku dngos bod yul du phebs te zab gsang gi chos sgo phyes pas skal ldan rje 'bangs kyi tshogs grub pa'i sa mthon por bsnyegs pa'i grub thob byin brgyud kyi ngad de tsam du ma yal bar dgongs brgyud kyi 'pho ba thob pa'i las can dag pa'i skyes bu gu ru'i ye shes sku yis ma bskal pa'i rig 'dzin gyi phreng ba ma chad par byung ba'i gzigs pa yin no/ /'di yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la bsams te dad pa'i sgo 'phar dbye ba'i tshul cung zad brjod pa ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la 'gal 'du'i phreng ba bsgrigs pa'i rtog ge tsab tsub mkhan la ngal gso'i slad du sbyin pa lags mod/ sman la dug tu 'khrul na re zhig byar med do//'khrungs yul yang / bod du gshegs pa'i ye shes zhabs kyi slob ma de nyid kyi sku'i rnam 'gyur kyang rgya gar ma ltar o rgyan gyi rgyal po'i blon po chen po zhig gi sras su 'khrungs pa yin kyang / gtso bo o rgyan gyi slob dpon zhes pa'i don 'dzam gling nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul 374

slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar las 'phros pa'i 'bel gtam/'di gsang ba'i bdag po'i gdul zhing gsang sngags kyi chos mdzod chen po'i gnyer kha mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bzung nas yod cing /yul de'i skye bo phal mo che la grub chen brgyad sogs sngags kyi dngos grub ji ltar rigs pa ma grub pa med pa lta bus phal cher nam mkha' la 'phur te 'gro bas 'phur 'gro'i yul du grags pa'i gnas chen po de nyid kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi tshogs dpon du bla ma dri ma med pa'i rnam pas bzhugs nas yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis o rgyan gyi slob dpon du grags pa lags shing / sku'i rnam 'gyur tsam la tshad bzung med par yul dus khol bu ba mang bor grub pa'i brtul zhugs ngom pa'i slob dpon gyi cha mang bo zhig yod pa 'dra ste/ za hor du lo sum brgyar gdul bya skyong ba'i tshe yang der mthun gyi sku gsar 'khrungs yod pa'i phyir te/ gter phyogs kyi yig rnying tshad ldan du mar/rigs ni za hor rgyal bo'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bod 'dir gu ru brdzus skyes su yongs la grags pa yang / thun mong gi snang tshod dang bstun na brdzus de 'khrungs pa ma yin kyang /bod kyi lha 'dre gdul ba la gdul bya lha 'dre nag po'i phyogs mang bo zhig gi bsam ngor mngal grib kyis lus sems bkol du mi btub 375

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa'i rnam smin rags pa'i rten can ma yin par las kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs kyis 'dod dgur dbang bsgyur ba'i rang rang gi skye gnas dang mthun par 'khrungs pa'i gzugs sku'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan pa yin la bod 'dir slob dpon 'di nyid kyi sku'i rnam 'gyur gyis lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams btul te mi min gyi gdul bya mang bo zhig gi tshogs rjer gyur te kha ba can 'dir rgyal bstan gyi gzhi bting bas rten 'brel 'di las rgyal bstan nam gnas su kha ba can 'dir lha 'dre dam la gnon pa'i ched du gu ru brdzus skyes kyi rnam thar gyi phyogs bzung nas rjes su dran par byas na sngon gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya de mi 'gyur bar brling ba'i dgos pa chen po zhig yod pas gu ru brdzus skyes kyi rnam thar 'di dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan ldan gyi rig 'dzin rnams ched du gleng ba 'di shes dgos pa zhig red// //376
na bo dhi pa'i rnalas bzhung

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄/ /mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thub bstan nyin byed 'dren pa'i skya rengs zhes bya ba bzhugs/༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ 'dir mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byed par spro bas/ skyabs sems sogs sbyor ba'i chos rnams sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi bskyed pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar kun bzang mchod sprin dbus/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi/ /ze'u 'brur seng khrir pad zla'i gdan gsum la/ /dbus ma'i steng du rang gi bla ma ni/ /rnam pa mtha' 'khob bod kyi yul 'di ru/ /rgyal bstan thog mar 'dzugs pa'i bka' drin can/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma'i shing rta che/ /mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po zhi ba 'tsho/ /dge slong rnam can phyag g.yas chos 'chad dang / /g.yon pa mnyam bzhag steng na glegs bam bsnams / /dbu la sde snod gsum mtshon paṇa zhu dang / /sku la ngur smrig chos gos rnam gsum gsol/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /de yi thugs kur rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gur gum mdog can longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas/ /zhal gcig phyag 378

bla ma'i rnal 'byor skor/gnyis ral gri glegs bam bsnams/ /'od phung dbus na skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /g.yas kyi seng khrir 'phags yul rgyal tshab mchog /sher phyin bka' babs seṅge bzang po'i zhabs/ /phyag gnyis chos 'khor dbu la paṇa zhu dang / /sku la chos gos gsum gsol skyil krung bzhugs / /g.yon gyi seng khrir bod kyi rgyal tshab che/ /dbu tshad bka' babs pad ma'i ngang tshul mchog /rtsod pa'i nyams can dbu la paṇa zhu dang / /sku la chos gos gsum gsol phyed skyil bzhugs/ /mtha' bskor bsam bzhin bod kyi rgyal bstan slad/ /sems dpa' che rnams skye ba'i tshul bzung ba'i/ /rab byung thog mar sad mi mi bdun mchog /sba btsun dpal dbyangs ye shes dbang po dang / /rnam snang srung ba ngan lam rgyal mchog dbyangs/ /rma ban rin chen mchog mkhon klu dbang srung / /la sum rgyal ba byang chub rnam pa bdun/ /dge slong cha byad bsil byed lhung bzed bsnams/ /de yi mtha' bskor skad gnyis smra ba'i gtso/ /'jig rten mig 'byed ska cog zhang gsum dang / /bstan pa'i me ro smad nas gso ba'i mgon/ /dmar g.yo gtsang gsum bla chen dge ba'i mtshan/ /sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan bsgyur zhus dang / /sgom sgrub bstan ba'i bya bas brel bzhin du/ /gangs can bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon chen po ru/ /thugs rje chen 379

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pos dgyes bzhin bzhugs par mos/ /'dab ma rnams la lha klu dri za ma'i / /rigs can gsum gyis mchod cing gsol 'debs shing / /khyad par sprul ba'i rgyal pos gangs ljongs 'dir/ /rgyal bstan dar ba'i ngo chen zhu zhing bzhugs/ /de dag gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan / /de las 'od 'phros mkha' khyab rgyal ba kun/ /bsgom pa dang 'dra'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ /tshogs zhing rnams la thim zhing dbyer med gyur/ /rgyas par na spyan 'dren khrus gsol byed cing / /dad mos shugs drag pos phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rgyal kun yab tu gyur kyang rgyal sras kyi/ /rnam pas rab 'byams zhing du zab mo'i bstan/ /spel ba'i thugs bskyed rlabs chen grub pa yi/ /mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo / /'jam dbyangs zhabs kyi pad+mo gus bsten nas/ /'phags pa'i yul dang mtha' 'khob bod yul 'dir/ /rgyal bstan snying pos dkar 'byams gtong pa yi/ /mkhan chen chos rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa'i lugs bzang theg mchog sher phyin mdzod/ /legs bshad lde'u mig du mas rab phyes te/ /mngon rtogs nor bu'i bgo bshas tshim mdzad pa'i/ /slob dpon seng bzang zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu tshad rigs pa'i sgo brgya rnam phyes shing / khyad par ci yang yid la mi byed pa/ /nges don sgom du 'khrul ba tshar gcod 380

bla ma'i rnal 'byor skor/pa'i / /mkhas mchog ka shi'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i snying rje'i rig sngags kyis/ /rab byung btub pa'i mtshan ma ston slad sogs/ /sgyu ma'i srid pa bsam bzhin bzung ba yi/ /sprul pa'i dge slong bdun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi chos mdzod phal mo che/ /gsar bcad skad kyi shing rtas yongs drangs te / /gangs can chos kyi gter du bsgrub pa yi/ /lo ts+tsha chen po gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus kyi rgud pas rgyal bstan 'jig pa nyid/ /bsrung phyir khams kyi dgon par chos 'dzin zhing / /spel ba'i smon lam chen po mngon gyur ba'i/ /'phags chen dam pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo zhes dang gzhan yang / mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /sogs dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs bcad rnams brjod do/ /de nas sdong po bkod pa'i kun tu bzang po'i smon lam las byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa dang / maṇ+ḍal rgyas par 'bul zhing byang sdom bzung ngo / /de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs la/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gzhon nus cha lugs 'chang ba po/ /sogs/ tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol phyes shing / /thams cad yod smra'i sde btsugs de / /mtha' 'khob mun pa sel mdzad pa'i/ /bornyi sa twar gsol ba 'debs / /'phags ba'i yul dang gangs can 'dir/ /chos kyi rgyal 381

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/po'i rgyal tshab che/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i srol 'dzin pa'i/ /sras mchog gnyis la gsol ba 'debs/ /thog ma'i 'dul 'dzin rnam pa bdun / /sprul ba'i lo ts+tsha chen po gsum/ /shākya dge 'byung rab gsal dang / /bla chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyi/ /sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam bzhin/ /mtha' 'khob las kyang mtha' 'khob 'dir/ /thub bstan dar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa bshad phyogs mthun 'dul ba dang / /sher phyin gtsor gyur mdo sde dag /gong 'og mngon tshad gzhung lugs kyi/ /'chad nyan 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nges 'byung tshul khrims gtsang ba dang / /rnam dag ting 'dzin rab brtan zhing / /mtha' bral shes rab dag pa yis/ /nyams len rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag ni 'phags nor bdun gyis phyug/ /dge 'dun spong klog las kyis brel/ yul 'di dge bcu'i khrims kyis 'tsho/ /bde skyid 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ces pa dang gzhan yang 'dod gsol dang smon lam shugs drag tu bya'o/ /de nas tshogs zhing bsdu ba ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas tshogs zhing rnams/ /mtha' nas bsdus te gtso 'khor gsum la thim /sras gnyis yab dang de yang 'od du zhu/ /'od kyi gong bu rang gi snying ga ru/ /thim pas rang sems byin gyis brlabs gyur te/ /bde gsal 382

bla ma'i rnal 'byor skor/mi rtog stong ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /mkha' khyab 'gro la snying rje ltag bsam sogs/ /theg mchog rigs kyi nus pa sad par gyur/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i rnam dkar dge ba yang / /sogs kyi bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ /ces mkhan chen bo rnyi sa twa la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thub bstan nyin byed 'dren pa'i skya rengs zhes bya ba 'di ni mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po de nyid dang ngo bo dbyer med par bka' gdams glegs bam sogs kyi lung dang rigs pas grub ba'i snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen pa 7 rje btsun 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros dpal bzang bo'i zhabs pad spyi bor thob pa las byin rlabs kyi snang ba phra mo la longs spyod pa'i shākya'i dge slong blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtshos rang gzhan gyi rgyud la sde snod gsum dang bslab pa gsum gyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyi dgos khyad che snyam nas snyan mo ri rnam rgyal dge ldan gyi rang gshags dkon mchog gsum gyi lha khang du gus pas bsgrigs pa dge legs 'phel/༄7/ /mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po bo rnyi sa twa la bstod pa byin rlabs dri bsung 'phro ba'i me tog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /thub bstan be+eḍūr sa gzhi'i khyon yangs por/ /bshad sgrub gser gyi re kha brgya bris te/ /mdzes par byed pa'i mkhas mchog lha'i bzo bo/ /dwangs ba'i sems kyi rdzing bur yang yang shar/ /ngag gi dbang phyug ral ba'i cod pan zur phud lngas mdzes 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /thun mong nyid du spyi bos mchod pa'i bka' lung bdud rtsis gtams pa yi//theg pa mchog gi chos kyi bum pa 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dod 383

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'jo'i gter/ /e ma khyod ni lus can kun gyi bsod nams dpal du ches cher lci/ /nges pa'i don du mthon mthing lcang lo re zhig mi mngon rgyas btab shing / /ral gri'i gdengs ka rnon po'i mtshon kyang chos 'chad zol du bsgyur nas ni/ /sher phyin rig sngags zhing brgyar zlos pa'i smon lam ji lta ba bzhin du/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir rgyal tshab mchog de thub bstan mgon du snang bar gyur/ /gang gi mtshan gyi tam+bu ra de gling 'di'i skye bos yang dang yang / /dad pa'i sor mos rnam par brdung ba'i ngag gi 'gyur khugs gcig nyid du/ /bo rnyi sa twa'i grags snyan dkar bo srid pa'i khong las yongs brgal te/ /phyogs kyi lus can dad pa'i mchi ma rang dbang med par bku ba lags / /mgon khyod tshul khrims gser gyi snye ma spong bdun yal gas rab dud rtser/ /lhung ba'i dri mas ring mo zhig nas rnam dag 'od zer brgya 'phro bzhin/ /ting 'dzin me tog 'bum phrag rgod pa'i shes rab ze'i 'bru re re la/ /rigs tshul ro mngar brgya phrag rdzogs pa'i zab don sbrang char zad pa med/ /'dzam bu bṛk+ṣas mtshan pa'i gling 'dir theg mchog nyi zla'i snang byed zung / /shes bya'i mkha' la rigs pa'i shing rtas so sor 'gro ba'i tshul gnyis 'ong / /sher phyin stong ba'i dus kyi char ni ro gcig zhi bar 'khrid rim gyis/ /rnal 'byor 384

bla ma'i rnal 'byor skor/spyod pa'i dbu ma'i tshul gyi shing rta'i srol 'di khyod kyi drin/ gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid med rigs pa'i ral gri'i 'khor lo che/ /rab tu 'khor bas bden 'dzin nags kyi tshang tshing stug po yongs bcom nas / /bden stong nam mkha'i sgeg mo'i 'dzum bag cir yang gsal ba'i zhi ba'i lam/ /slar yang bde blag bgod pas chog pa'i legs bshad rin thang ji ltar gzhal/ /gangs ri'i mu 'khyud 'dzin pa'i ljongs 'dir dam chos snang ba phra ba yis/ /nges legs lam bzang mi mthong mun pa'i sgrib g.yogs stug pos khebs pa'i tshe/ khams bco brgyad dang dge bcu'i chos kyis 'phral dang yun du dge ba yi/ /bde skyid nyin byed 'dren pa'i mgon po khyod min su zhig yid la byed / /rnam byang nor bu'i ba gam mngon mthor ci dgar 'jug pa'i bstun pa'i stegs/ /rab du brling ba'i rtsa lag gcig pu chos 'dul gser gyi 'dzin ma'i khyon/ /gzhi lnga'i shes bya yod smra'i sde bzhin rab tu bstan par mdzad pa yis/ /da dung tshul khrims me tog tshom bu sa 'dir 'bum phrag 'bum phrag rgod/ /e ma khyod kyi thugs bskyed shing rtas legs par drangs pa'i ngo mtshar brgyas/ /rnam par bkra ba'i thub bstan nor bu dus kyi mtha' 'dir da dung yang / /mi nyams smon lam kha los bsgyur ba'i byin rlabs gzi brjid 'di mthong tshe/ /385

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rgyal dang rgyal sras grangs med dbus na nor bu'i khrod na bsam 'phel bzhin/ /mgon khyod yon tan gzi 'od phung bo bka' drin phyogs brgyar spro ba'i zer/ /sgo kun nas ni nam mkha'i nor bu ji lta ba bzhin gyur ba'i tshul/ /yang dang yang du yid la bcag pas byang chub bar gyi tshe rabs su/ /bdag gi theg mchog dge ba'i bshes su khyod nyid rtag tu 'gyur bar shog /de ltar bstod pa'i legs byas mthus / /mgon de'i byin rlabs zla ba'i 'od/ /snying gi kun+dar yongs sim ste/ /dam chos chu rgyun 'thung bar shog /'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bdag ni rab tu 'byung ba dang / /ltung pa'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma bsrung bar shog /gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i/ /yang dag rigs lam la brten nas/ /chos rnams bden 'dzin sun phyung ste/ /nges don lta ba goms par shog /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro khams la/ /mi bzod snying rjes drangs pa yi/ /lhag pa'i sems dang byang chub sems/ /phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'phel bar shog /rgyal ba'i sras kyi bya dka' ba'i/ /rlabs chen spyod pa gang gis kyang / /nam yang zhum pa med par ni/ /gzhan don chen po 'byung bar shog /'dir yang thub bstan rin po che/ /bshad dang sgrub pa zung 'brel gyis/ /gong nas gong du ches 'phel te/ /'gro 386

bla ma'i rnal 'byor skor/kun bde la spyod par shog /ces mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po bo rnyi sa twa la bstod pa byin rlabs dri bsung 'phro ba'i me tog ces bya ba 'di ni/ mgon po de nyid dang gnyis su med pa'i drin chen chos kyi rje 'jam mgon bla ma 7 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros dpal bzang po'i zhabs pad spyi bor thob pa'i skal ba bzang bo can blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya bas mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan sku drin dran pa'i dad pas mtshams sbyar te rang gzhan gyi rgyud la rgyal bstan dar ba'i rten 'brel du dmiṭa te gus pas bsgrigs pa dge legs 'phel// //

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dze /bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun min gsang ba'i lam tu bsgrub pa grub dbang thugs bcud ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po'i rnam rol gyi/ /gsang ba dam pa'i dpal mnga' blo gros gter/ /khyod kyi zhabs pad byang chub snying bo'i bar/ /bdag gi spyi bor 'bral ba med gyur cig /gang zhig bsten na legs tshogs kun/ /sdud pa theg mchog bshes gnyen zhes/ /rgyal ba bden par smra ba'i bkas/ /lan gcig min par bsngags pa bzhin/ /gang la de yi yon tan cha/ /mtha' dag dbyar gyi 'khri shing bzhin/ /rdzogs par bdo ba khyod nyid du/ /yang dang yang du brtags pas grub / /de phyir rje btsun dam pa mchog /khyod kyi zhabs pad bsten pa la / /yon tan yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/ /rgyad pa'i mun pa ring du gyur/ /e ma ho rdzogs sangs rgyas las kyang / /bdag gi bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ /mgon po khyod nyid ches lhag pa/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i ngogs su gsal/ /nyes ltung 'dam gyis ma gos 'di/ /tshul khrims sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan mchog /brtan cing mkhas pa'i yon tan ni/ /388

bla ma'i rnal 'byor skor/nye ba 'khor kyi spun zlar gyur/ /dul zhing zhi la nyer zhi zhing / /yon tan zab cing rgya che sogs/ /theg pa chen por bkri ba yi/ /chos bcu khyod la mngon sum lags/ /phyi dang nang gi de nyid sogs/ /gsang ba chen po'i sgo nas ni/ /sku gsum go 'phang la bkri ba'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid che/ /dus kyi mtha' 'dir blo gsal brgyas/ /phyogs rnams kun tu btsal ba na/ /khyod nyid lta bu 'ba' zhig las/ /brtul zhugs can rnams lhod par gyur/ /so sor thar dang theg pa che / /gsang ba mchog gi chos kyi chu/ /khyod nyid kho nas btung ba ltar//dus kyi gsham 'dir ches dkon mod/ /khyod kyi rnam thar gtsang ma'i khrims / /ston pa'i bstan pa'i gtad rabs bzhin/ /theg mchog rtsa ba snying rje dang / /sems mchog dpag bsam smin pa ltar/ /theg pa bla na med pa yi/ /smin grol gsang chen chos kyi sgo/ /bcos ma min pa'i bzang bo'i gshis/ /khyod la nor bu'i 'od ltar gsal/ /de slad du ni gang ldan na/ /rigs rnams kun gyi bdag nyid du/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po yis/ /lan gcig min par bka' bstsal pa'i/ /yon tan de ldan mgon po khyod//dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ji snyed pa'i//khyab bdag chen por nges rnyed de/ /khyod kyi rnam 'gyur kho nar mthong ske/ /de phyir sangs rgyas byang sems zhes/ /gud du gtsigs su 389

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/byed pa'i blo/ /ma rtogs pa dang log pa ste/ /dad pa'i gegs su shin tu che/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kun gyi/ /phan dang bde ba'i mchog sbyin pa'i/ /phrin las sgo brgya 'dus pa yi/ /rin chen za ma tog mchog ni/ /theg pa mchog gi bshes gnyen te/ /de yi yon tan cha rdzogs pa'i/ /rang gi me tog phog pa'i lha/ /khyod 'dra bsod nams mthu yis rnyed/ /e ma ho shin tu skal ba bzang / /bdag deng rnyed pa legs par rnyed/ /theg pa mchog gis 'gro ba la/ /rin chen nor mchog khyod nyid de/ /ji ltar lo tog mtha' dag kun/ /char gyis rtag tu bskyed pa ltar/ /theg pa chen po'i yon tan kyang / /mtha' dag mgon khyod gcig las 'khrungs/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i phun tshogs ma lus pa/ /gang las rnyed pa'i sgo gcig pu/ /mgon khyod nyid du legs par 'khums/ /de ltar mthong ba'i 'du shes kyang / /lam gyi rtsa ba nyid do zhes/ /bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis ni/ /brtse bas yang dang yang du gdams/ /de lta lags na bdag gis ni/ /rnam pa kun tu mgon po khyod/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi spyi gzugs su/ /yang dang yang du cis mi blta/ /dad dang shes rab la sogs pa'i/ /rnam byang dbang po 'phel ba yis/ /gang du 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor yang / /khyod kyi gsang ba kho na ste/ /de slad gsang 390

bla ma'i rnal 'byor skor/chen rim pa lnga/ /rdo rje slob dpon mnyes pa'i mthu/ /'ba' zhig yin zhes bdag nyid ches/ /shing rta'i lam srol nyid du byas/ /gang zhig gang du byang chub pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid/ /khyod kyi gsang ba legs mthong ba/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gnad yin zhes/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i tshogs kun gyis/ /dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis/ /snod ldan rnams la gdams pas na/ /bdag blo'ang ci'i phyir der mi phyogs/ /de tshe bsgrub bya mthar thug pa/ /khyod kyi gsang ba kho na las/ /lha dang rtogs pa gzhan med snyam/ /ngal gso ci yi phyir mi thob/ /de phyir rigs brgya rigs gcig tu/ /gang du bsdu ba'i rigs mthar thug /khyod nyid kho nar zad pas na/ /rigs rnams kun gyi byed po ste/ /gdan gsum dkyil 'khor ba kun kyang / /khyod kyi phung khams rnam dag char/ /sam+bu ṭa dang phreng ba sogs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal bo du mas bsngags/ /gzhan yang sku re ba spu re'i/ /dag pa'i brtan g.yo'i spro bsdu yang / /'di tsam nyid ces tshad 'dzin pa/ /grangs med grangs su bgrang ba lags/ /de phyir gang la gang 'dul ba'i / /'khor lo'i rnam grangs de dang de/ /khyod kyi sku yi rnam 'gyur te / /dag pa'i bkod pa mtha' las 'das/ /de phyir gang zhig legs bsten pas/ /de nyid mnyes pa'i bsod nams kun/ /sdud pa 'dren 391

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa mchog khyod phyir/ /legs tshogs rtsa ba khyod la rag /des na sras bcas rgyal ba las/ /khyod kyi sku yi ba spu gcig /rgya chen tshogs kyi zhing nyid du/ /ches cher lteg pa'ang ches grub pas/ /bdag gis legs tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /tshugs pa mgon khyod mnyes pa ste/ /thog mtha' bar du gal che ba'i/pre /lam gyi srog 'dir cis mi brtson/ /ting nge 'dzin dag thob pa na/ /mgon khyod mchog gi sprul ba'i skur/ /mthong bar gyur tshe mthar thug 'di/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i spros pa kun/ /dbyings su nub pa'i zag med kyis/ /bdag blo yongs su dag pa na/ /dus dang 'khor dang zhing la sogs/ /khyod kyi gzugs sku mthar thug pa / /rdzogs par mngon du mthong bar 'gyur/ /rgyu mtshan des na mgon po khyod/ /byang chub chen por bzhugs pa'i tshul/ /yang dang yang du rjes dran te/ /dad pa'i khams dag cis mi gso/ /theg mchog rtsa ba snying rje'i chus/ /brlan pa'i khyod thugs bde chen khams//dag pa'i brtan g.yo'i nyer rgyu ste/ /gsang ba mchog kyang de lags na / /bgrang yas rgyal ba ma lus pas/ /gang du ro gcig gyur pa'i gnas / /rgyal sras skye 'phags ji snyed pa'i/ /dngos brgyud rim gyis bsgrod pa'i stegs/ /'di la bdag gi 'jug ngogs su/ /rnam par mthong ba'i chos kyi mig /bskal ba du ma'i tshogs kyi 'bras/ /lan 392

bla ma'i rnal 'byor skor/gcig mngon du gyur ba'i skabs/ /da ni dal dang 'byor ba'i rten bzang po/ /log dman bya bas chud zos mi gtong bar/ /long med dran pa'i lcag gis legs bkrab ste/ /dkon mchog 'dus pa'i ngo bor skyabs 'gro zhing / /sdug bsngal brgyas sun thar ba don gnyer blo / /mi bzod 'gro la snying rje'i gzhan dbang du/ /bsgyur te rdzogs byang thob par 'dod pa'i sems/ /theg mchog spyod dang bcas la bslang bar bgyi/ /thabs kyis smin pa'i shes rab zab mo'i dngos/ /yongs dag bzhi ldan 'dren pa dam pa'i skur/ /ldang ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gces/ /chags pa'i rdul khams yongs su spyad nus shog /lhan skyes dga' ba stong bar sbyar ba yi/ /gzung rnam gdan gsum lha ru shar ba'i mthus/ /skye 'chi bar do bral te sku gsum gyi/ /go 'phang mchog la tshe 'dir 'god par shog /rlung sems ye shes rol mo rdzogs pa'i bar/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag nyid bla ma lha'i/ /gsang ba dam par skad cig mi 'bral bar/ /lam gyi gnad 'dis sa lam myur rdzogs shog /theg mchog rtogs pa mtha' dag bde blag tu/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal dbyor la dril te/ /rang gis rtogs shing gzhan la 'dom pa'i sgos/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer bdag 'gyur shog /mkha' la bla ma'i byin rlabs chu 393
'dzin 'khrigs/ /bar snang chos kyi sbrang char zil mas gang / /sa la bde skyid lo tog yongs smin te/ /bkra shis rgya mtshos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig/ //
cheng

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄/ /theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi gdams pa'i gtam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid rje btsun dam pa bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su bzung du gsol/ ma rig mun pas khebs pa'i 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon 'dir/ /thugs bskyed smon lam zab mos rang dang 'tshams pa yi/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzugs kyis gsung rab sgron me yis/ /thar ba'i lam bzang ston rnams gus pa'i phyag gis mchod / /tshe 'di'i bde ba kho na la/ /zhen pa gtso bor mi byed pa'i/ /skal bzang grogs des bskul ba'i ngor/ /mi ldog tsam du 'di ltar spel / /bdag nyid thos pa nyung zhing rgyud ma dul bas yon tan rin po che'i nor gyis dbul ba la gzhan gyi rgyud la phan pa'i gdams ngag gi bgo bsha' byed rgyu med pa ni sprang pos sprang por zan bslang ba dang 'dra yang / /sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams las cung zad thos pa'i chos rje'u'i nang gi phye thug lta bu las khyed la nyung shas shig gsol bar bya ste/ de yang rgyal ba'i sras po zhi 396

theg chen blo sbyong gi bdams pa bzhugs/ba lha'i zhal snga nas/ /dal ba'i rten 'di shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /skyes bu'i don sgrub thob par gyur ba la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na/ /phyis 'di yang dag 'byor bar ga la 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa der gda'/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di glu ngag dang sgrung rgyud ltar ma song bar rgan po'i sha tsha'i gros ltar snying gi ze'u 'brur bcing nas/ da res rnyed par dka' ba rnyed/ phyis su yang yang mi 'byor ba'i tshul la 'dris par byas te/ dbul pos nor bu rnyed pa la 'dod don ma zhus ba dang / nad pa sman dang 'phrad kyang ma btung ba lta bu'i rang don chud zos su ma song ba'i 'du shes shugs drag po re nyin dang mtshan du nangs dang nub byas nas sems la phur ba btab ste rten bzang bo 'di la dgos don legs par chod pa zhig cis kyang dgos/ de yang dal 'byor la snying bo lon pa'i tshad ni/ rje btsun tsong kha pa'i zhal snga nas/ /de ltar rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg chen gyi/ /lam mchog gnyis kur dgos pa'i thun mong lam ji bzhin bskyed nas mkhas pa'i ded dpon gyi/ /mgon la brten nas rgyud sde rgya mtsho cher/ /zhugs nas yongs rdzogs man ngag brten pa des / /dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par byas/ gsungs pa de lags / des na mdo sngags mtha' dag la bag chags yag pa zhig e 397

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/theb blta dgos/ de theb par byed pa la lam ston gyi mkhas pa'i ded dpon sna sha sbyin btub pa zhig btsal te/ kha mnyam lag mnyam du mi 'dzin par bla mar bzung nas bsten tshul rnam par dag pa zhig gal che ste/ bdag nyid chen po po to bas/ man ngag thams cad bsdus pa'i mgo ni/ bshes gnyen dam pa mi btang ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa de red/ bla mar bzung ba'i don yang zhing gong mar 'dzin pa zhig la zer bas/ zhing gi 'jig rten na so nam legs na ston thog phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i gzhi dang / ma legs na ston thog ma rnyed pas phongs par 'gyur ba'i gnas la zer ba ltar/ bla ma yang tshul bzhin bsten na gnas skabs kyi bya ba lam 'gro yan chad nas bzung ste nyams rtogs yon tan gyi lo tog dpag tu med pa 'byung pa'i gzhi dang —/ ma bsten na de mi 'byung bas chos kyis phongs te gnas skabs dang mthar thug kun sdug bsngal bar 'gyur bas na de las dpe gras zhing zhes zer/ de yang zhing gzhan las so nam sla zhing 'dod dgu'i lo tog bzang bas zhing mchog dam pa rje btsun bla ma zhes gsungs/rgyu mtshan de lta bus na rang dang 'dra mnyam du mi 'dzin par rang las gong ma'am bla ma'i khyad par du 'phags par 'dzin dgos pa der 'dug /bsten tshul la yang bsam sbyor gnyis las bsam pas 398

theg chen blo stong gi gdams pa bzhugs/bsten tshul gal che/ de yod na gzhan yang 'byung bas thog mar bsam pa'i ngos nas bla ma de nyid rang gi blo ngor ji ltar 'char gyin yod bltas te skyon rtog gi blo 'gog lugs dang / yon tan sems pa'i blo sbyong tshul dang / bka' drin rjes dran gyi gus pa skyed tshul rnams gcig tu na ji ltar dgos skyes bu gsum gyi lam khrid la bsten nas shes rgyu gal che/ /gnyis su na kha bshad tsam du ma song bar lag len la theb pa zhig gal che/ gsum du lag len theb pa yang dus de ring nas bzung / bsam pa'i kha nang du bskor te/ da snga su la chos mnyan / chos smra ba po la zhe rtsis ci 'dra zhig 'jog gin yod/ bla ma de rang gi bsam ngor lci yo re ba zhig 'char gyin yod dang med/rang bla ma la zhe gting nas dga' mi dga'/ dga' na yang gong du bshad pa ltar bla mar mthong nas dga' dang / tshe 'dir rgyu zas kyi phan thog /nad gdon gyi 'jigs skyobs sogs 'phral gyi bya ba cung zad re la phan 'dogs 'gal spongs res dga' ba yin brtags te ngan pa bcos/ bzang po sgrub rgyu zhig byung na bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi chos skor/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zer ba de 'ong sa red pas de nas bzung ste rgyud la byin rlabs kyi gter kha rdol nges can du 'dug/chos kyi dbu nas ma nor ba dang / rten 'brel gyi mgo nas ma 399

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'chugs pa zhig cis kyang gal che bas/ khyed chos shig bzhed na de ltar mdzod/ de la mdo sngags so so dang 'brel ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam grangs mang yang yig nag nag 'gros su bri tshod med cing //bri srol yang med pas bla ma'i ngag las shes dgos/ de ltar bsten nas rang gi blo dam pa'i chos la 'dzud pa la/ thog mar shes dgos/ /shes nas nyams su len dgos pas chos kyi rgyus shes par byed pa la bka' gdams bla ma rnams kyis/ po ti mdzo khal tsam pa la bya ba ma byas par be'u bum lag mthul tsam re ston pa tsug /sbed pa tsug byas pas gar yang mi phyin gsungs pa ltar tshe mjug rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'chad nyan dang blta rtog la 'dril thub pa zhig e 'ong zhes smon lam tshun chad thob la 'dun pa der gtod/ tshe mjug thos bsam gyis gzad nas nam zhig na de'i don sgom snyam pa dang / su la bshad bsam pa'i log rtog ma skye/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin po che'i don shes na bshad sa zhig rnyed dgos pas ga la khyab/ rang gi cung zad re sems steng du blang na ngal ba don med du ji ltar 'gro/ de 'dras thos bsam gyi kun slong mgo nas skyon can du song ba red pas de ltar ma byed par rang blo chos la cung zad e 'dres kyi 'dun pas rna bas thos thos sems la bsam bsam gyi dpe 'dzin skyor sbyang 400

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/thams cad 'gag gcig tu dril e thub ltos la 'jig rten na rkang rdo thog tu bcag pa lce thog tu smin dgos zer ba ltar chos thos bsam gyi nus pa sems la 'ju ba zhig byed rgyu thugs la chongs/ de yang skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim 'di shing rta chen po gnyis kyi brgyud pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi nying khu yin pas 'gag bsdu ba der bsdu dgos/ bshad tsa na mdo sngags kyi bshad pa gnam sa'i kha bar du mi shong tsam la lag len la 'dril tsa na skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim du bsdus nas thun rer ma zad kun slong gcig la yang cha tshang ba/ dper na lha'i dar zab kyi gos lta bu zhig dgos zhes khri gung thang rin po che'i gsung bas de 'dra zhig dam pa'i chos la mkhas pa red / des na spyir thos bsam phyogs med kyis lag len lam rim du dril dgos pas lam khrid re cis kyang nyon la sngas lam rim gyi po ti dang nam yang mi 'bral ba zhig mdzod/ las dang po ba dka' tshegs med par chos la 'jug pa'i sna khrid dang /nyon mongs pa'i rnam rtog gi zug rngu drag la rtsub pa phal mo che ngang gis 'jil ba'i zhi byed gcig thang gi sman mchog ni rags pa'i mi rtag pa la nges pa 'drongs ba nyid yin 'dug pas de nyid yang yang bsam te sems kyi mthul du long sa/ deng sang lo shas las gnas 401

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/grogs gnyen bshes kun kyang rang dang 'brel med 'dris med mgron po'i tshogs kyis ngal gso lta bur 'dug go snyam du thag chod la gnas la gtan yul dang / grogs la yun ring 'grogs rtsis/ nor rdzas la mkho zhen chen po mi byed par 'dis bdag 'dor/ bdag gis 'di 'dor zhes yang nas yang du soms la zhen pa'i thag pa bcad ci thub/chags pa'i rgya mtsho skem ci nus shig mdzod la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs bzang la nyin mtshan dal khom med par dad gus kyi sna thag gis sbrel ci thub kyi sgo nas las 'bras drang thig gi gser lam la zhen nas ya yo dang 'khya 'khyogs ma byas na mngon mtho rin chen gyi gling du sang bsleb gnang bsleb las ci yod/ des skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i chos skor tshegs su tshud pa red/ de tsam gyis mi chog par nges 'byung gi bsam pa yag po re e skye blta dgos pas de la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsgom dgos/ de bsgom pa la tshor ba sdug bsngal gyis yid skrag cing sun pa tsam ma yin par khams gsum gyi gnas ris mtho dman med par sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du mthong ba'i sdug bsngal sgom tshul khyad par ba zhig dgos/ de la zag bcas nyer bar len pa'i phung bo lnga 'di blangs tsam nyid nas tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu dngos su mi ldang ba gzugs gzugs med kyi phung bo 402

wa thegachenablosbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/lta bu yin kyang zag bcas las nyon gyi 'du byed las mi 'dod pa dang / gnod pa brgya phrag du ma'i bdag nyid du skyes pa'i mi lcog pa'i khur du bka' dang dgongs 'grel las gsungs pa ltar thag bcad de yang yang 'dris par byas nas nyer len gyi phung bo'i rang ldog nas yid 'byung ba zhig dgos don gyi dbang 'dis/ 'du byed sdug bsngal la dgongs nas/ sdug bsngal bsgom par gsungs pa yin/zhes rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis gsungs par gda'/ des na gzugs gzugs med kyi phung bo yang mi 'dod pa'i bdag nyid dang gnod pa'i bdag nyid du grub kyang ting nge 'dzin khyad par can dang mtshungs ldan gyi mi g.yo ba'i dge ba'i sems pas 'phangs shing 'dres ma min par dkar bo'i las kho nar gtogs pas na re zhig chu lon gyis chu bkag pa ltar/ gang zag mtha' dag gis thun mong du skyes tsam nas mi 'dod par mthong ba'i sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu rags pa dge ba'i las kyis bkag kyang / khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa'i sa bon dang 'brel zhing rnam byang gi phyogs la bkol du mi btub pa'i gnas ngan len du ma'i bdag nyid dang / nges par dbang med du 'dor dgos pas yid brtan du mi rung ba sogs skyes bu dam pas brtags na mi 'dod pa las kyang mi 'dod pa'i rang bzhin yin pas 403

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zer/ de lta bu'i phung bo la nying mtshams sbyor ba log pa'i sems steng gi bral ba ni 'gog pa'i bden pa'am thar ba zer ba de red pas de lta bu'i thar ba la don gnyer bcos ma min pa zhig skyes na nges 'byung gi bsam pa rnyed de thar lam zin pa yin pas 'di la chos mngon pa mnyan te 'khor 'das so sor 'byed pa'i shes rab phra la mdzangs pa zhig sngon du song ba med na gong ma rnams la go dka' bas zab cing phra/ thar ba de thob pa la srid pa'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin lhan skyes kyi 'dzin stengs sun phyung ba'i shes rab kyi bslab pa dang / de'i rten tu sems kyi rnam rtog gi rta ma dul ba dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab ba/ de la lus ngag gi spyod pa ngan pa tshar gcod pa'i tshul khrims gsum ya bral du ma song bar nyams su len dgos la/ de yang dang po nas tshul khrims nas rkang rtsa tshugs dgos pas nyi ma re re bzhin yang rang rgyud kyi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ji ltar song 'dug blta dgos la/ de la dam pa'i chos 'dul ba lung sde bzhi las lhag pa'i bslab bya zhig med pas 'dul ba lung re thon/ las 'bras la yid ches rnyed na tshul khrims dag pa rang shugs kyis 'ong bas 'dul ba lung gi las 'bras kyi byung ba rnams soms / sangs rgyas kyi bka' las lhag pa'i nyams len zhig rdzogs 404

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/pa'i sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i lam ston zhig yod par thal nas snyigs ma'i dus 'dir zab zab mo yin zer tshad kyi kha la brgyugs nas khyi bya bsnyegs ma byed/ gdams ngag ni sangs rgyas kyi bka' la byed pa ni bka' gdams gsar rnying gi phyag srol red pas rgyal ba'i bka' la nyams len gyi mthil du mdzod/ sangs rgyas kyi gsungs dang mi mthun par spyad pa'i nyes ltung da snga ci 'dra zhig bsags/ da lta gsog gin yod med/ phyis su gsog par 'gyur mi 'gyur rnams zhib tu rtog la bsags zin bshags pas 'dag nges dang / gsog bzhin pa'i 'phro rbad chod/ gsog 'gyur gyi sgo yang yang sdom pa bcas 'phral dang 'phral du sems thog la longs la rang gis bsam kyang brtag thub pa'i rang rgyud gtsang seng nge ba zhig nyi ma re re nas mdzod la/ rang sems me long gi byi bdar byed byed kyis dang / de las lhag pa'i sems ngo zhig mi dgos te/ rgyal sras chen pos/sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma rtogs pa/ /brtul zhugs mang bos ci zhig bya/ /gsungs pa red/ de 'dra zhig byung na skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong pa'i chos skor la bag chags theb nges/ de'i steng du theg pa chen po'i chos la slob dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs ma thob bar du rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir/405

ga sprulaskugasung rab kyi gsung 'bum/de yang skyes bu chen po'i chos skor rnams ni dngos gzhi dang / chung 'bring thun mong ba'i lam rim rnams de'i sngon 'gro yan lag yin tshul sogs lam rim che chung du gsal bar gsungs pa rnams go na sems la bogs che/ theg pa chen por 'jug pa la 'jug sgo byang chub kyi sems rin po che yin pas 'di nyid bskyed pa gal che/ rgyal sras chen pos/ dam chos 'o ma bsrub pa las/ /mar gyi nying khu byung ba yin / /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi brjod don gces dgu'i yang snying dang / 'gro ba'i mgron po srid pa'i lam rgyu zhing / bde ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa la/ 'di ni bde ba'i mchog tu nyer gnas te/ /sems can mgron chen tshim par byed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems can la phan 'dogs pa'i sgo bla na med pa dang / rang don yang mthar thug pa'i rgyu sems rin po che 'di nyid kho nar nges pa'i nges shes bskyed de byang chub kyi sems la bag chags yag po zhig theb dgos/ de ma theb na 'phags pa'i zhing mchog theg chen gyi chos thang mar brdal ba'i yul du skyes nas theg chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa sogs kyi rten 'brel ches mchog tu gyur ba 'grigs pa la ltos te dal 'byor la snying bo ma lon par lag stong du song ba yin zhing / phyis su yang yang chos 406

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/ldan gyi rten tsam thob pa dka' na theg chen dang mjal bar dka' ba lta ci smros/ des na long bas glang mjug zin pa ltar brtson pas 'ju ba gal che/ de la lam rim du byang chub kyi sems sbyong tshul shing rta chen po'i lugs gnyis ka bkod la/ bla ma las nyon la rtsad gdar chod / yang yang dpe bltas gyis/ dpe thog tu ma 'jog par sems la skor/ de'i rgyab brten du spyod 'jug la ltos dang de na gzhan don gyi blo sbyong ba la yid 'khul tshabs che ba'i rigs pa'i rno so mang du yod / rgyu mtshan des a rig dge bshes chen mos kyang nged kyi rigs pa'i dbang phyug rgyal sras zhi ba lha la zer ba yin gsungs te go rgyu che/byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba la gzhan don la blo 'gro ba gal che/gzhan don don gnyer gyi bsam pa sbyong ba la mar shes drin dran sogs kyis sbyang lugs dang / bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang brje ba'i sems bskyed de sbyong lugs gnyis sher phyin gyi mdo dang sdong po bkod pa sogs las gsungs shing byams 'jam dbyangs kyi man ngag gi bum par bzung ste shing rta chen po gnyis nas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan a ti shas gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir drangs te sras kyi gtso bo 'brom rje la gtad cing / de nas bzung brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa las rje btsun tsong kha 407

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa chen pos bdag gir bzhes te/ ji skadadu/ sems bskyed theg mchog lam gyi gzhung shing ste/ /sogs nas/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar bgyis/ /thar 'dod khyed kyang de bzhin bskyang 'tshal lo/ /gsungs pa dang / thar 'dod phyi rabs kyi skal ldan mkhas grub gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i gser mdog cod paṇa 'dzin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas kyang gsung de kho na blo sbyong bas de'i brgyud pa'i gral 'dab nas yar mnyan rgyu byung ba 'di bsod nams dpag tu med pa'i skyes chen po lags pas/ sems rin po che la ma ltos par sngags kyi zab khyad kho nas sa gcod mdog gi snyan snyan mo la rna ba khobs/ byang chub kyi sems skye ba la gnad 'gag gnyis yod/ sems can su mthong yang nye ring med par yid 'ong gi rnam ldan du skye ba zhig dgos/ de la sems can gyi ngos nas rang la drin che tshul shes shing gting nas blo 'khul ba zhig dgos/ /drin dran tshul la sngar gnyen gyi dwangs mar gyur te bskyangs tshul sems pa dang —/ da gzod rdzogs byang gi go 'phang tshun chad kyi legs tshogs thams cad sems can gyi zhing la brten nas 'thob dgos tshul sems pa gnyis yod/ gnyis po sbrag na rgyud 'khul tshabs che bar snang —/ yang rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang de yon tan mtha' yas 408

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/pa'i bdag nyid yin pa dang / khyad par du rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa yin pa dang / yang sgos su gzhan don la blo 'khul ba la gzhan don sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rnam pa thams cad pa 'bad med lhun grub du yod lugs sogs theg chen gyi mdo dang bstan bcos nas 'byung ba ltar shes shing sems pa gal che/ de ltar sems pas rdzogs byang de nyid don gnyer gyi bsam pa 'byung sla/ de ltar na mgon po byams pas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa de ji bzhin par 'byung rgyu zhig yin tshod red/ spyod pa nyams len gyi rten byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed nas phyin drug slob pa'i lam gyi go rim gsungs kyang las dang po ba 'o skol lta bus lam yongs rdzogs la bag chags theb dgos pas sbyin sogs nyams len kyang lam khrid ltar thugs la zungs / lam mchog sgo 'byed las/ sems tsam bskyed kyang tshul khrims rnam gsum la/ /goms pa med na byang chub mi 'grub par/ /legs par mthong nas rgyal sras sdom pa la/ /brtson pa drag pos slob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyod pa nyams len gyi bya ba thams cad kyang nyes spyod sdom pa dang / dge ba chos sdud dang /sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum du bsdus nas nyams su 409

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/len tshul shes dgos/ yang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yang mdo sde rgyan sogs nas bshad pa ltar dang por shes su chug la rgyal ba'i sras kyis sems can bsdu ba'i tshul ni 'di ltar yin no zhes ston gnam g.ya' dag ltar dwangs pa'i yid kyis de ltar bsdu'o snyam pa'i dam bca' dang bsdu nus par gyur cig snyam pa'i smon lam tshun chad yang yang thob dang bag chags khyad par can theb 'gro bas cis kyang gal che/lhag par mdo sde rgyan nas bshad pa'i phyin drug gi grangs nges rnams dang / slob dpon seng bzang gi phyin drug gi grangs nges gnyis gsungs pa rnams lam rim chen mor bkod pa ltar yang yang sems thog tu blang na rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la go ba ster phul che zhing nges shes 'drongs sla/ phyin drug gi lam po che las gzhan du rdzogs byang du bgrod pa'i myur lam yin mdog gis kha gzhan du 'dren par mi nus pa'i nges pa gting tshugs pa skye zhing / des lam ltar bcos pa la yid nam yang mi gol bas bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam 'di kho na khog srong rgyu 'ong bas sa chod kyang che/ lam gang la yang de ltar sems thog tu blangs te dpyad pa byas pas nges shes kyis rgyud 'khul ba re 'ong na de las lhag pa'i sgom byed tshul gtan nas med pa bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung rgyun yin/ rtog ngan re re skyes pas kyang rtog pa 410

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/ de nyid 'gag pa'i tshe sems rgyud la slar yang rtog pa ngan pa de 'dra'i rigs 'byung rung gi nus pa 'jog pas nus pa de la sa bon dang bag chags zer/ de bzhin tu rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin po che'i dgongs don la dpyad pas don gang yin kyang de ltar los yin snyam pa'i 'dzin stangs thag chod pa byung ba nges shes 'drongs pa zer de yang lung rigs kyi rgyab brten bzang po'i lag rjes las byung ba de nges shes rnam par dag pa yin/ de dang dus mtshungs par don de la yid dwangs seng nge ba dang / yid ches pa dang / don du gnyer ba sogs kyi dad pa dang / de la mngon par spro ba'i brtson 'grus dang dmigs rnam de nyid mi brjed pa'i dran pa dang / de la yid rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / /shes rab nges shes rang gi ngo bo yin pas rnam byang phyogs la dbang byed pa'i dad sogs dbang po lnga ldan gyi sgom 'di lta bu lan re skyes pas kyang sems rgyud la de 'dra'i blo phyi ma 'byung rung gi dge ba'i nus pa 'jog cing / sems ni rnam 'grel las gsungs pa ltar rten brten pa dang / yon tan de yang goms zin 'bad rtsol bskyar ma la mi ltos pa'i chos yin pas nam yang chud zos su mi 'gro/ des na de ltar dpyad sgom gal che tshul lam rim na rgyas par gsungs pas der ltos la nges shes rnam par 411

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dag pa dpyad pas 'dren dgos pas zhi gnas kyi sgom ma yin pa la dpyad sgom bsngags tshul shes dgos/ sgom yin na 'jog sgom yin dgos / 'jog sgom yin na sems tsom me ci yang mi bsam par 'jog dgos snyam pa 'di deng sang phal cher la 'char rgyu zhig yin pas de 'dra'i gegs dang gol sa la ma 'khrul/ bsgom brgyab pa'i lag rjes la yar gyi sangs rgyas byang sems dang bla ma slob dpon la dad gus/ bar gyi grogs mched dam tshig gcig gis bsdus pa la dag snang / mar gyi rigs drug sems can la byams snying rje sogs 'byung dgos pa la ci yang ma bsam par sems tsom mer bzhag pas mi 'byung ba ni 'o ma 'dod pas rwa 'jo ba dang 'dra bar slob dpon chen po ka ma la shrī las gsungs/ des na rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug tshul yang so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis phyin ci log gi 'dzin stangs sun dbyung ste 'jug dgos tshul kho bos grub mtha' phyi rol ba bshad skabs yang yang bshad pa der gda'/ don 'di la rgyab brten tshad ma 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo las shing gnyis drud pa'i dpes gsungs tshul sogs dran na nges shes 'drongs sla/ de ltar dpyad sgom zab na rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin po cher blta rtog ma byas pa la dpyad bya dpyod byed ci yang med pas/ dpe char gzigs rgyu 412

theg chen blo stong gi gdams pa bzhugs/gal che/ slob gnyer byed pa 'di dpyad sgom gyi rgyu tsam du ma zad rang dus der yang dpe 'dzin skyor sbyang nam byed la dpyad pa yin pas dpyad pa logs na med cing / sgom gyi don goms par byed pa la zer bas 'dzin rtsod skyor gsum sbrag ste sems de'i phyogs su goms cha gtong ba las lhag pa'i sgom zhig 'dod na khyed mo gsham gyi bu dang 'phrad 'dod par gda'/ des na so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pa gtso bor byed cing / dpyad mthar nges shes kyi rgyun la 'jog par yang bya dgos pas dpyad 'jog spel mar mdzod/ khyad par phar phyin tha ma gnyis la slob tshul ni/ dang po rtse gcig pa'i zhi gnas dang / dpyad sgom gyi lhag mthong so so'i ngo bo/ de dag ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul/ grub te zung 'brel du 'gro lugs sogs lam rim che chung ltar shes pa gal che zhing / shes nas kyang dge ba'i dmigs rnam gang dang gang blo yul du byed na yang ting nge 'dzin gyi man ngag rnams ldan par bskyang na bogs che bas/ sgom zer rgyu de mdo sde dgongs 'grel dang / shing rta chen po thogs med kyi sa sde spyi dang khyad par nyan thos kyi sa/ ka ma la shī la'i sgom rim gsum/sharnyi ba'i sher phyin man ngag sogs nas zhib rgyas gsungs pa'i don rje bdag nyid chen pos lam rim du bkod pa las lhag pa zhig dus 413
