sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gsum gyi rgyal bas kyang mi snyed/ da lta rnying phyogs kyi rdzogs pa chen po'i rig ngo skyong tshul dang / spyir btang sgom gyi ldog pa gcig tu 'khrul nas gsang sngags kyi thun mong min pa'i 'od gsal lam byed 'ga' re rgyu mtshan du bzung nas so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi sgom spangs pa ni ci yang mi shes pa yin/ thun mong ba'i sgom ni ting nge 'dzin skyon med 'tshol ba yin la/ thun mong min pa'i 'od gsal lam byed ni 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa 'dren pa'i ched yin pas dgos don dang skyong lugs sogs mi gcig pa bla ma'i zhal las shes dgos/spyir zhi lhag zung 'brel tsam ni phyi nang gnyis ma'i thun mong yin la/nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i thun mong min pa'i lhag mthong ni/ bdag medarnam can dang bden pa'i rnam can gyi lhag mthong yin pas de la grub mtha' so so'i bdag med phra rags kyi 'jog tshul mang du gsungs pa rnams grub gzhung rnams nas byung ba ltar shes rgyu dang /lhagapar shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa'i mthil rjen par phyungs pa'i zab mo lta ba'i man ngag jo 'brom yab sras dang / 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i thugs dam nyams bzhes su mdzad pa ni / slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pa'i 'grel chen rnam gsum dang /dbum la 'jug pa ltar lags pas don de ni ches rtogs par dka' 414

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/zhing rtogs na don che ba yin phyir da res kyi rten 'di la bstan pa'i snying bo 'di la bag chags brtan po zhig theb dgos/ de la dgongs 'grel mang yang lhag mthong che chung lta bu shin tu dkon pas der blta rtog byed rgyu gal chung du byas nas nor bu dang 'ching bu ma nor bar tshe mjug 'di 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung rab la gcig dril gyis 'da' bar mdzod/ zab mo'i lta ba la dang por dgag bya nges pa gal che bas dgag bya khyab che chung gi skyon spangs te rang lugs kyi dgag bya ngos 'dzin rgyu dang / dgag bya ngos bzung nas de nyid thal rang gang gis 'gog dang / de dag gis 'gog tshul nyi ma brgya phrag dus gcig tu shar ba las kyang gsal ba'i legs bshad kyi snang ba chen po lhag mthong chen mor yod pas de la go rtogs ci 'gro mdzod/ gnad don mthar thug pa ni/ deng sang gzhi bden pa gnyis kyi rnam dbye byed pa ni/ lam nyams len gyi dus na bden gnyis so so la brten pa'i lam rim gnyis sam bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis 'byung ba'i ched yin la/ lam rim gnyis dgos pa ni/ 'bras dus su chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis 'grub pa'i thabs yin zhing gzhi kun rdzob kyi rnam bzhag la bston du med pa'i nges shes med na de'i lam rim mi 'ong zhing / don dam bden pa la nges shes legs po med na 415

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/yang de'i lam rim 'byung tshul med pas gnyis ka la nges shes 'dren dgos / de yang nges shes gnyis gcig gis gcig la gnod na gnyis ka 'dren tshul med cing / stobs sam nus pa che chung shor na yang lam rim gnyis kyang de bzhin 'gro bas thabs shes gnyis la stobs che chung shor bas theg pa chen po'i lam rim dpyis phyin pa med/des na bden gnyis la nges pa stobs che chung mi rung la/ /nges pa stobs mtshungs su 'dren tshul yang kun rdzob nges pas don dam la nges shes ster zhing / /don dam nges pas kun rdzob la nges pa ster ba zhig gis 'byung ste/ phan tshun nges shes gnyis gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba'i tshe nges shes stabs mtshungs su skye ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i nges shes bskyed lugs ni/ ji skad du/ /snang ba rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang / /stong ba khas len bral ba'i go ba gnyis/ /ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du/ /da dung thub pa'i dgongs pa rnyed pa med//nam zhig res 'jog med par cig char du/ /rten 'brel mi bslur mthong ba tsam nyid nas/ /nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun 'jig na / /de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags/ zhes gsungs pa ltar snang stong gnyis gzhi gcig gi steng du 'du mi rung ba dang / gal te 'du yang snang ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas snang ba nges pa'i blos gzhan 416

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/la ltos med du bden grub kyi dmigs gtad 'jig pa dang / stong ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas stong ba nges pa'i blos blo gzhan la ltos med du las 'bras kyi nges pa la yid ches rnyed pa mi 'ong bas snang stong so so'i rgyu mtshan log nas 'tshol dgos pa dang / /snang ba nges pa'i blos stong ba 'char ba la sgrib pa dang / /stong ba nges pa'i blos snang ba 'char ba la sgrib pa'i tshe snang stong so sor snang ba yin la/ de srid du thub pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa la rtogs pa nang byan chud pa med cing / /nam zhig na gong du bshad pa ltar rgyu 'bras rten 'brel la nges shes 'drong ba de tshe nges shes de ma'i byed pas rgyu mtshan gzhan mi 'tshol bar nges shes de nyid kyis yul gyi dmigs gtad zhig pa zhig byung na snang stong gnyis kyi blo snga phyi yin kyang gtan la 'bebs tshul so so la ltos pa'i res 'jog med par nges shes gnyis gcig char du skye ba 'ong ba'i tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs par gsungs pa ltar lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa zhig e 'ong blta dgos la/ de yang rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsungs sgros nyag ma re re yang dngos shugs kyi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas lhag mthong che chung la ring du blta zhing 'dris par byed pa'i sgo nas chos dang gang zag gang yin kyang yul gyi sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pa med pa dang / yul can blo la 417

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/snang lugs kyi ngos nas 'jog dgos pas gnas lugs don dam par ma grub pa dang / kun rdzob bam tha snyad du 'jog pa'i tshul/ de gnyis kyi nges pa bshad ma thag pa ltar 'drongs pa la tshig tsam min par nyin mtshan ltos med du 'bad rigs pa ni/ 'di la the tshom zos pas kyang / /srid pa hrul bar byed por 'gyur/ /gsungs pa ltar lags pas 'bad par mdzod/ de ltar lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyang bzhin du thun mong min pa rdo rje theg pa la bag chags che theb chung theb byed dgos pas/ de la deng sang gsang sngags bla med kyi gser chos thang mar brdal yod pas lam gyi 'jug sgo dbang bskur tshad ldan rgyud dang grub chen gyi man ngag ltar legs par zhu zhing / dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam sdom la srog bsdos byed pa ni lam gyi srog rtsa gal bo cher gsungs pas dam tshig bsrung ba dang / /sngar las kyang lhag pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la mnyes pa sgrub pa dang / /mi mnyes pa spong pa'i phyag len sla chos su mi gtong bar byin rlabs dngos grub kyi gter kha 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu gcig pur nges par byas te/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su blta ba'i dad gus kyi rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs la bskyon te rim gnyis kyi mos sgom byas na nyams rtogs kyi nor bu ci 'dod du lag rtser 'phen pas na/ tshe mjug 'dir sgrub 418

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa zhig mdzod/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa la yang sgom thag rgyag pa dang / /sgo 'dag sbyar dang / bzlas grangs mang bo 'khyol e thub dang / /ri khrod pa dang / bya bral gyi skad grags chen po gang yang mi dgos/ don chung zhing bar chad 'jug pa'i nyen che/ 'gro'am 'dug gam spyod lam ci byed kyang rang rgyud la rtogs la rgyun du rang sems dad pa'i me long g.ya' dag pa la byin rlabs kyi gter chen po bla ma'i gzugs brnyan yang dang yang du bkod de/ 'di phyi thams cad kyi skyabs gnas gcig chog tu mnga' gsol bzhin so thar gyi sdom pa la zhu dag byang sems kyi bslab pa la smon 'dun/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la bsngo bgrang nyi ma re re bzhin gyis la kha mig sems gsum bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung bzang rnams dang ma 'bral na sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa yin zhes bla ma dam pa rnams kyis gsungs pas de bzhin du mdzad par thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa legs so/ /rang la med pa'i dge sbyor la/ /grogs khyed bskul ba khrel 'das kyang / /nyid kyi thugs la nan che phyir/ /bla ma'i gsung rgyun gleng ba lags/ /de la dge tshogs cung zad yod srid na/ /de mthus rgyal bstan spyi dang 'jam mgon lugs/ /khyed thugs yangs pa'i gshong du ma dros 419

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bzhin / /'khyil de gtan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /dharma sā ras bris/ dge'o/ /༄7/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir brjed tho nyung 'dus 'god na/ rje bla ma'i zhal nas/ gdams ngag 'di spyir rje btsun byams pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rgyan gyi gdams ngag yin la/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab rgyas kyi dgongs pa byams 'jam dbyangs nas klu sgrub thogs med la brgyud de rim par phebs par theg chen gyi lam srol nyid las dang po la dgongs te skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim du bsdus nas gsungs pas/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang sbyar nas go ba len pa shin tu legs so/ /de yang mngon rtogs rgyan du yum gyi sbas don gsal bar 'grel tshul ni/ thog mar skabs dang po gsum du shes bya mkhyen pa gsum gyi rnam bzhag nyams su blang ba'i dbang du byas te 'phags pa bzhis khyad par gyis legs par gsungs / de'i 'og tu skabs bzhi ba nas bdun pa'i bar nyams su len tshul gyi dbang du byas te rgyu 'bras cha gnyis kyi sgos sbyor ba bzhi gsungs la/ de yang mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa'i grangs ma chad par nyams su len pa'i sgo nas rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang / /rnam pa de dag 420

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/go rim mthar chags su ma 'khrugs par bsgom pa'i cha nas mthar gyis sbyor ba ste bsgom tshul gnyis bzhag la/ gnyis pa ltar bsgom pas skad cig sbyor thob pas bsgom pa'i 'bras bu'i sbyor ba yang gnyis so/ /de ltar nyams su blang bya mkhyen gsum/ len byed sbyor bzhis nyams su blang pas mthar thug gi 'bras bu chos kyi sku ni zag med sde tshan nyer gcig sogs kyi sgo nas skabs brgyad par gsungs so / /de ltar yum don rje btsun gyi bkral ba de ltar nyams su len pa la byang chub lam rim gyi gdams pa 'di byung bas dang po mkhyen gsum gyi skabs ltar nyams su blang bya 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rigs kun skabs 'dir skyes bu gsum gyi nyams len du dril te nyams su blang bya'i ngo bo nges pa zhig thog mar dgos/ de nas 'phags rgyud kyi mngon rtogs de dag rang rgyud kyi ngan rtog gi gnyen por rgyud steng du bskor ba la nyams su blang bya'i rnam pa'i grangs ma chad par yongs su rdzogs pa zhig dgos pas rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ltar nyams su len la skabs dang mthun pa'i grangs nges yod pa zhig byed/ grangs nges tshul de yang mthar gyis sbyor ba ltar snga phyi'i go rim gyis nyams su blang na rgyud la tshegs med par skye bas nyams len gyi go rim nges nges byas pa rnams 421

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/kyang shin tu gal che ba dang / rgyan gyi gdams ngag yin pa shes par byas te lam gyi ngo bo nges pa dang / grangs nges pa dang / go rim nges pa gsum gyi sgo nas nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /de tshe skabs 'dir nyams len mgo dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung ba ni bka' gdams gzhung ba'i lugs te/ be'u bum sngon po las man ngag thams cad bsdus pa'i mgo ni/ bshes gnyen dam pa mi gtong pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /don de rgyan gyi man ngag yin tshul ni/ skabs bzhi bar mkhyen pa gsum gyi shes rnam brgya dang don gsum rang rgyud kyi phyin ci log gi 'dzin stangs so so'i gnyen por bsgom pa'i ched du legs par gsungs pa'i 'og tu sbyor ba nyi shus rim pas bsgom pa la sgom pa po dang bsgom tshul gyi sngon 'gro'i dbang du byas te/ /sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun/ /dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa/ /'di mnyan pa yi snod yin no/ /gsungs pa dang / sdud par/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la brten to zhes/ /yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal ba de skad gsungs/ /gsungs shing brgyad stong bar dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul gal che ba las brtsam te rtag tu ngu'i rnam par thar pa rgyas par gsung ste/ de ni mthun dper bkod pa yin 422

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/no / /bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gyi bsten tshul bdud las spong tshul gyi skabs nas go dgos pa mang du yod do/ /sbyor chos kyi khungs kyang /sbyor ba sgom pa pos sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dge rtsa bskrun dgos pa 'di yin la/ brgyad stong 'grel chen du yang byang chub sems dpa' sa phyogs gtsang mar skyil mo krung bcas te sogs gsungs tshul gyi khungs mang ngo / /sher phyin gyi rtogs pa skye ba la phyi rol nas lhan cig byed rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi byin rlabs khyad par can thob pa dang / nang nas nyer len gyi rgyu nyams len gyi cha yongs su rdzogs pa la dmigs rnam brkyang ste blo sbyang khyad par can byed pa gnyis gal gang che yin pas lam rim yongs rdzogs sa bcad gnyis su dril nas khul gyi ngo bo ltar cha mnyam du gsungs pa yin zhes rgyud chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsungs rgyun yin zhing / dmigs rnam la blo sbyang ba la/ skabs 'dir thog mar dal ba'i rten la snying bo len pa'i phyir du bskul ba ni/ rang la brtson 'grus kyi lcag gis bkrab pa yin pas/skabs dang por go cha'i sgrub pa sogs brtson 'grus kyi ldog pa nas gsungs pā dang gnad gcig pa'i khungs yang de yin la/ /der ma zad lo zla bzhin theg chen gyi sbyor ba dus tshigs su bcad de nyams su len dgos par gsungs pas sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba yang 'grig go//423

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/sher phyin du skyes bu gsum gyi nyams len so sor phyes te gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa che tshul sogs lam rim rang nas gsungs pa ltar shis pa shin tu gal che ste/ 'di la snyigs ma'i dus kyi gdul bya blo rtul bo rnams rtogs pa gong ma la tshegs med du 'khrid pa'i nyams len gyi gnad gcig yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i chos skor 'di rnams ni/ gzhi shes kyi bden bzhi'i rnam pa rtogs pa'i skabs dang rjes su mthun par mi rtag pa dang / /sdug bsngal sogs la phra rags phyes te rags rim nas blo sbyang byed bcug ste lam gong ma la 'khrid pa'i sta gon lta bus chos kyi gzhi 'dzug pa yin la/ dang po mi rtag pa'i chos skor gyis 'di snang gi zhen pa 'gog pa ni/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun gyi thog mar med pa'i rnam pa nas dbu btsug pa nas 'di'i nyams len las dang po pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ med pa'i rnam pa 'di nges med drug la sbyar nas rags pa'i mi rtag pa'i tshul gyis go dgos pa yang ka chen yongs 'dzin rin po che'i gsungs rgyun yin zhes gung thang gsungs/ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsgom pa yang / mi skye ba'i rnam pa'i nyams len te/ 'di dngos bstan stong nyid kyi dbang du byas pa ma gtogs sbas don la sdug bsngal gyi sgo skye ba blang ba 'dis phyes pas de la nyes 424

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/dmigs su blta ba dang / khyad par du ngan 'gror skye ba la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal mdzod phye bar song lugs kyi steng nas rim par blo sbyong ba'i sgo phye ba yin no/ /de nas skyabs 'gro ni/ theg chen sgrub pa'i rten yin pa gdams ngag gi skabs su 'byung la skabs 'dir yang 'og gi chung ngu'i chos skor dngos gzhi mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims sogs kyi rten yin la/ 'di nas bzung skyabs 'gro'i sgos rang nyid nang bar sgrub pa yin nga/sa shin tu gal che'o/ /skyabs su song nas kyang las 'bras kyi blang dor la yid ches bskyed de lag len bya dgos pa 'di/ byang chub sems dpas sgrub pa nyams len gyi tshe shes bya'i chos thams cad spyir sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gzhi'i dmigs pa bcu gcig tu dril yang dgos su dang por blang dor btang snyoms su bya ba gsum gyi sgo nas de ltar lag len bya ba'i gzhir gsungs pa 'dis dge mi dge'i las 'bras kyi blang dor bya dgos par gsungs pa yin pas lag len de 'dra gal che ba yin no/ /skyes bu 'bring gi skabs 'di dag ni/ mkhyen pa gsum las gzhi shes dang / sbyor ba'i skabs rnam pa nyer bdun nyams su len pa yin la/ de la thog mar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong ba'i blo sbyang ba'i byis pa'i blo sna lta bu zhig dgos par gsungs pa ni/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /425

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang / /gsungs pa'i gzhi shes gnyis kyi don du med mi rung ba yin te/ 'bring gi blo rigs de 'dra rgyud la ma skyes par nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang / snying rje chen po sogs rgyud la skye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gzhi shes lam shes thams cad kyi skabs kyi mi rtag sogs rnam pa bcu drug bsgom pa'i lam rnams kyi nyams len phyogs gcig tu dril te/ thog mar myong ba 'don pa yin pas shin tu gal bo che yin pa shes dgos so/ /'bring gi bsam pa la blo 'byongs pa'i 'og tu bsam pa des drangs de bslab pa gsum las kyang thog mar tshul khrims la slob dgos par gsungs pa ni/ sher phyin gyi skabs 'dir theg chen gyi 'phags pa rnams kyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan gong nas gong du sbyong ba la sa rang rang gi yongs sbyong rnams gsungs shing / yongs sbyong re re'i skabs su yang tshul khrims med pa med la/ khyad par du/ nags gnas 'dod chung chog shes dang / /sbyang ba yang dag sdom bsten dang / /bslab pa yongs su mi gtong dang / /'dod pa rnams la smod pa dang / /sogs tshul khrims gyi nyams len rtsal du bton cing / sa re re'i yongs sbyongs yang phal cher sa kun la 'khyer shes dgos pa dang / khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /426

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/gsungs pa yang 'di ltar shes dgos pas byang 'phags la yon tan sbyong byed dad rten du gal chen so skye dang las dang po ba la lta ci smos/de ltar na mdo'i shes byed 'di ltar tshul khrims la gces spras gnad du che'o/ /skyes bu chen po'i skor/ ji skad du/ sems bskyed theg mchog lam gyi gzhung shing ste/ /rlabs chen spyod pa rnams kyi gzhi dang rten / /sogs gsungs pa rnams kyi don dpyis phyin pa'i khungs ni yum gyi skabs 'dir don bdun cu'i dbu sems bskyed nas btsug pa dang / theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed gcig la sa lta ba'i sems bskyed sogs nyer gnyis kyi rab dbyes theg chen gyi lam 'bras mtha' dag bsdus nas gsungs pa 'di dag gis sems bskyed theg chen gyi 'jug sgo dang / gzhung shing du bstan pa yin la/ de yang sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid skabs/ gzhan don don gnyer gyi rgyu las byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dun pa grogs su yod pa'i bsam pa khyad par can zhig sems skyed du bstan pa'i shugs la rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun dang bdag gzhan mnyam rje'i theg chen gyi bsam pa sbyong dgos pa don gyis thon cing / /yum gyi skabs 'di'i mdor rgyas kyi mdo rnams dang sbyar na theg chen gyi bsam pa 'di 'dra sbyang dgos pa la nges shes chen po skye bar snang bas sems sbyong gi gdams pa 'di 427

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gnyis yum gyi sbas don gyi nang nas khyad nor mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin pa shes par byas la gces par 'dzin dgos so/ /khyad par mar shes sgom pa sogs ni skabs bzhi ba'i sbyor lam gyi mdo'i dgongs pa yin par gsungs pas/ rgyan las de dag nyid la sems mnyam sogs / /rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do/ /zhes pa'i don yin par 'dug go/ /lam shes kyi yan lag skabs lam shes skye ba'i yul sems bskyed dang ldan pa nges par dgos par gsungs pas kyang sems bskyed med mi rung ba yin par shes nus pa sogs skabs gong 'og tu shin tu mang yang de tsam las ma spros so/ /sems bskyed nas spyod pa la slob dgos pa ni/ theg chen sgrub pa bzhi'i dang po bsam pa'i ngos nas phyin drug la slob pa'i go cha rgya chen po bgo dgos pa'i go sgrub 'di rang gis shes shing / sbyor ba'i skabs/ sbyin pa shes rab bar dag dang / /sogs phyin drug gi nyams len gyis zin pa'i sgo nas mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba sgom par gsungs pa sogs kyis go nus la/sher phyin rang las kyang rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon da ltar gang bzhugs pa/ kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin zhes dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam du dngos su gsungs pa sogs kyis theg pa chen po'i lam gyi lus 428

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/su mtshon nus pas lam ltar snang la mgo mi 'khor bar nyams len gyi gnad zin pa zhig ces kyang dgos so/ /phar phyin tha ma gnyis la bslab par gsungs pa'i skabs/ lhag mthong gi sems rten du zhi gnas khyad par can bsgrub dgos pa dang de yang nyes pa lnga spongs pa'i 'du byed brgyad bsten tshul dang / de las sems gnas dgu rim par brgyud de khams gong ma'i sas bsdus kyi nyer bzlog dang dngos gzhi'i snyom 'jug sgrub pa ni theg chen gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo grangs med pa'i gzhi yin pa dang / sbyor ba khyad par can gyi sgo nas theg pa chen po'i lam gong ma gong ma la 'jug 'dzegs byed pa'i 'jug sgrub kyi nyams len dang / sgrub pa la rang dbang du 'jug pa'i rgyu spyan dang / sgrub pa myur du rdzogs pa'i rgyu mngon shes sogs la 'jug pa'i rgyu yin zhing / khyad par du mdo las/ sems mnyam par bzhag na yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar so sor rtogs pa'i lhag mthong shes rab kyi rten du rgyal bas yang yang bsngags pas na/ 'dir yang nyams su blang dgos par gsungs pa lags so/ /sbyor ba'i skabs su yang / 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu/ /sogs thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin sgom tshul gsungs so/ /lhag mthong ni/ sdud pa las/ shes 429

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga yi/ /dmigs bu med pas byang chub reg par nus ma yin/ /sogs gsungs pa ltar shin tu gal che bar gsungs pa shes sla la/ 'on kyang shes rab khyad par can gyi yul bdag med pa'i gnas lugs la mi mthun pa mang bas rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos gtan la phab pa 'di ltar rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin tshul dang / nges don gyi mdo sde spyi dang / lhag par sher phyin gyi mdo'i dngos bstan du bston du med pa'i lung rigs kyi shes byed 'god dgos kyang / kho bo blo dang brtson pa zhan pas mang du bshad par ni mi nus/ /cung zad cig nus pa yang dus kyi mtha' 'dir sa 'di phyogs ris kyis gang bas don du yang mi 'gyur bas bzhag go/ /mdor bsdus na/ da lta'i nyams len la brtson pa rnams lam mthon po la dgyes pa'i rgyun mtha'i bar chad med rtse'i steng nas mtshon na/mngon rtog rgyan las/ 'di yi dmigs pa dngos med de/ /bdag po dran pa yin par gzhed/ /rnam pa zhi nyid 'di la ni/ /rab tu smra rnams rgyud mar rgol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas lugs stong ba nyid la gnyis snang phra mos kyang bar ma chod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi dngos rgyu nus pa thogs med du gyur ba'i skad cig sbyor ni dgag bya bden ba'i dngos po 430

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/bkag pa'i dngos med dmigs yul du byas te grangs med gsum du goms pa'i dran pa khyad par can gyi bdag rkyen gyi mthu las blo'i 'dzin stangs kyi rnam pa yul gyi ngos nas mtha' bzhi gang du yang grub pa med pa'i spros pa zhi ba'i gnas lugs la ro gcig tu zhugs pa nyid la gsal bar gsungs pas de ltar shing rta rnam bdun gyi rigs pa dang gcig du bral sogs kyis gtan la phab nas sgom dgos te/des na gcig du bral gyi rigs pas gnad bzhi'i sgo nas nyung ngur brjod na/ thog mar dgag bya nges pa'i gnad ni/ tha na rmi lam gyi skabs tshun chad du nga nga snyam pa'i blo lhan skyes 'di la nga ji ltar snang tshul nges pa gal che bas zhib tu brtags na/ lus sems dbyer med 'o chu 'dres pa lta bu'i steng nas phar btags snyam med par tshur grub grub cig 'char gyin yod pas snang tshul de ltar don la yod pa'i nga dang nga yi ba ni skabs 'dir dgag bya rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i nga sogs yin no/ /de nas khyab pa nges pa'i gnad ni/ yod na gcig dang du ma gang rung gi tshul du yod dgos pa'i spyi khyab nges pa la brten nas bye brag tu nga rang bzhin gyi grub pa yod na yang gdags gzhi phung bo lnga dang gcig tha dad gang rung zhig tu yod dgos par grub la/ spyi khyab de yang phung gsum pa med pa'i 'gal ba yin tshul 431

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gyis 'grub pa shes dgos so/ /de nas gcig bral nges pa'i gnad ni de 'dra'i nga de phung po lnga dang gcig tu yod do snyam na/ phung bo lnga bo bdag gis nye bar blang bya dang / bdag len pa po yin pas nye bar blang bya len byed kyi bya byed gcig tu thal ba dang / phung po lnga yod pa bzhin de dang gcig pa'i nga lnga yod pa'am/ /yang na de nga gcig yin pa bzhin phung po gcig tu thal ba dang / bdag khas blang ba phung po 'dor len gyi byed pa po'i don du yin pa la de tshe de mi rung bas bdag khas blang ba don med du thal ba sogs kyis gnod pas na bdag phung gcig tu ma grub bo/ /du bral nges pa'i gnad ni/ yang nga de phung bo lnga dang tha dad du yod do snyam na/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i tha dad la ltos med kyi tha dad dgos pas ngo bo tha dad du 'gyur la / de tshe ra bsal ba'i shul du lug lus pa yod pa bzhin tu phung bo lnga bsal ba'i 'og tu nga 'di'o zhes bstan du yod dgos pa la cung zad kyang med pas bdag phung tha dad kyang ma yin no/ /de lta na nga ni gang nas kyang ma rnyed pas med pa yin no snyam na/ btsal ba'i ma rnyed pa de rang bzhin gyis med pa'i don yin gyi/ med pa'i don ma yin te yod na yul steng nas btsal de rnyed pa'i dbang du byas nas yod mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na nga btsal ba'i ma rnyed bzhin du 432

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/'jog lugs de ci 'dra zhig yin zer na/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ chos thams cad 'jig rten gyi tha snyad du yod kyi/ don dam par ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nga'o snyam pa'i blo dang nga zhes brjod pa'i sgra rtog gi tha snyad kyis phar btags tsam 'di la tshad ma gang gis kyang mi gnod pas ming rkyang btags yod tsam du yod pa yin te/nye ba 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ sna tshogs yid dga' me tog kha phye zhing / /gser gyi khang mchog 'bar ba yid 'ong ba/ /'di na de la byed po 'ga' med de/ /de dag rtog pa'i dbang gis bzhag pa yin/ /rtog pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten rnams btags te/ /mi shes byis pa'i bden par rnam par zhen/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lhag mthong gi skabs 'dir gzhi re re'i steng du yang / bden gnyis mi 'gal par gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba'i tshul gtan la 'bebs pa yin la/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang gzhi re re'i steng du bden gnyis kyi rnam pa mtha' dag cig char mngon sum du gzigs par byed pas lhag mthong gi tshul 'di ni rnam mkhyen gyi thun mong min pa'i rigs 'dra'i nyams len yin la sbyor ba'i skabs skad cig sbyor gyi dmigs rnams las 'phros te bsal bya log sgrub bcu drug bsal tshul yang mthar gtug na skabs 'di'i snang stong mi 433

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'gal bar ma zad snang bas yod mtha' sel ba dang / stong bas med mtha' sel tshul 'di'i steng nas legs par go dgos pas sbyor ba khyad par can gyi nyams len shin tu gces pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam nyams len gyi srog dam pa yin no/ /de ltar skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim 'di ni/ rgyal ba'i gsungs rab bka' dgongs 'grel chen po rnams bsdus te nyams su len tshul gyi lag len khrig chags su bkod pa yin pas 'di las zab pa med la/ khyad par du mdo sde thams cad kyi rgyal po yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum nyams su len tshul gyi sgom yig gnad du dril ba yin pas/ dngos bstan stong nyid dang sbas don mngon par rtogs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i sdom chen po bla na med pa yin pas/ rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i zhal snga nas/ gsung rab kun gyi snying bo bsdu bsdu ba/ /tshul 'di thun re ston dang nyan pas kyang / /dam chos 'chad dang thos pa'i phan yon rnams/ /rlabs chen sdud par nges pas de don bsam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yang theg pa chen po spyi'i lam gyi khog 'di dang 'brel na tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi gnad dang ldan pa'i nye lam yin gyi/ min na ni theg pa chen po ma zad thar lam tsam 434

theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa bzhugs/gyi grangs su yang mi tshud do/ /don de dag shes par byas te byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len 'bad nas dal 'byor la snying bo ci lon gang lon bya dgos so/ /zhes mngon rtog rgyan dang lam rim gzhung dang man ngag tu sbyang tshul rang blos gang dpog tu bkod pa 'di ni/shākya'i dge slong bsod nams phun tshogs kyi gsung ngo mi ldog tsam du/lam rim chen mo'i khrid kyi skabs su rang gis gang smras kyi bshad pa/dharma sā ras yi ger bkod pa dge legs 'phel/dbu ma la 'jug pa nyams su len pa la/ nyams su blang bya lam gyi rigs bsdus te gtso bo so skyes sa'i chos gsum/ 'phags pa'i sa bcu mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa rnams yin/ de nyams su len pa'i tshe thog mar snying rje chen po thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che ba nges shes ci 'thob byas te theg pa chen po'i thabs kyi rtsa ba btsug pa'am/mong gzhi bting nas skye med kyi lta ba grogs su bzung ste byang chub tu sems yang nas yang du bskyed pa rnams dngos por gal che ba'i nyams len yin la/ de nas byang sems sar gnas kyi spyod pa la yar bltas te theg chen lam gyi khog phyin drug nyams len gyis stong ba zhig gis theg pa chen po'i spyi'i thun mong ba'i lam yongs su rdzogs pa tshang ba min no/ /skabs de dag tu 'bras bu gnas mthar gyi sa'i yon 435

tan 'thob tshul la brod pa bskyed de/ brtson 'grus sbar gyin 'bras bu lam byed sngags kyi thabs mkhas kyi snon pa dang bcas byang chub lam rim dang khog gcig tu byas te goms pa yin bsring bar bya'o / / //

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ bkra shis/mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ kurma tshe ring /sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/deb gnyis pa/mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gzhung las khang gis bsdu sgrig byas/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa dang /si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun nas bkram/si khron ca khrong par 'debs tshad yod 'gan 'khri kung sis dpar/2006lo'i zla12par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2006lo'i zla12par par thengs dang po dpar/par grangs/ 0001wa 2000dpe rtags/152ga978—7—5409—3370—8pod gsum po la rin sgor/ 60 00
lngo 1——

(mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dag sgrig dpe yin bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gi ming tho/tshan gtso/ pad ma rnam rgyal/tshan gtso gzhon pa/ byis tshe ring / dkon mchogaskal bzang tshe ring / bstan chos/ 'jigs med/gces ma/ klu skyabs/ nor sde/khongs mi(ming rim bod yig ka mad ltar bsgrigs pa)dkon mchog skal bzang tshe ring / klu skyabs/dge legs/ mgon lha/ gces ma/'ju skal bzang / 'jigs med/ bstan chos/thub bzang / dung gces/ nor sde/pad ma rnam rgyal/ byis tshe ring /

(lkoḥṣ+ṭhakhyerngo657〉lorgyu 21tsho cha ku ñtsa3767)ri:224:2 4 khye raṣ+ṭha//:ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha ma〉〉〉 〉〉ba77711 2〉ba 'ir+sā0lho lhor po〈rtsolo zla (ṣ+ṭha༅ṭha07)tshakhri7/1)'ir+sā 707/6 4777/1 lkoṣ+ṭha 〉〉ba0lho lho༄ r+sā13ṣ+ṭha stsa khyeraṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha ṣ+ṭha12 〉〉rkos
/spyoskeskyi chi:
